```python
"""Shared contact validation for public interests and setter capture."""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

CONTACT_CONFIG = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'config/interests/contact.config.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
PRIVACY_VERSION = CONTACT_CONFIG['privacy_version']
PREFERENCES = {option['value'] for option in CONTACT_CONFIG['preferences']}


def normalize_contact(values):
    preference, phone, email = values.get('contactPreference'), values.get('phone'), values.get('email', '')
    if not isinstance(preference, str) or preference not in PREFERENCES:
        raise ValueError('Choose a contact preference')
    if not isinstance(phone, str) or len(phone) > 30:
        raise ValueError('Invalid phone')
    phone = re.sub(r'[ ()-]', '', phone.strip())
    if not re.fullmatch(r'\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}', phone):
        raise ValueError('Use an international phone number')
    if not isinstance(email, str):
        raise ValueError('Invalid email')
    email = email.strip().lower()
    if len(email) > 254 or not re.fullmatch(r'[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+', email):
        raise ValueError('Invalid email')
    return {'phone': phone, 'email': email, 'contact_preference': preference}
```

```python
"""Run with python -m backend.dev_server; Vite proxies /api to this server."""
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment

from api.chat import handler as ChatHandler
from api.interests import handler as InterestHandler
from api.chat_feedback import handler as FeedbackHandler
from api.hotmart_click import handler as HotmartClickHandler
from api.admin import handler as AdminHandler


class DevApiHandler(InterestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/admin':
            return AdminHandler.do_POST(self)
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/hotmart_click':
            return HotmartClickHandler.do_POST(self)
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/chat_feedback':
            return FeedbackHandler.do_POST(self)
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/chat':
            return ChatHandler.do_POST(self)
        return super().do_POST()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/health':
            return self.reply(200, {'status': 'ready'})
        if self.path.split('?', 1)[0].rstrip('/') == '/api/chat':
            return ChatHandler.do_GET(self)
        return super().do_GET()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    load_local_environment()
    print("API local: http://127.0.0.1:3001 (/api/admin, /api/interests, /api/chat y /api/hotmart_click)")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 3001), DevApiHandler).serve_forever()
```

```python
"""Anonymous click registration. Counting is atomic and idempotent in Postgres."""
from uuid import UUID

from backend.chat_store import rpc, StoreUnavailable
from backend.source_context import source_path


def record_click(payload, visitor):
    try:
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != {'event_id', 'source', 'source_path'}:
            raise ValueError()
        event = str(UUID(payload['event_id']))
        source = payload['source']
        path = source_path(payload['source_path'])
        if source not in ('chatbot', 'course', 'home'):
            raise ValueError()
        if (source == 'course' and path != '/cursos') or (source == 'home' and path != '/'):
            raise ValueError()
        result = rpc('record_hotmart_click', {'p_event': event, 'p_visitor': visitor,
                                             'p_source': source, 'p_source_path': path})
        return {'recorded': 200, 'rate_limited': 429, 'conflict': 409}.get(result.get('status'), 503), result
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        return 400, {'status': 'invalid'}
    except StoreUnavailable:
        return 503, {'status': 'unavailable'}
```

```python
"""Validation and insert-only persistence; no personal data is written to logs."""
import json
import os
import re
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from backend.supabase_config import PROJECT_URL, PUBLISHABLE_KEY
from backend.chat_identity import fingerprint
from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable, rpc
from uuid import UUID
from backend.contact_details import PRIVACY_VERSION, normalize_contact
from backend.source_context import source_path

CONTACT_PRIVACY_VERSION = PRIVACY_VERSION


class InvalidSubmission(ValueError):
    pass


class StorageUnavailable(Exception):
    pass


class RateLimited(Exception):
    pass


def text_field(values, key, maximum, required=True):
    value = values.get(key, "")
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise InvalidSubmission("Invalid text field")
    value = value.strip()
    if len(value) > maximum or (required and not value):
        raise InvalidSubmission("Invalid text length")
    return value or None


def validate_submission(payload):
    if isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get('source') == 'chatbot':
        return validate_contact(payload)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("interest") not in ("online", "nature", "consultation"):
        raise InvalidSubmission("Invalid interest")
    if payload.get("privacyConsent") is not True:
        raise InvalidSubmission("Privacy consent is required")
    if not isinstance(payload.get("updatesConsent", False), bool) or payload.get("website"):
        raise InvalidSubmission("Invalid submission")
    values = payload.get("values")
    if not isinstance(values, dict):
        raise InvalidSubmission("Invalid fields")
    kind = payload["interest"]
    allowed = {"name", "email", "phone", "contactPreference", "country", "experience"} if kind == "online" else {"name", "email", "phone", "contactPreference", "city"}
    if kind == 'consultation':
        allowed = {"name", "email", "phone", "contactPreference"}
    if set(values) - allowed:
        raise InvalidSubmission("Unexpected fields")
    try:
        details = {**normalize_contact(values), 'source_path': source_path(payload.get('source_path'))}
    except ValueError as error:
        raise InvalidSubmission(str(error)) from None
    return {
        "interest": kind,
        "full_name": text_field(values, "name", 120),
        **details,
        "country": text_field(values, "country", 100) if kind == "online" else None,
        "city": text_field(values, "city", 100) if kind == "nature" else None,
        "experience": text_field(values, "experience", 500, required=False) if kind == "online" else None,
        "updates_consent": payload.get("updatesConsent", False),
        "privacy_consent": True,
        "privacy_version": PRIVACY_VERSION,
    }


def validate_contact(payload):
    if set(payload) - {'source', 'interest', 'values', 'privacyConsent', 'contactConsent', 'updatesConsent',
                       'website', 'request_id', 'conversation_id', 'source_path'}:
        raise InvalidSubmission('Unexpected fields')
    if payload.get('interest') not in ('consultation', 'course', 'online', 'nature'):
        raise InvalidSubmission('Invalid service')
    if payload.get('privacyConsent') is not True or payload.get('contactConsent') is not True:
        raise InvalidSubmission('Consent is required')
    if not isinstance(payload.get('updatesConsent', False), bool) or payload.get('website'):
        raise InvalidSubmission('Invalid submission')
    values = payload.get('values')
    if not isinstance(values, dict) or set(values) - {'name', 'phone', 'email', 'contactPreference'}:
        raise InvalidSubmission('Invalid fields')
    try:
        details = {**normalize_contact(values), 'source_path': source_path(payload.get('source_path'))}
    except ValueError as error:
        raise InvalidSubmission(str(error)) from None
    try:
        UUID(payload.get('request_id'))
        UUID(payload.get('conversation_id'))
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        raise InvalidSubmission('Invalid request') from None
    return {'interest': payload['interest'], 'full_name': text_field(values, 'name', 120),
            **details, 'contact_channel': details['contact_preference'],
            'contact_consent': True, 'privacy_consent': True, 'privacy_version': CONTACT_PRIVACY_VERSION,
            'updates_consent': payload.get('updatesConsent', False)}


def save_interest(record):
    # This is a publishable key, restricted to INSERT by database grants and RLS.
    # Never substitute a service_role/secret key: public writes need no read privileges.
    url = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL", PROJECT_URL).rstrip("/")
    key = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY", PUBLISHABLE_KEY)
    request = Request(
        f"{url}/rest/v1/interest_registrations",
        data=json.dumps(record).encode("utf-8"),
        method="POST",
        headers={"apikey": key, "Content-Type": "application/json", "Prefer": "return=minimal"},
    )
    try:
        with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            if response.status != 201:
                raise StorageUnavailable()
    except HTTPError as error:
        try:
            details = json.loads(error.read(4096))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
            details = {}
        if not isinstance(details, dict):
            details = {}
        if error.code == 429 or (details.get("code") == "P0001" and details.get("message") == "interest_rate_limited"):
            raise RateLimited() from None
        raise StorageUnavailable() from None
    except (URLError, TimeoutError, OSError):
        raise StorageUnavailable() from None


def process_submission(payload, visitor=None):
    try:
        record = validate_submission(payload)
    except InvalidSubmission:
        return 400, {"status": "invalid", "message": "Revisa los campos y acepta la información de privacidad."}
    if isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get('source') == 'chatbot':
        if not visitor:
            return 401, {'status': 'session_required'}
        try:
            digest = fingerprint(json.dumps({'visitor': visitor, 'conversation': payload['conversation_id'],
                                             'record': record}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
            result = rpc('setter_save_contact', {'p_visitor': visitor, 'p_conversation': payload['conversation_id'],
                         'p_request': payload['request_id'], 'p_hash': digest, 'p_record': record})
            return (201 if result['status'] == 'saved' else 429 if result['status'] == 'rate_limited' else 409), result
        except (StoreUnavailable, ValueError):
            return 503, {'status': 'unavailable'}
    try:
        save_interest(record)
    except RateLimited:
        return 429, {"status": "rate_limited", "message": "Recibimos varios intentos. Espera un minuto antes de reintentar."}
    except StorageUnavailable:
        return 503, {"status": "unavailable", "message": "No pudimos confirmar el registro. Inténtalo nuevamente más tarde."}
    return 201, {"status": "saved"}
```

```python
"""Load only supported server settings for the local development server."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

SERVER_KEYS = {'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_MODEL', 'SUPABASE_URL', 'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY', 'SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY',
               'CHAT_COOKIE_SECRET', 'CHAT_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION', 'CHAT_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION',
               'CHAT_DAILY_BUDGET_MICRO_USD', 'APP_ENV', 'OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT', 'OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS',
               'OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', 'CHAT_TEST_METRICS', 'MARKETING_LEDGER_ENABLED', 'MARKETING_REPORTS_ENABLED'}


def load_local_environment(root=None):
    root = Path(root) if root is not None else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    for filename in ('.env.local', '.env'):
        path = root / filename
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
            key, separator, value = line.strip().partition('=')
            if separator and key in SERVER_KEYS:
                value = value.strip()
                if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in ('"', "'"):
                    value = value[1:-1]
                if value:
                    os.environ.setdefault(key, value)
```

```python
"""Whole-file CSV validation. A malformed batch is never partially applied."""
import csv
import hashlib
import io
from backend.marketing_ledger import MOVEMENT_FIELDS, SPEND_FIELDS, InvalidMarketingData, validate_movement, validate_spend

MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ROWS = 10000


def parse_marketing_csv(content, kind='movements', campaigns=None):
    if kind not in {'movements', 'spend'} or not isinstance(content, bytes) or len(content) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_file')
    try:
        text = content.decode('utf-8-sig')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_encoding') from None
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    columns = MOVEMENT_FIELDS if kind == 'movements' else SPEND_FIELDS
    validator = validate_movement if kind == 'movements' else validate_spend
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text, newline=''), strict=True)
    rows, errors, identities = [], [], {}
    try:
        if not reader.fieldnames or len(reader.fieldnames) != len(columns) or set(reader.fieldnames) != set(columns):
            raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_columns')
        for index, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            if index > MAX_ROWS + 1:
                raise InvalidMarketingData('too_many_rows')
            try:
                value = validator(row, campaigns)
                key = (value['provider'], value['external_event_id']) if kind == 'movements' else (
                    value['platform'], value['campaign_id'], value['spend_date'], value['currency'])
                if key in identities:
                    if identities[key] != value:
                        raise InvalidMarketingData('conflicting_duplicate')
                    continue
                identities[key] = value
                rows.append(value)
            except InvalidMarketingData as error:
                errors.append({'line': index, 'code': str(error)})
    except csv.Error:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_csv') from None
    if not rows and not errors:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('empty_file')
    return {'schema_version': 1, 'kind': kind, 'file_digest': digest, 'rows': rows, 'errors': errors, 'valid': not errors}


def apply_marketing_batch(batch, store):
    if batch.get('valid') is not True or batch.get('errors') or not batch.get('rows'):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_batch')
    return store.apply_batch({key: batch[key] for key in ('schema_version', 'kind', 'file_digest', 'rows')})
```

```python
"""Strict marketing ledger normalization. Never log contact or raw CSV values."""
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone, date
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path
import json

CURRENCY_DIGITS = {'CLP': 0, 'USD': 2, 'EUR': 2}
MOVEMENT_FIELDS = ('provider', 'external_transaction_id', 'external_event_id', 'event_type', 'occurred_at',
                   'service', 'product_id', 'currency', 'amount_decimal', 'campaign_id', 'attribution_method', 'attribution_reference')
SPEND_FIELDS = ('platform', 'campaign_id', 'spend_date', 'source_timezone', 'currency', 'spend_decimal')
PROVIDERS = {'hotmart', 'consultation_payments'}
EVENT_TYPES = {'sale', 'refund', 'chargeback', 'fee', 'tax', 'adjustment'}
SERVICES = {'consultation', 'course', 'online', 'nature'}


class InvalidMarketingData(ValueError):
    """Only a fixed error code, never a rejected value."""


def identifier(value, optional=False):
    if value == '' and optional:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,119}', value):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_identifier')
    return value


def currency_digits(currency):
    if currency not in CURRENCY_DIGITS:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('unsupported_currency')
    return CURRENCY_DIGITS[currency]


def money_minor(value, currency, allow_zero=False):
    digits = currency_digits(currency)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 32 or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?', value):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_amount')
    try:
        amount = Decimal(value) * (10 ** digits)
        if amount != amount.to_integral_value() or amount < 0 or (not allow_zero and amount == 0) or amount > 9_000_000_000_000_000:
            raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_amount')
        return int(amount)
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_amount') from None


def utc_timestamp(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 40:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_timestamp')
    try:
        instant = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        if instant.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError()
        return instant.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    except (ValueError, OverflowError):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_timestamp') from None


def campaign_ids():
    file = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'config' / 'marketing' / 'campaigns.json'
    return {entry['utm_id'] for entry in json.loads(file.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['campaigns']}


def validate_movement(row, campaigns=None):
    if set(row) != set(MOVEMENT_FIELDS) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in row.values()):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_columns')
    if row['provider'] not in PROVIDERS or row['event_type'] not in EVENT_TYPES or row['service'] not in SERVICES:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_catalog_value')
    # Adjustments need signed/revision semantics; never guess their economic sign.
    if row['event_type'] == 'adjustment':
        raise InvalidMarketingData('adjustment_requires_review')
    currency_digits(row['currency'])
    campaign = identifier(row['campaign_id'], optional=True)
    reference = identifier(row['attribution_reference'], optional=True)
    method = row['attribution_method'] or 'unknown'
    known = campaign_ids() if campaigns is None else campaigns
    if method == 'unknown':
        if campaign or reference:
            raise InvalidMarketingData('unknown_attribution_has_evidence')
    elif method not in {'provider_campaign', 'documented_manual'} or campaign not in known or not reference:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_attribution')
    return {'provider': row['provider'], 'external_transaction_id': identifier(row['external_transaction_id']),
            'external_event_id': identifier(row['external_event_id']), 'event_type': row['event_type'],
            'occurred_at': utc_timestamp(row['occurred_at']), 'service': row['service'],
            'product_id': identifier(row['product_id'], optional=True), 'currency': row['currency'],
            'amount_minor': money_minor(row['amount_decimal'], row['currency']), 'campaign_id': campaign,
            'attribution_method': method, 'attribution_reference': reference}


def validate_spend(row, campaigns=None):
    if set(row) != set(SPEND_FIELDS) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in row.values()):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_columns')
    campaign = identifier(row['campaign_id'])
    if campaign not in (campaign_ids() if campaigns is None else campaigns):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('unregistered_campaign')
    if row['platform'] not in {'google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'other'}:
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_platform')
    try:
        day = date.fromisoformat(row['spend_date'])
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError
        ZoneInfo(row['source_timezone'])
    except (ValueError, TypeError, ZoneInfoNotFoundError):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_date_or_timezone') from None
    return {'platform': row['platform'], 'campaign_id': campaign, 'spend_date': day.isoformat(),
            'source_timezone': row['source_timezone'], 'currency': row['currency'],
            'spend_minor': money_minor(row['spend_decimal'], row['currency'], allow_zero=True)}
```

```python
"""Exact, source-scoped report calculations. No contact or transaction joins."""
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, localcontext
from backend.marketing_report_contract import validate_snapshot, CASH_VALUES, REPORT_TIMEZONE
from backend.marketing_ledger import CURRENCY_DIGITS, InvalidMarketingData


def ratio(numerator, denominator, complete=True, percent=False):
    if not complete: return {'value': None, 'reason': 'incomplete_source'}
    if numerator is None or denominator is None: return {'value': None, 'reason': 'missing_input'}
    if denominator <= 0: return {'value': None, 'reason': 'zero_denominator'}
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = max(40, len(str(numerator)) + len(str(denominator)) + 16)
        value = Decimal(numerator) / Decimal(denominator) * (100 if percent else 1)
        return {'value': format(value.quantize(Decimal('0.000001'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), 'f'), 'reason': ''}


def engagement_metrics(*, exposed_views, clicked_exposed_views, clicks, unexposed_clicks, eligible_views, section_views, complete=True):
    values = (exposed_views, clicked_exposed_views, clicks, unexposed_clicks, eligible_views, section_views)
    if any(value is not None and (type(value) is not int or value < 0) for value in values):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_engagement_counts')
    if (clicked_exposed_views is not None and exposed_views is not None and clicked_exposed_views > exposed_views
            or section_views is not None and eligible_views is not None and section_views > eligible_views
            or clicks is not None and clicked_exposed_views is not None and clicked_exposed_views > clicks
            or clicks is not None and unexposed_clicks is not None and unexposed_clicks > clicks):
        raise InvalidMarketingData('inconsistent_engagement_counts')
    return {'cta_ctr_percent': ratio(clicked_exposed_views, exposed_views, complete, True),
            'click_frequency': ratio(clicks, exposed_views, complete),
            'section_reach_percent': ratio(section_views, eligible_views, complete, True),
            'unexposed_clicks': unexposed_clicks}


def funnel_metrics(row, complete=True):
    result = {
        'user_conversion_percent': ratio(row['lead_users'], row['eligible_users'], complete, True),
        'session_conversion_percent': ratio(row['lead_sessions'], row['sessions'], complete, True),
        'send_error_percent': ratio(row['failed_sends'], row['send_attempts'], complete, True),
        'chat_contact_percent': ratio(row['chat_lead_users'], row['chat_open_users'], complete, True),
    }
    completed = ratio(row['form_completers'], row['form_starters'], complete, True)
    result['observed_abandonment_percent'] = {**completed, 'value': format(Decimal(100) - Decimal(completed['value']), '.6f') if completed['value'] is not None else None}
    return result


def amount_decimal(minor, currency):
    if minor is None: return None
    digits = CURRENCY_DIGITS[currency]
    sign = '-' if minor < 0 else ''
    units, fraction = divmod(abs(minor), 10 ** digits)
    return f'{sign}{units}' + (f'.{fraction:0{digits}d}' if digits else '')


def build_report(snapshot, campaigns=None):
    validate_snapshot(snapshot, campaigns)
    sources, period = snapshot['sources'], snapshot['period']
    ledger_complete = sources['ledger']['state'] == 'complete'
    analytics_complete = sources['analytics']['state'] == 'complete'
    rows = {'revenue': [], 'campaigns': [], 'funnel': [], 'quality': [], 'cohorts': []}
    common = {'period_start': period['start'], 'period_end': period['end'], 'report_timezone': REPORT_TIMEZONE, 'as_of': snapshot['as_of']}
    for entry in snapshot['cash']:
        adjusted = entry['sales_minor'] - entry['refunds_minor'] - entry['chargebacks_minor']
        record = {**common, **entry, 'source': 'ledger', 'source_state': sources['ledger']['state'],
                  'observed_adjusted_minor': adjusted, 'confirmed_adjusted_minor': adjusted if ledger_complete else None,
                  'after_costs_minor': adjusted - entry['fees_minor'] - entry['taxes_minor'] if ledger_complete and snapshot['cost_components_complete'] else None,
                  'after_costs_reason': '' if ledger_complete and snapshot['cost_components_complete'] else 'cost_coverage_unconfirmed'}
        for key in ('sales_minor', 'refunds_minor', 'chargebacks_minor', 'fees_minor', 'taxes_minor', 'observed_adjusted_minor', 'confirmed_adjusted_minor', 'after_costs_minor'):
            record[key.replace('_minor', '_amount')] = amount_decimal(record[key], entry['currency'])
        ticket = ratio(entry['sales_minor'], entry['sales_count'], ledger_complete)
        record.update(ticket_mean_minor=ticket['value'], ticket_mean_reason=ticket['reason'])
        rows['revenue'].append(record)

    # Aggregate money and spend independently to campaign+currency BEFORE combining.
    money = defaultdict(lambda: {key: 0 for key in CASH_VALUES})
    methods = defaultdict(lambda: {'provider_campaign_sales_minor': 0, 'documented_manual_sales_minor': 0})
    unknown = defaultdict(lambda: {'sales_minor': 0, 'sales_count': 0, 'known_minor': 0, 'unknown_count': 0, 'unknown_minor': 0})
    for entry in snapshot['cash']:
        key = (entry['campaign_id'], entry['currency'])
        for field in CASH_VALUES: money[key][field] += entry[field]
        unknown[entry['currency']]['sales_minor'] += entry['sales_minor']
        unknown[entry['currency']]['sales_count'] += entry['sales_count']
        if entry['campaign_id'] is None:
            unknown[entry['currency']]['unknown_count'] += entry['sales_count']
            unknown[entry['currency']]['unknown_minor'] += entry['sales_minor']
        else:
            unknown[entry['currency']]['known_minor'] += entry['sales_minor']
            methods[key][entry['attribution_method'] + '_sales_minor'] += entry['sales_minor']
    spend = defaultdict(lambda: {'total': 0, 'days': set(), 'timezones': set()})
    for entry in snapshot['spend']:
        key = (entry['campaign_id'], entry['currency'])
        spend[key]['total'] += entry['spend_minor']
        spend[key]['days'].add(entry['date']); spend[key]['timezones'].add(entry['source_timezone'])
    day = date.fromisoformat(period['start'])
    required_days = set()
    while day.isoformat() <= period['end']:
        required_days.add(day.isoformat()); day += timedelta(days=1)
    campaign_analytics = {entry['campaign_id']: entry for entry in snapshot['analytics'] if entry['scope'] == 'campaign'}
    for key in sorted(set(money) | set(spend), key=lambda item: (item[0] or '', item[1])):
        campaign, currency = key
        amounts = money[key]
        ad = spend[key]
        comparable = ad['timezones'] == {REPORT_TIMEZONE}
        spend_complete = sources['spend']['state'] == 'complete' and ad['days'] == required_days and comparable
        # No spending on file is unknown, even if another campaign has records.
        paid = ad['total'] if spend_complete else None
        adjusted = amounts['sales_minor'] - amounts['refunds_minor'] - amounts['chargebacks_minor']
        record = {**common, 'campaign_id': campaign, 'currency': currency, 'source': 'ledger+spend',
                  'sales_count': amounts['sales_count'], 'observed_sales_minor': amounts['sales_minor'],
                  'observed_adjusted_minor': adjusted, 'observed_spend_minor': ad['total'] if key in spend and ad['days'] else None,
                  'confirmed_spend_minor': paid, **methods[key],
                  'spend_source_timezone': '|'.join(sorted(ad['timezones'])) or None,
                  'spend_reason': '' if spend_complete else 'timezone_mismatch' if ad['timezones'] and not comparable else 'incomplete_spend',
                  'unattributed_sales_count': amounts['sales_count'] if campaign is None else 0}
        comparable_money = ledger_complete and spend_complete and campaign is not None
        for name, value in (('roas_gross', amounts['sales_minor']), ('roas_adjusted', adjusted)):
            metric = ratio(value, paid, comparable_money)
            record[name], record[name + '_reason'] = metric['value'], metric['reason']
        cost = ratio(paid, amounts['sales_count'], comparable_money)
        record['cost_per_payment_minor'], record['cost_per_payment_reason'] = cost['value'], cost['reason']
        observed = campaign_analytics.get(campaign)
        record['observed_leads'] = observed['observed_leads'] if observed and analytics_complete else None
        cpl = ratio(paid, observed['observed_leads'] if observed else None, spend_complete and analytics_complete and observed is not None)
        record['cost_per_observed_lead_minor'], record['cost_per_observed_lead_reason'] = cpl['value'], cpl['reason']
        record['observed_sales_amount'] = amount_decimal(amounts['sales_minor'], currency)
        record['observed_adjusted_amount'] = amount_decimal(adjusted, currency)
        record['confirmed_spend_amount'] = amount_decimal(paid, currency)
        rows['campaigns'].append(record)

    for entry in snapshot['interests']:
        rows['funnel'].append({**common, 'source': 'interests', 'scope': 'persisted_records', 'date': entry['date'],
                               'service': entry['service'], 'lead_source': entry['source'], 'metric': 'persisted_records',
                               'numerator': entry['count'], 'denominator': None, 'observed_value': entry['count'],
                               'value': entry['count'] if sources['interests']['state'] == 'complete' else None,
                               'reason': '' if sources['interests']['state'] == 'complete' else 'incomplete_source'})
    for entry in snapshot['analytics']:
        # These are exact whole-period source segments. Do not sum distinct users
        # across days, forms or campaigns, and do not join them to transactions.
        context = {**common, 'source': 'analytics', 'scope': entry['scope'], 'campaign_id': entry['campaign_id'], 'form_kind': entry['form_kind'], 'funnel_window_days': entry['funnel_window_days']}
        for field in ('sessions', 'eligible_users', 'observed_leads', 'send_attempts', 'retries'):
            rows['funnel'].append({**context, 'metric': field, 'observed_value': entry[field], 'value': entry[field] if analytics_complete else None, 'reason': '' if analytics_complete and entry[field] is not None else 'incomplete_source' if not analytics_complete else 'missing_input'})
        denominators = {'user_conversion_percent': ('lead_users','eligible_users'), 'session_conversion_percent': ('lead_sessions','sessions'),
                        'send_error_percent': ('failed_sends','send_attempts'), 'chat_contact_percent': ('chat_lead_users','chat_open_users'),
                        'observed_abandonment_percent': ('form_completers','form_starters')}
        for name, metric in funnel_metrics(entry, analytics_complete).items():
            numerator, denominator = denominators[name]
            rows['funnel'].append({**context, 'metric': name, 'numerator': entry[numerator], 'denominator': entry[denominator], **metric})
    for entry in snapshot['search']:
        metric = ratio(entry['clicks'], entry['impressions'], sources['search']['state'] == 'complete', True)
        rows['funnel'].append({**common, 'source': 'search', 'scope': 'search_page_day', 'date': entry['date'], 'page_path': entry['page_path'],
                               'source_timezone': entry['source_timezone'], 'metric': 'organic_ctr_percent',
                               'numerator': entry['clicks'], 'denominator': entry['impressions'], **metric})
    as_of = datetime.fromisoformat(snapshot['as_of'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    for source, state in sources.items():
        observed_rows = len(snapshot['cash' if source == 'ledger' else source])
        updated = state['updated_at']
        age = int((as_of - datetime.fromisoformat(updated.replace('Z', '+00:00'))).total_seconds()) if updated else None
        rows['quality'].append({**common, 'source': source, 'metric': 'source_coverage', 'state': state['state'],
                                'sample_size': observed_rows, 'updated_at': updated, 'data_age_seconds': age,
                                'value': None, 'reason': 'no_data' if not observed_rows else '' if state['state'] == 'complete' else 'incomplete_source'})
    for currency, data in sorted(unknown.items()):
        coverage = ratio(data['known_minor'], data['sales_minor'], ledger_complete, True)
        rows['quality'].append({**common, 'source': 'ledger', 'currency': currency, 'metric': 'gross_attribution_coverage_percent',
                                'sample_size': data['sales_count'], 'unknown_sales_count': data['unknown_count'], 'unknown_sales_minor': data['unknown_minor'], **coverage})
    for name, reason in (('traffic_coverage', 'consented_traffic_only_total_unknown'), ('acquisition_cohorts', 'acquisition_date_unavailable'),
                         ('hotmart_webhook', 'deferred_by_owner'), ('roi', 'missing_costs'), ('cac', 'new_customer_identity_unavailable'), ('ltv', 'recurrence_window_unavailable')):
        rows['quality'].append({**common, 'source': 'contract', 'metric': name, 'value': None, 'reason': reason})
    return {'schema_version': 1, 'period': period, 'as_of': snapshot['as_of'], 'datasets': rows}
```

```python
"""Closed aggregate-only input contract for offline and server reports."""
import copy
from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from backend.marketing_ledger import InvalidMarketingData, campaign_ids, utc_timestamp, SERVICES, PROVIDERS, CURRENCY_DIGITS

REPORT_TIMEZONE = 'America/Santiago'
SOURCES = ('ledger', 'spend', 'interests', 'analytics', 'search')
STATES = ('missing', 'partial', 'complete')
CASH_VALUES = ('sales_count', 'sales_minor', 'refunds_minor', 'chargebacks_minor', 'fees_minor', 'taxes_minor')
CASH_KEYS = ('date', 'provider', 'service', 'currency', 'campaign_id', 'attribution_method')
ANALYTICS_COUNTS = ('sessions', 'eligible_users', 'lead_users', 'lead_sessions', 'observed_leads',
                    'form_starters', 'form_completers', 'send_attempts', 'retries', 'failed_sends',
                    'chat_open_users', 'chat_lead_users')
PUBLIC_PATHS = ('/', '/consulta', '/terapias', '/cursos', '/naturaleza', '/sobre-mi')


def invalid(code='invalid_report_snapshot'):
    raise InvalidMarketingData(code)


def report_period(start, end):
    try:
        first, last = date.fromisoformat(start), date.fromisoformat(end)
        if first.isoformat() != start or last.isoformat() != end or not 0 <= (last - first).days < 366:
            invalid('invalid_report_period')
        zone = ZoneInfo(REPORT_TIMEZONE)
        return first, last, datetime.combine(first, time.min, zone).astimezone(timezone.utc), datetime.combine(last + timedelta(days=1), time.min, zone).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        invalid('invalid_report_period')


def fields(value, expected):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != set(expected): invalid()


def count(value, optional=False):
    if optional and value is None: return
    if type(value) is not int or value < 0: invalid()


def validate_snapshot(snapshot, campaigns=None):
    fields(snapshot, ('schema_version', 'period', 'as_of', 'sources', 'cost_components_complete', 'cash', 'spend', 'interests', 'analytics', 'search'))
    if type(snapshot['schema_version']) is not int or snapshot['schema_version'] != 1 or type(snapshot['cost_components_complete']) is not bool: invalid()
    fields(snapshot['period'], ('start', 'end', 'timezone'))
    period = snapshot['period']
    report_period(period['start'], period['end'])
    if period['timezone'] != REPORT_TIMEZONE: invalid()
    as_of = datetime.fromisoformat(utc_timestamp(snapshot['as_of']))
    fields(snapshot['sources'], SOURCES)
    for source in snapshot['sources'].values():
        fields(source, ('state', 'updated_at'))
        if source['state'] not in STATES: invalid()
        if source['updated_at'] is not None and datetime.fromisoformat(utc_timestamp(source['updated_at'])) > as_of: invalid()
    known = campaign_ids() if campaigns is None else campaigns

    for name in ('cash', 'spend', 'interests', 'analytics', 'search'):
        rows = snapshot[name]
        if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) > 10000: invalid()
        source_name = 'ledger' if name == 'cash' else name
        if rows and snapshot['sources'][source_name]['state'] == 'missing': invalid()
        identities = set()
        for row in rows:
            if name == 'cash':
                fields(row, CASH_KEYS + CASH_VALUES)
                if row['provider'] not in PROVIDERS or row['service'] not in SERVICES or row['currency'] not in CURRENCY_DIGITS: invalid()
                if row['attribution_method'] not in ('unknown', 'documented_manual', 'provider_campaign'): invalid()
                if (row['attribution_method'] == 'unknown') != (row['campaign_id'] is None): invalid()
                for key in CASH_VALUES: count(row[key])
                if (row['sales_count'] == 0) != (row['sales_minor'] == 0): invalid()
                identity = tuple(row[key] for key in CASH_KEYS)
            elif name == 'spend':
                fields(row, ('date', 'platform', 'campaign_id', 'currency', 'source_timezone', 'spend_minor'))
                if row['currency'] not in CURRENCY_DIGITS or row['platform'] not in ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'other'): invalid()
                try: ZoneInfo(row['source_timezone'])
                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError): invalid()
                count(row['spend_minor'])
                identity = (row['date'], row['platform'], row['campaign_id'], row['currency'])
            elif name == 'interests':
                fields(row, ('date', 'service', 'source', 'count'))
                if row['service'] not in SERVICES or row['source'] not in ('form', 'chatbot'): invalid()
                count(row['count'])
                identity = (row['date'], row['service'], row['source'])
            elif name == 'analytics':
                fields(row, ('scope', 'campaign_id', 'form_kind', 'funnel_window_days') + ANALYTICS_COUNTS)
                if row['scope'] not in ('site', 'campaign', 'form'): invalid()
                if (row['scope'] == 'campaign') != (row['campaign_id'] is not None): invalid()
                if (row['scope'] == 'form') != (row['form_kind'] is not None): invalid()
                if row['form_kind'] is not None and row['form_kind'] not in ('consultation', 'nature', 'online', 'chat_contact'): invalid()
                for key in ANALYTICS_COUNTS: count(row[key], optional=True)
                if row['funnel_window_days'] is not None and (type(row['funnel_window_days']) is not int or not 1 <= row['funnel_window_days'] <= 366): invalid()
                if (row['form_starters'] is not None or row['form_completers'] is not None) and row['funnel_window_days'] is None: invalid()
                for numerator, denominator in (('lead_users', 'eligible_users'), ('lead_sessions', 'sessions'), ('form_completers', 'form_starters'), ('failed_sends', 'send_attempts'), ('chat_lead_users', 'chat_open_users')):
                    if row[numerator] is not None and row[denominator] is not None and row[numerator] > row[denominator]: invalid()
                identity = (row['scope'], row['campaign_id'], row['form_kind'])
            else:
                fields(row, ('date', 'page_path', 'source_timezone', 'impressions', 'clicks'))
                if row['page_path'] not in PUBLIC_PATHS: invalid()
                try: ZoneInfo(row['source_timezone'])
                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError): invalid()
                count(row['impressions']); count(row['clicks'])
                if row['clicks'] > row['impressions']: invalid()
                identity = (row['date'], row['page_path'], row['source_timezone'])
            if 'date' in row:
                day = row['date']
                if date.fromisoformat(day).isoformat() != day or not period['start'] <= day <= period['end']: invalid()
            if row.get('campaign_id') is not None and row['campaign_id'] not in known: invalid('unregistered_report_campaign')
            if identity in identities: invalid('duplicate_report_aggregate')
            identities.add(identity)
    return snapshot


def apply_coverage(snapshot, coverage):
    """An operator's explicit, period-scoped reconciliation; never inferred."""
    fields(coverage, ('period', 'ledger_complete', 'spend_complete', 'cost_components_complete'))
    if coverage['period'] != snapshot['period'] or any(type(coverage[key]) is not bool for key in ('ledger_complete','spend_complete','cost_components_complete')):
        invalid('invalid_coverage_attestation')
    result = copy.deepcopy(snapshot)
    for source in ('ledger','spend'):
        if coverage[source + '_complete']: result['sources'][source]['state'] = 'complete'
    result['cost_components_complete'] = coverage['cost_components_complete']
    return result
```

```python
"""Turn normalized M11 records into anonymous daily aggregates for reconciliation."""
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from backend.marketing_report_contract import report_period, CASH_VALUES, CASH_KEYS, REPORT_TIMEZONE
from backend.marketing_ledger import InvalidMarketingData


def aggregate_movements(movements, start, end):
    _, _, lower, upper = report_period(start, end)
    grouped = defaultdict(lambda: dict.fromkeys(CASH_VALUES, 0))
    seen_events, sales, transactions = {}, {}, {}
    columns = {'sale': 'sales_minor', 'refund': 'refunds_minor', 'chargeback': 'chargebacks_minor', 'fee': 'fees_minor', 'tax': 'taxes_minor'}
    for row in movements:
        event_key = (row['provider'], row['external_event_id'])
        if event_key in seen_events:
            if seen_events[event_key] != row: raise InvalidMarketingData('conflicting_report_event')
            continue
        seen_events[event_key] = row
        tx_key = (row['provider'], row['external_transaction_id'])
        tx = tuple(row[key] for key in ('service', 'currency', 'campaign_id', 'attribution_method', 'product_id', 'attribution_reference'))
        if tx_key in transactions and transactions[tx_key] != tx: raise InvalidMarketingData('conflicting_report_transaction')
        transactions[tx_key] = tx
        if row['event_type'] == 'sale':
            if tx_key in sales:
                if sales[tx_key] != row['amount_minor']: raise InvalidMarketingData('conflicting_report_sale')
                continue
            sales[tx_key] = row['amount_minor']
        instant = datetime.fromisoformat(row['occurred_at'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        if not lower <= instant < upper: continue
        key = (instant.astimezone(ZoneInfo(REPORT_TIMEZONE)).date().isoformat(), *(row[field] for field in CASH_KEYS[1:]))
        group = grouped[key]
        group[columns[row['event_type']]] += row['amount_minor']
        if row['event_type'] == 'sale': group['sales_count'] += 1
    return [{**dict(zip(CASH_KEYS, key)), **value} for key, value in sorted(grouped.items(), key=lambda item: str(item[0]))]
```

```python
"""Atomic private CSV export. Only validated, aggregate report fields reach disk."""
import csv
import io
import json
import re
import os
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4
from backend.marketing_ledger import InvalidMarketingData

COMMON = ('period_start', 'period_end', 'report_timezone', 'as_of')
COLUMNS = {
    'revenue': COMMON + ('date', 'provider', 'service', 'currency', 'campaign_id', 'attribution_method', 'source', 'source_state',
        'sales_count', 'sales_minor', 'sales_amount', 'refunds_minor', 'refunds_amount', 'chargebacks_minor', 'chargebacks_amount',
        'fees_minor', 'fees_amount', 'taxes_minor', 'taxes_amount', 'observed_adjusted_minor', 'observed_adjusted_amount',
        'confirmed_adjusted_minor', 'confirmed_adjusted_amount', 'after_costs_minor', 'after_costs_amount', 'after_costs_reason',
        'ticket_mean_minor', 'ticket_mean_reason'),
    'campaigns': COMMON + ('campaign_id', 'currency', 'source', 'sales_count', 'observed_sales_minor', 'observed_sales_amount',
        'observed_adjusted_minor', 'observed_adjusted_amount', 'observed_spend_minor', 'confirmed_spend_minor', 'confirmed_spend_amount',
        'provider_campaign_sales_minor', 'documented_manual_sales_minor', 'unattributed_sales_count', 'spend_source_timezone', 'spend_reason',
        'roas_gross', 'roas_gross_reason', 'roas_adjusted', 'roas_adjusted_reason', 'cost_per_payment_minor', 'cost_per_payment_reason',
        'observed_leads', 'cost_per_observed_lead_minor', 'cost_per_observed_lead_reason'),
    'funnel': COMMON + ('source', 'scope', 'date', 'service', 'lead_source', 'campaign_id', 'form_kind', 'page_path', 'source_timezone',
        'funnel_window_days', 'metric', 'numerator', 'denominator', 'observed_value', 'value', 'reason'),
    'quality': COMMON + ('source', 'metric', 'state', 'currency', 'sample_size', 'unknown_sales_count', 'unknown_sales_minor',
        'updated_at', 'data_age_seconds', 'value', 'reason'),
    'cohorts': COMMON + ('cohort_date', 'currency', 'metric', 'value', 'reason'),
}


def safe_cell(value):
    if value is None: return 'N/D'
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)): return str(value)
    text = str(value)
    if re.fullmatch(r'-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?', text): return text
    # Includes leading whitespace, CR/TAB and full-width formula characters.
    if text.lstrip().startswith(('=', '+', '-', '@', '\t', '\r', '\n', '＝', '＋', '－', '＠')) or text.startswith(('\t', '\r', '\n')):
        return "'" + text
    return text


def dataset_csv(name, rows):
    output = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.writer(output, lineterminator='\n')
    columns = COLUMNS[name]
    writer.writerow(columns)
    for row in rows:
        if set(row) - set(columns): raise InvalidMarketingData('unexpected_export_field')
        writer.writerow([safe_cell(row.get(field)) for field in columns])
    return output.getvalue()


def export_report(report, destination):
    destination = Path(destination)
    if destination.exists(): raise InvalidMarketingData('report_destination_exists')
    if set(report['datasets']) != set(COLUMNS): raise InvalidMarketingData('invalid_report_datasets')
    # Finish formatting before creating anything. A failed validation cannot leave
    # a half-updated report that a reader mistakes for a complete export.
    files = {name + '.csv': dataset_csv(name, rows) for name, rows in report['datasets'].items()}
    manifest = {key: report[key] for key in ('schema_version', 'period', 'as_of')}
    manifest['datasets'] = {name: {'rows': len(rows), 'file': name + '.csv'} for name, rows in report['datasets'].items()}
    manifest['limitations'] = ['hotmart_webhook_deferred', 'consented_traffic_only_total_unknown', 'acquisition_cohorts_unavailable']
    files['manifest.json'] = json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Python 3.13 implements mode=0700 as an owner-only Windows ACL. A staging
    # directory with that ACL retains it on rename and can lock out the user's
    # ordinary process. On Windows inherit the destination parent's ACL instead.
    prepared = destination.parent / ('.marketing-report-' + uuid4().hex)
    prepared.mkdir(mode=0o777 if os.name == 'nt' else 0o700)
    try:
        for name, content in files.items():
            target = prepared / name
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
            if os.name != 'nt': target.chmod(0o600)
        if destination.exists(): raise InvalidMarketingData('report_destination_exists')
        prepared.rename(destination)
    finally:
        if prepared.exists():
            # Remove only the exact files this export owns; never recursively
            # delete an unexpected file or an existing destination directory.
            for name in files:
                (prepared / name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            prepared.rmdir()
    return manifest
```

```python
"""Server-only provider settings; no browser request may override these."""
import os


def output_token_limit():
    value = int(os.environ.get('OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS', '512'))
    if not 64 <= value <= 25000:
        raise ValueError('Invalid output token limit')

def request_timeout():
```

```python
"""Versioned selector contract and approved copy, shared by server consumers."""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config" / "chatbot"


def load_config(root=ROOT):
    config = json.loads((root / "setter.config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    copy = json.loads((root / config["files"]["responses"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    schema = config["structured_output"]["schema"]
    templates = copy["model_response_templates"]
    if set(schema["properties"]["response_key"]["enum"]) != set(templates) or set(config["decisions"]) != set(templates):
        raise ValueError("Selector catalog mismatch")
    if config["policy"]["reveal_delay_ms"] != 800:
        raise ValueError("The base delay must be 800 ms")
    for decision in config["decisions"].values():
        if not set(decision["actions"]) <= set(config["catalog"]["actions"]):
            raise ValueError("Unknown action")
    prompts = "\n\n".join((root / config["files"][key]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                            for key in ("system_prompt", "developer_prompt"))
    return config, copy, prompts


CONFIG, COPY, INSTRUCTIONS = load_config()
POLICY = CONFIG["policy"]
RESPONSES = COPY["model_response_templates"]
KNOWLEDGE = json.loads((ROOT / 'knowledge.es.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['facts']


def validate_decision(value, context, require_reply=False):
    fields = {"topic", "response_key", "action", "contact_signal"}
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) not in (fields, fields | {'reply'}):
        raise ValueError("Invalid decision")
    if require_reply and 'reply' not in value:
        raise ValueError('Missing conversational reply')
    if 'reply' in value:
        reply = value['reply']
        if not isinstance(reply, str) or not 1 <= len(reply.strip()) <= 700 or re.search(r'https?://|www\.|\]\(|[<>]|[\x00-\x08]', reply, re.I):
            raise ValueError('Invalid conversational reply')
    for field, prop in CONFIG["structured_output"]["schema"]["properties"].items():
        if field == 'reply':
            continue
        if value[field] not in prop["enum"]:
            raise ValueError("Unknown decision value")
    allowed = CONFIG["decisions"][value["response_key"]]
    if value["topic"] not in allowed["topics"] or value["action"] not in allowed["actions"]:
        raise ValueError("Invalid decision combination")
    if value["response_key"] not in context["allowed_response_keys"] or value["action"] not in context["allowed_actions"]:
        raise ValueError("Action not allowed")
    contact = value["action"] in ("offer_contact", "start_contact_capture")
    if contact and (value["contact_signal"] == "declined" or
                    (context.get("contact_declined") and value["contact_signal"] != "requested")):
        raise ValueError("Contact was declined")
    if value["action"] == "start_contact_capture" and value["contact_signal"] != "requested":
        raise ValueError("Capture requires an explicit request")
    return value
```

```python
"""Opt-in feedback and bounded, reviewed examples; never trains on raw chat."""
from uuid import UUID

from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable, rpc


def approved_examples():
    try:
        result = rpc('setter_learning_examples', {})
        examples = result.get('examples', [])
        return examples[:8] if isinstance(examples, list) else []
    except StoreUnavailable:
        return []


def save_feedback(payload, visitor):
    if not visitor:
        return 401, {'status': 'session_required'}
    fields = {'id', 'conversation_id', 'request_id', 'category', 'question', 'suggestion', 'comment', 'consent'}
    try:
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != fields or payload['consent'] is not True:
            raise ValueError()
        if payload['category'] not in ('irrelevant', 'missing', 'unnatural', 'incorrect'):
            raise ValueError()
        values = {key: str(UUID(payload[key])) for key in ('id', 'conversation_id', 'request_id')}
        for key, minimum, maximum in (('question', 5, 500), ('suggestion', 10, 1000), ('comment', 0, 500)):
            value = payload[key]
            if not isinstance(value, str) or not minimum <= len(value.strip()) <= maximum:
                raise ValueError()
            values[key] = value.strip()
        result = rpc('setter_feedback_save', {'p_visitor': visitor, 'p_values': {
            **values, 'category': payload['category'], 'consent': True}})
        status = result.get('status')
        return {'saved': 201, 'rate_limited': 429, 'not_found': 404, 'conflict': 409, 'invalid': 400}.get(status, 503), result
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        return 400, {'status': 'invalid'}
    except StoreUnavailable:
        return 503, {'status': 'storage_unavailable'}
```

```python
"""Bounded relative paths only: never store query strings or URL fragments."""
import re


def source_path(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'/[A-Za-z0-9/_-]{0,119}', value) or '//' in value:
        raise ValueError('Invalid source path')
    return value.rstrip('/') or '/'
```

```python
"""Real HTTP pipeline exercise, cost accounting and reproducible Markdown reports.

No provider mocks, no direct calls to Responses, no changes to project-wide model
settings. Each entry point can deploy its own Preview and has its own cookie jar.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from uuid import uuid4
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = ROOT / 'chatbot testing'
PRIVATE = ROOT / '.preview' / 'chatbot-testing'
PROJECT = 'prj_9NLR5XePMoPl4dVGO06bZHQ0r5jq'
TEAM = 'team_wpjRCdTWmM7mt6hz8P5oOwtr'
PROMPTS = [
    'Hola, quiero información sobre el curso Flores de Bach para la vida cotidiana.',
    '¿Qué propuesta tiene ese curso? Busco información general para aprender.',
    '¿La futura modalidad online ya está abierta?',
    'Prefiero volver al curso actual. ¿Dónde puedo revisar su precio y condiciones?',
    '¿Puedes mostrarme el enlace para inscribirme al curso actual?',
    'No quiero dejar mis datos por ahora, solo seguir leyendo información del curso.',
    'Gracias. ¿También puedo encontrar información sobre las terapias en la web?',
    'Me interesa una primera consulta individual. ¿Cómo comienza?',
    '¿Puedes confirmar cuánto dura y qué disponibilidad hay para la consulta? Si no está publicado, no lo inventes.',
    'Quiero que el equipo me contacte por una consulta individual.',
]
WELCOME = {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Hola, puedo orientarte sobre consultas, terapias, cursos y actividades en la naturaleza. ¿Qué estás buscando?'}


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')


def safe_error(text):
    return re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}', '[redacted]', text)[-1400:]


def deploy(effort, evidence):
    command = [shutil.which('vercel.cmd') or 'vercel', 'deploy', '--yes', '--target', 'preview',
        '--project', PROJECT, '--scope', TEAM]
    overrides = {'OPENAI_MODEL': 'gpt-6-luna', 'OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT': effort,
        'OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS': '25000', 'OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS': '25', 'CHAT_TEST_METRICS': '1',
        'CHAT_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION': '0.10', 'CHAT_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION': '0.50',
        'CHAT_DAILY_BUDGET_MICRO_USD': '3000000'}
    for key, value in overrides.items():
        command.extend(['--env', f'{key}={value}'])
    print(f'Deploying isolated Preview for Luna {effort}...', flush=True)
    completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=300, cwd=ROOT)
    if completed.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Preview deployment failed: ' + safe_error(completed.stderr))
    url = None
    for match in re.finditer(r'\{', completed.stdout):
        try:
            value, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(completed.stdout[match.start():])
            if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get('deployment'), dict):
                url = value['deployment'].get('url')
                if url:
                    dump(evidence / 'deployment.json', {'deployment': value['deployment'], 'overrides': overrides})
                    break
        except ValueError:
            continue
    if not url:
        urls = re.findall(r'https://nicolaszamara-[a-z0-9-]+\.vercel\.app', completed.stdout)
        if urls:
            url = urls[-1]
            dump(evidence / 'deployment.json', {'url': url, 'overrides': overrides})
    if not url:
        raise RuntimeError('No Preview URL returned by Vercel')
    print(f'Preview ready: {url}', flush=True)
    return url


class Pipeline:
    def __init__(self, deployment, case, run_id):
        self.deployment = deployment
        self.private = PRIVATE / f'test-{case}-{run_id}'
        self.private.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.jar = self.private / 'session.cookies'
        self.sequence = 0

    def request(self, path='/api/chat', payload=None):
        self.sequence += 1
        command = [shutil.which('vercel.cmd') or 'vercel', 'curl', path, '--deployment', self.deployment,
            '--scope', TEAM, '--yes', '--', '--silent', '--show-error', '--max-time', '70',
            '--cookie', str(self.jar), '--cookie-jar', str(self.jar), '--write-out', 'HTTP_CODE:%{http_code}']
        if payload is not None:
            body_path = self.private / f'{self.sequence}.request.json'
            dump(body_path, payload)
            command.extend(['--request', 'POST', '--header', 'Content-Type: application/json',
                            '--data-binary', '@' + str(body_path)])
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=100, cwd=ROOT)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return {'http_status': None, 'body': {'status': 'transport_timeout'}, 'duration_ms': round((time.perf_counter()-started)*1000, 2)}
        duration = round((time.perf_counter()-started)*1000, 2)
        if completed.returncode:
            return {'http_status': None, 'body': {'status': 'transport_error', 'cli_exit': completed.returncode}, 'duration_ms': duration}
        parsed = parse_http_output(completed.stdout)
        return {**parsed, 'duration_ms': duration}


def parse_http_output(raw):
    # curl emits UTF-8 JSON. Windows' locale is not necessarily UTF-8: decoding
    # with that locale corrupts accents and changes the next round's context.
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    body, separator, status = text.strip().rpartition('HTTP_CODE:')
    try:
        value = json.loads(body) if separator else {'status': 'invalid_transport_output'}
    except ValueError:
        value = {'status': 'non_json_response'}
    return {'http_status': int(status) if status.isdigit() else None, 'body': value}


def calculate_cost(usage, sources):
    if usage.get('service_tier') not in (None, 'default', 'standard'):
        return None
    if not all(type(usage.get(field)) is int for field in ('input_tokens', 'output_tokens', 'total_tokens')):
        return None
    details = usage.get('input_tokens_details', {})
    cached = details.get('cached_tokens')
    if type(cached) is not int:
        return None
    writes = details.get('cache_write_tokens', details.get('cache_creation_tokens', 0))
    if type(writes) is not int or not 0 <= cached + writes <= usage['input_tokens']:
        return None
    prices = sources['pricing']
    amount = (Decimal(usage['input_tokens'] - cached - writes) * Decimal(prices['usd_per_million_input'])
        + Decimal(cached) * Decimal(prices['usd_per_million_cached_input'])
        + Decimal(writes) * Decimal(prices['usd_per_million_cache_write'])
        + Decimal(usage['output_tokens']) * Decimal(prices['usd_per_million_output'])) / Decimal(1000000)
    return {'usd': str(amount), 'clp': str(amount * Decimal(sources['fx']['clp_per_usd']))}


def fmt(value, digits=9):
    return 'N/D' if value is None else f'{Decimal(str(value)):.{digits}f}'


def write_report(record, sources, path):
    rounds = record['rounds']
    attempts = rounds + record.get('extra_attempts', [])
    known = [row for row in attempts if row.get('cost')]
    measured_usd = sum((Decimal(row['cost']['usd']) for row in known), Decimal(0))
    measured_clp = measured_usd * Decimal(sources['fx']['clp_per_usd'])
    total_known = len(known) == len(attempts) and len(rounds) == 10
    tokens = {key: sum(row.get('usage', {}).get(key, 0) for row in attempts) for key in ('input_tokens', 'output_tokens', 'total_tokens')}
    reasoning = sum(row.get('usage', {}).get('output_tokens_details', {}).get('reasoning_tokens', 0) for row in attempts)
    cached = sum(row.get('usage', {}).get('input_tokens_details', {}).get('cached_tokens', 0) for row in attempts)
    written = sum(row.get('usage', {}).get('input_tokens_details', {}).get('cache_write_tokens', 0) for row in attempts)
    lines = [f"# Flujo de conversación test {record['case']} — {record['date']}", '',
        f"Modelo solicitado: **gpt-6-luna**, esfuerzo **{record['effort']}**.",
        f"Estado: **{record['status']}**. Inicio UTC: `{record['started_at']}`.",
        f"Preview aislado: {record.get('deployment', 'no disponible')}.", '',
        '## Alcance y configuración', '',
        'Prueba E2E HTTP real del pipeline de la app: sesión/cookie → API Python → autorización atómica en Supabase → OpenAI Responses → validación → plantilla y acción → cierre. No utiliza mocks ni una llamada directa al modelo para simular el chat. No automatiza el DOM, los tooltips ni mide el tiempo de revelado de React.',
        'La solicitud explícita del usuario autoriza estas dos pruebas reales como excepción puntual a la política general de unitarias de AGENTS.md.',
        'Se usa el mismo guion de diez mensajes, una identidad independiente por caso y el mismo contrato del frontend de hasta 12 mensajes de contexto.',
        'Solo estos Previews configuran `reasoning.effort=low/high`, `max_output_tokens=25000`, plazo de OpenAI de 25 s y métricas habilitadas. El valor normal de la app sigue siendo 256 tokens, 15 s y sin cambio del modelo público. El margen mayor incluye razonamiento, evita truncarlo artificialmente y está incorporado en la reserva de presupuesto.',
        'El presupuesto global autorizado sigue siendo US$3/día. Las reservas conservadoras no son el costo facturado de los tokens.', '',
        '## Tarifas y conversión', '',
        f"Tarifas estándar por millón de tokens: entrada US${sources['pricing']['usd_per_million_input']}; entrada en caché US${sources['pricing']['usd_per_million_cached_input']}; escritura explícita de caché US${sources['pricing']['usd_per_million_cache_write']}; salida US${sources['pricing']['usd_per_million_output']}.",
        f"Fuente: [OpenAI, GPT-6 Luna]({sources['pricing']['source_url']}), consultada {sources['retrieved_date']}.",
        f"Conversión: **1 USD = {sources['fx']['clp_per_usd']} CLP**, dólar observado del {sources['fx']['date']}. [Banco Central]({sources['fx']['source_url']}).",
        'Costo USD = (entrada no cacheada × tarifa entrada + lectura caché × tarifa caché + escritura caché × tarifa escritura + salida × tarifa salida) / 1.000.000. Los tokens de razonamiento ya forman parte de salida: no se cobran dos veces.',
        'Son costos calculados a partir de usage real y tarifas publicadas, no una factura liquidada. No incluyen impuestos, comisión/tipo de cambio de tarjeta, Vercel ni Supabase. La duración incluye la CLI, autenticación/protección de Vercel y red; no es latencia pura de OpenAI.', '',
        '## Consumo por ronda', '',
        '| Ronda | HTTP / resultado | Entrada | Lectura caché | Escritura caché | Salida | Razonamiento (incluido) | Tokens totales | USD | CLP | Duración ms |',
        '| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
    for row in rounds:
        u, cost = row.get('usage', {}), row.get('cost') or {}
        extras = [item for item in record.get('extra_attempts', []) if item['step'] == row['step']]
        status = f"{row.get('http_status')} / {row.get('status')}"
        duration = row.get('duration_ms')
        if extras:
            parts = [row]+extras
            u = {key: sum(item['usage'].get(key,0) for item in parts) for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens','total_tokens')}
            u['input_tokens_details'] = {key: sum(item['usage'].get('input_tokens_details',{}).get(key,0) for item in parts) for key in ('cached_tokens','cache_write_tokens')}
            u['output_tokens_details'] = {'reasoning_tokens':sum(item['usage'].get('output_tokens_details',{}).get('reasoning_tokens',0) for item in parts)}
            cost = {key: str(sum((Decimal(item['cost'][key]) for item in parts),Decimal(0))) for key in ('usd','clp')}
            status += f" (+{len(extras)} intento fallido)"
            duration = sum(item['duration_ms'] for item in parts)
        lines.append(f"| {row['step']} | {status} | {u.get('input_tokens', 'N/D')} | {u.get('input_tokens_details', {}).get('cached_tokens', 'N/D')} | {u.get('input_tokens_details', {}).get('cache_write_tokens', 0)} | {u.get('output_tokens', 'N/D')} | {u.get('output_tokens_details', {}).get('reasoning_tokens', 'N/D')} | {u.get('total_tokens', 'N/D')} | {fmt(cost.get('usd'))} | {fmt(cost.get('clp'), 6)} | {duration} |")
    lines.extend(['', '## Total de la interacción', '',
        f"- Pasos de conversación: {len(rounds)}/10; respuestas entregadas: {sum(row.get('status') == 'completed' for row in rounds)}; intentos de proveedor contabilizados: {len(attempts)}.",
        f"- Tokens medidos: entrada **{tokens['input_tokens']}**, salida **{tokens['output_tokens']}**, total **{tokens['total_tokens']}**.",
        f"- Subconjuntos incluidos en los totales: **{reasoning}** tokens de razonamiento en salida; **{cached}** de lectura de caché y **{written}** de escritura de caché en entrada. No se suman otra vez al total.",
        f"- {'Costo total calculado' if total_known else 'Subtotal medido (total no determinable con los datos disponibles)'}: **US${fmt(measured_usd)} / CLP ${fmt(measured_clp, 6)}**.",
        f"- Intentos con usage y costo determinables: {len(known)}/{len(attempts)}. `N/D` significa no medido; no equivale a costo cero.", '',
        '## Conversación registrada', ''])
    for row in rounds:
        lines.extend([f"### Paso {row['step']}", '', f"**Visitante:** {row['prompt']}", '',
            f"**Asistente:** {row.get('reply') or '(No se entregó una respuesta)'}", '',
            f"Decisión: `{row.get('topic')}` / `{row.get('action')}`. Contadores: {row.get('completed_rounds')} respuestas, {row.get('provider_attempts')} intentos.",
            f"Modelo devuelto: `{row.get('usage', {}).get('actual_model')}`. Servicio: `{row.get('usage', {}).get('service_tier')}`.", ''])
    if record.get('incident'):
        lines.extend(['## Incidencia real y recuperación explícita', '', record['incident'], '',
            'La tabla principal agrega en la ronda 8 el intento inicial fallido y el reintento que entregó la respuesta. El intento inicial siguiente se desglosa aquí, pero **ya está incluido** en la fila 8 y en los totales; no debe sumarse de nuevo:', '',
            '| Paso / intento adicional | Estado | Entrada | Salida | Total tokens | USD | CLP |',
            '| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |'])
        for row in record.get('extra_attempts', []):
            usage, cost = row.get('usage', {}), row.get('cost') or {}
            lines.append(f"| {row['step']} / inicial | {row['status']} | {usage.get('input_tokens')} | {usage.get('output_tokens')} | {usage.get('total_tokens')} | {fmt(cost.get('usd'))} | {fmt(cost.get('clp'),6)} |")
            lines.extend(['', f"**Visitante, intento inicial del paso {row['step']}:** {row['prompt']}", '',
                          f"**Resultado:** HTTP {row.get('http_status')}, `{row['status']}`. OpenAI devolvió usage, pero no se entregó una respuesta guardada al visitante.", ''])
        for event in record.get('blocked_transport_events', []):
            lines.extend([f"**Visitante, envío bloqueado del paso {event['step']}:** {event['prompt']}", '',
                f"**Resultado:** HTTP {event.get('http_status')}, `{event['status']}`. La reserva activa bloqueó la llamada al proveedor; no se contó como ronda completada. Se conservó el evento en `before_explicit_recovery.json`.", ''])
        lines.append('Tras consultar el ID original, el servidor devolvió `uncertain` sin repetir OpenAI. El operador inició un nuevo intento explícito para el paso 8; no hubo reintento automático del proveedor. Después se completaron los pasos 9 y 10.\n')
    lines.extend(['## Comprobaciones adicionales', ''])
    for check in record.get('checks', []):
        lines.append(f"- **{check['name']}**: {'APROBADO' if check['passed'] else 'FALLÓ'} — {check.get('detail', '')}")
    if record.get('error'):
        lines.extend(['', '## Incidencia', '', record['error']])
    lines.extend(['', '## Evidencia y reproducibilidad', '',
        f"Script independiente: `scripts/test_{record['case']}_luna_{record['effort']}.py`.",
        f"Registro JSON: `evidence/test-{record['case']}-{record['run_id']}/run.json`; configuración de despliegue en el mismo directorio. Fuentes en `evidence/sources.json`.",
        'Las cookies y los archivos transitorios de transporte quedan fuera de los informes, en `.preview/chatbot-testing`. No se incluyen claves ni bypass de Vercel.',
        'Una ejecución por esfuerzo no permite afirmar superioridad estadística, igualdad de inferencia ni cubrir los 30 escenarios por consumo exigidos para estudiar coreografías de carga.', ''])
    path.write_text('\n'.join(lines), encoding='utf-8')


def run_case(case, effort):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--deployment', help='Reuse an isolated Preview configured for this effort')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    sources = json.loads((WORK / 'evidence/sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    available = json.loads((WORK / 'evidence/model_availability.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if not available.get('available'):
        raise SystemExit('Requested Luna model is unavailable; no paid request was sent.')
    run_id = str(uuid4())
    evidence = WORK / 'evidence' / f'test-{case}-{run_id}'
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    date = datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Santiago')).date().isoformat()
    report_path = WORK / f'flujo de conversación test {case} {date}.md'
    record = {'case': case, 'effort': effort, 'run_id': run_id, 'date': date,
              'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'EN CURSO', 'rounds': [], 'checks': []}

    def persist():
        dump(evidence / 'run.json', record)
        write_report(record, sources, report_path)

    def check(name, passed, detail=''):
        record['checks'].append({'name': name, 'passed': bool(passed), 'detail': detail})
        persist()

    persist()
    try:
        record['deployment'] = args.deployment or deploy(effort, evidence)
        api = Pipeline(record['deployment'], case, run_id)
        initial = api.request()
        configuration = initial['body'].get('testing_configuration', {})
        valid = initial['http_status'] == 200 and initial['body'].get('provider_enabled') and configuration.get('model') == 'gpt-6-luna' and configuration.get('reasoning_effort') == effort
        check('Sesión y configuración del esfuerzo', valid, f"HTTP {initial['http_status']}; configuración {json.dumps(configuration)}")
        if not valid:
            raise RuntimeError('The Preview did not confirm the requested model/effort; no provider request was sent.')
        conversation = initial['body']['state']['conversation_id']
        record['conversation_id'] = conversation
        messages = [dict(WELCOME)]
        last_payload = None
        for step, prompt in enumerate(PROMPTS, 1):
            messages.append({'role': 'user', 'content': prompt})
            payload = {'operation': 'send', 'conversation_id': conversation, 'request_id': str(uuid4()), 'messages': messages[-12:]}
            last_payload = payload
            response = api.request(payload=payload)
            dump(evidence / f'step-{step:02d}.response.json', response)
            body = response['body']
            decision, state = body.get('result') or {}, body.get('state') or {}
            usage = body.get('testing_usage') or {}
            row = {'step': step, 'prompt': prompt, 'request_id': payload['request_id'], 'http_status': response['http_status'],
                   'status': body.get('status'), 'duration_ms': response['duration_ms'], 'reply': decision.get('reply'),
                   'topic': decision.get('topic'), 'action': decision.get('action'),
                   'completed_rounds': state.get('completed_rounds'), 'provider_attempts': state.get('provider_attempts'),
                   'closed': state.get('closed'), 'usage': usage, 'cost': calculate_cost(usage, sources)}
            record['rounds'].append(row)
            if body.get('status') == 'completed' and decision.get('reply'):
                messages.append({'role': 'assistant', 'content': decision['reply']})
            persist()
            print(f"Test {case} / {effort} / step {step}: HTTP {response['http_status']} {body.get('status')}; tokens={usage.get('total_tokens', 'unknown')}", flush=True)
        final_state = api.request()['body'].get('state', {})
        closed = final_state.get('closed') and final_state.get('completed_rounds') == 10
        check('Diez respuestas y cierre', closed, f"completed_rounds={final_state.get('completed_rounds')}, closed={final_state.get('closed')}")
        before = final_state.get('provider_attempts')
        if closed:
            eleventh = api.request(payload={'operation': 'send', 'conversation_id': conversation, 'request_id': str(uuid4()),
                'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Quiero hacer una pregunta adicional.'}]})['body']
            check('Intento 11 sin llamada al proveedor', eleventh.get('status') == 'conversation_closed' and eleventh.get('state', {}).get('provider_attempts') == before,
                  f"status={eleventh.get('status')}; intentos={eleventh.get('state', {}).get('provider_attempts')}")
            replay = api.request(payload=last_payload)['body']
            check('Repetición idempotente de ronda 10', replay.get('status') == 'completed' and replay.get('result', {}).get('reply') == record['rounds'][-1]['reply']
                  and replay.get('state', {}).get('provider_attempts') == before, 'Mismo request_id; sin incremento de intentos.')
            opened = api.request(payload={'operation': 'start_capture', 'conversation_id': conversation})['body']
            check('Captura disponible después del cierre', opened.get('state', {}).get('capturing'), 'Comando local, sin OpenAI.')
            lead_id = str(uuid4())
            preference = 'phone' if case == 1 else 'video_call'
            contact = {'source': 'chatbot', 'interest': 'consultation', 'conversation_id': conversation, 'request_id': lead_id,
                'values': {'name': f'Chatbot Testing Test {case} {date} {run_id[:8]}', 'phone': f'+5690000010{case}',
                           'email': '' if case == 1 else 'qa-luna-high@example.invalid', 'contactPreference': preference},
                'privacyConsent': True, 'contactConsent': True, 'updatesConsent': False}
            saved = api.request('/api/interests', contact)
            repeated = api.request('/api/interests', contact)
            record['lead_request_id'] = lead_id
            check('Guardado de contacto ficticio autorizado', saved['http_status'] == 201 and saved['body'].get('status') == 'saved', f'Preferencia {preference}; lead_request_id={lead_id}.')
            check('Reintento del contacto sin duplicar', repeated['http_status'] == 201 and repeated['body'].get('status') == 'saved', 'Se reutilizó el identificador de guardado; comprobar unicidad en Supabase.')
            recovered = api.request()['body'].get('state', {})
            check('Cuotas conservadas después de guardar', recovered.get('completed_rounds') == 10 and recovered.get('provider_attempts') == before and not recovered.get('capturing'), 'Sin nuevas rondas ni intentos durante la captura.')
        record['status'] = 'APROBADO' if closed and all(item['passed'] for item in record['checks']) else 'CON FALLOS'
        if any(row.get('cost') is None for row in record['rounds']):
            record['status'] = 'CON FALLOS O CONSUMO NO DETERMINABLE'
        return 0 if record['status'] == 'APROBADO' else 1
    except Exception as error:
        record['status'] = 'INTERRUMPIDO'
        record['error'] = safe_error(str(error))
        print(f"Test {case} interrupted: {record['error']}", flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        record['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        persist()
        print(f'Report: {report_path.name}', flush=True)
```
