```sql
-- Additive upgrade of the existing interests pipeline and server-only setter RPCs.
-- Apply once to the existing schema; see database/README.md.
create schema if not exists private;
revoke all on schema private from public, anon, authenticated;
grant usage on schema private to service_role;

alter table public.interest_registrations
  drop constraint interest_registrations_interest_check,
  drop constraint interest_fields_match,
  alter column email drop not null,
  add column source text not null default 'form',
  add column contact_channel text,
  add column phone text,
  add column contact_consent boolean,
  add column contact_accepted_at timestamptz,
  add column lead_request_id uuid unique,
  add column lead_fingerprint text,
  add column management_status text not null default 'new';

alter table public.interest_registrations
  add constraint interests_catalog check (interest in ('consultation','course','online','nature')),
  add constraint interest_fields_match check ((
    (source = 'form' and email is not null and contact_channel is null and phone is null
      and contact_consent is null and contact_accepted_at is null and lead_request_id is null and lead_fingerprint is null
      and ((interest = 'online' and country is not null and char_length(btrim(country)) between 1 and 100 and city is null)
        or (interest = 'nature' and city is not null and char_length(btrim(city)) between 1 and 100 and country is null and experience is null)))
    or (source = 'chatbot' and country is null and city is null and experience is null
      and contact_consent is true and contact_accepted_at is not null and lead_request_id is not null
      and lead_fingerprint is not null and management_status = 'new'
      and ((contact_channel = 'email' and email is not null and phone is null)
        or (contact_channel in ('phone','whatsapp') and email is null and phone ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')))
  ) is true);

-- anon keeps its original column grants and can only submit the existing form variants.
alter policy "Public forms may only insert consented interests" on public.interest_registrations
  with check (source = 'form' and privacy_consent and privacy_version = '2026-10-21');
create index interest_phone_created_idx on public.interest_registrations(phone, created_at desc) where phone is not null;
create or replace function private.limit_interest_submissions() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(874291);
  if (select count(*) from public.interest_registrations where created_at > now() - interval '1 minute') >= 200
    or (select count(*) from public.interest_registrations
        where created_at > now() - interval '1 minute'
        and ((new.email is not null and email = new.email) or (new.phone is not null and phone = new.phone))) >= 5 then
    raise exception 'interest_rate_limited' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function private.limit_interest_submissions() from public, anon, authenticated;

create table private.setter_conversations (
  visitor uuid primary key,
  conversation_id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid(),
  completed_rounds integer not null default 0 check (completed_rounds between 0 and 10),
  provider_attempts integer not null default 0 check (provider_attempts between 0 and 12),
  topic text not null default 'unknown',
  action text not null default 'none',
  contact_declined boolean not null default false,
  capturing boolean not null default false,
  last_result jsonb,
  closed_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table private.setter_daily (
  visitor uuid not null,
  day date not null,
  completed_rounds integer not null default 0,
  provider_attempts integer not null default 0,
  conversations integer not null default 0,
  primary key(visitor, day)
);
create table private.setter_requests (
  visitor uuid not null,
  request_id uuid not null,
  conversation_id uuid not null,
  fingerprint text not null,
  status text not null check (status in ('reserved','completed','failed','uncertain')),
  result jsonb,
  usage jsonb,
  reserved_micro_usd bigint not null check (reserved_micro_usd > 0),
  day date not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(visitor, request_id)
);
create index setter_pending_idx on private.setter_requests(visitor, conversation_id, created_at) where status = 'reserved';
create index setter_requests_retention_idx on private.setter_requests(created_at);
create table private.setter_budget (
  day date primary key,
  reserved_micro_usd bigint not null default 0
);
alter table private.setter_conversations enable row level security;
alter table private.setter_daily enable row level security;
alter table private.setter_requests enable row level security;
alter table private.setter_budget enable row level security;
revoke all on private.setter_conversations, private.setter_daily, private.setter_requests, private.setter_budget from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on private.setter_conversations, private.setter_daily, private.setter_requests, private.setter_budget to service_role;
grant select, insert on public.interest_registrations to service_role;

create function public.setter_transition(
  p_visitor uuid, p_operation text, p_limits jsonb,
  p_conversation uuid default null, p_request uuid default null, p_hash text default null,
  p_result jsonb default null, p_usage jsonb default null
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  c private.setter_conversations%rowtype;
  d private.setter_daily%rowtype;
  r private.setter_requests%rowtype;
  today date := (now() at time zone 'America/Santiago')::date;
  outcome text := 'ready';
  replay jsonb;
  state jsonb;
  blocked text;
  busy boolean;
  reserve_amount bigint;
  daily_budget bigint;
begin
  if p_operation not in ('session','lookup','reserve','complete','fail','restart','start_capture','cancel_capture') then
    raise exception 'invalid_operation';
  end if;
  insert into private.setter_conversations(visitor) values(p_visitor) on conflict do nothing;
  select * into c from private.setter_conversations where visitor = p_visitor for update;
  insert into private.setter_daily(visitor,day,conversations)
    values(p_visitor,today,case when c.updated_at = now() then 1 else 0 end) on conflict do nothing;
  select * into d from private.setter_daily where visitor=p_visitor and day=today for update;
  update private.setter_requests set status='uncertain'
    where visitor=p_visitor and status='reserved' and created_at < now()-interval '75 seconds';
  busy := exists(select 1 from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and conversation_id=c.conversation_id and status='reserved');
  if not busy and c.provider_attempts >= 12 and c.closed_at is null then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
  if p_operation != 'session' and p_conversation is distinct from c.conversation_id then
    outcome := 'conversation_changed';
  elsif p_operation in ('lookup','reserve') then
    select * into r from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
    if found then
      if r.fingerprint != p_hash or r.conversation_id != p_conversation then
        outcome := 'request_conflict';
      else
        outcome := case when r.status='completed' then 'completed' when r.status='reserved' then 'pending' else r.status end;
        replay := r.result;
      end if;
    else
      outcome := 'new';
    end if;
  end if;
  blocked := case
    when c.closed_at is not null or c.completed_rounds >= (p_limits->>'max_completed_rounds')::integer then 'conversation_closed'
    when c.provider_attempts >= (p_limits->>'max_provider_attempts_per_conversation')::integer then 'attempt_budget_exhausted'
    when d.completed_rounds >= (p_limits->>'max_completed_rounds_per_visitor_day')::integer
      or d.provider_attempts >= (p_limits->>'max_provider_attempts_per_visitor_day')::integer then 'daily_limit'
    when c.capturing then 'capture_active'
    when busy then 'pending'
    else null end;
  if outcome='new' then
    if blocked is not null then
      outcome := blocked;
    elsif p_operation='reserve' then
      reserve_amount := (p_limits->>'reservation_micro_usd')::bigint;
      daily_budget := (p_limits->>'daily_budget_micro_usd')::bigint;
      if reserve_amount is null or reserve_amount <= 0 or daily_budget is null or daily_budget <= 0 then
        raise exception 'budget_not_configured';
      end if;
      insert into private.setter_budget(day) values(today) on conflict do nothing;
      -- The conditional UPDATE serializes global reservations across every visitor/instance.
      update private.setter_budget set reserved_micro_usd=reserved_micro_usd+reserve_amount
        where day=today and reserved_micro_usd+reserve_amount <= daily_budget;
      if not found then
        outcome := 'global_budget_exhausted';
      else
        insert into private.setter_requests(visitor,request_id,conversation_id,fingerprint,status,reserved_micro_usd,day)
          values(p_visitor,p_request,c.conversation_id,p_hash,'reserved',reserve_amount,today);
        c.provider_attempts := c.provider_attempts+1;
        d.provider_attempts := d.provider_attempts+1;
        outcome := 'reserved';
        busy := true;
      end if;
    end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation in ('complete','fail') then
    select * into r from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
    if not found or r.status != 'reserved' or r.conversation_id != c.conversation_id then
      outcome := 'uncertain';
    elsif p_operation='fail' then
      update private.setter_requests set status='failed' where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
      outcome := 'failed';
      busy := false;
      if c.provider_attempts >= 12 then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
    else
      update private.setter_requests set status='completed', result=p_result, usage=p_usage where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
      c.completed_rounds := c.completed_rounds+1;
      -- Attempts belong to the request day; delivered responses to the completion day.
      d.completed_rounds := d.completed_rounds+1;
      c.topic := p_result->>'topic';
      c.action := p_result->>'action';
      c.contact_declined := (p_result->>'contact_declined')::boolean;
      c.capturing := c.action='start_contact_capture';
      c.last_result := p_result;
      if c.completed_rounds >= 10 or c.provider_attempts >= 12 or (p_result->>'stop')::boolean then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
      outcome := 'completed';
      replay := p_result;
      busy := false;
    end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation='start_capture' then
    if busy then outcome := 'pending';
    else c.capturing := true; c.contact_declined := false; end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation='cancel_capture' then
    c.capturing := false;
    c.contact_declined := true;
    c.action := 'none';
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation='restart' then
    if busy or c.capturing or c.closed_at is null then outcome := 'conversation_active';
    elsif c.closed_at + make_interval(mins => (p_limits->>'cooldown_minutes_after_close')::integer) > now() then outcome := 'cooldown';
    elsif d.conversations >= (p_limits->>'max_new_conversations_per_visitor_day')::integer then outcome := 'daily_conversation_limit';
    elsif d.completed_rounds >= 30 or d.provider_attempts >= 36 then outcome := 'daily_limit';
    else
      c.conversation_id := gen_random_uuid(); c.completed_rounds := 0; c.provider_attempts := 0;
      c.closed_at := null; c.topic := 'unknown'; c.action := 'none'; c.contact_declined := false; c.last_result := null;
      d.conversations := d.conversations+1;
    end if;
  end if;
  update private.setter_conversations set conversation_id=c.conversation_id, completed_rounds=c.completed_rounds,
    provider_attempts=c.provider_attempts, topic=c.topic, action=c.action, contact_declined=c.contact_declined,
    capturing=c.capturing, last_result=c.last_result, closed_at=c.closed_at, updated_at=now() where visitor=p_visitor;
  update private.setter_daily set completed_rounds=d.completed_rounds, provider_attempts=d.provider_attempts,
    conversations=d.conversations where visitor=p_visitor and day=today;
  state := jsonb_build_object('conversation_id',c.conversation_id,'completed_rounds',c.completed_rounds,
    'provider_attempts',c.provider_attempts,'topic',c.topic,'action',c.action,'contact_declined',c.contact_declined,
    'capturing',c.capturing,'closed',c.closed_at is not null or c.completed_rounds >= 10 or c.provider_attempts >= 12,
    'daily_completed_rounds',d.completed_rounds,'daily_provider_attempts',d.provider_attempts,'daily_new_conversations',d.conversations,
    'busy',busy,'can_send',c.closed_at is null and c.completed_rounds<10 and c.provider_attempts<12
      and d.completed_rounds<30 and d.provider_attempts<36 and not c.capturing and not busy,
    'restart_at',c.closed_at+interval '30 minutes','last_result',c.last_result);
  return jsonb_build_object('status',outcome,'state',state,'result',replay);
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.setter_transition(uuid,text,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.setter_transition(uuid,text,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb) to service_role;

create function public.setter_save_contact(p_visitor uuid,p_conversation uuid,p_request uuid,p_hash text,p_record jsonb)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  c private.setter_conversations%rowtype;
  existing public.interest_registrations%rowtype;
begin
  -- Serialize contact completion with conversation operations and other tabs.
  select * into c from private.setter_conversations where visitor=p_visitor for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','session_required'); end if;
  select * into existing from public.interest_registrations where lead_request_id=p_request;
  if found then
    if existing.lead_fingerprint=p_hash then return jsonb_build_object('status','saved'); end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','request_conflict');
  end if;
  if c.conversation_id != p_conversation or not c.capturing then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','capture_required');
  end if;
  insert into public.interest_registrations(interest,full_name,email,phone,source,contact_channel,
    contact_consent,contact_accepted_at,privacy_consent,privacy_version,updates_consent,lead_request_id,lead_fingerprint)
  values(p_record->>'interest',p_record->>'full_name',p_record->>'email',p_record->>'phone','chatbot',p_record->>'contact_channel',
    (p_record->>'contact_consent')::boolean,now(),(p_record->>'privacy_consent')::boolean,p_record->>'privacy_version',
    (p_record->>'updates_consent')::boolean,p_request,p_hash);
  update private.setter_conversations set capturing=false,action='none',updated_at=now() where visitor=p_visitor;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','saved');
exception
  when unique_violation then return jsonb_build_object('status','request_conflict');
  when raise_exception then
    if sqlerrm='interest_rate_limited' then return jsonb_build_object('status','rate_limited'); end if;
    raise;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.setter_save_contact(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.setter_save_contact(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb) to service_role;
```

<a id="archivo-database-setter-learning-sql"></a>

### `database/setter_learning.sql`

SHA-256: `3424043ccf927f3fbef39f52b01de6f0fcf87328f73862c51a8488e9b471cf57` · 105 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Optional, explicitly submitted cases. Pending suggestions never reach the model.
create table private.setter_feedback (
  id uuid primary key,
  visitor uuid not null,
  conversation_id uuid not null,
  request_id uuid not null,
  category text not null check (category in ('irrelevant','missing','unnatural','incorrect')),
  question text not null check (char_length(question) between 5 and 500),
  actual_reply text not null,
  suggestion text not null check (char_length(suggestion) between 10 and 1000),
  comment text not null default '' check (char_length(comment) <= 500),
  consent_version text not null default 'setter-feedback-2026-10-23',
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','approved','rejected')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  reviewed_by text,
  unique (visitor, request_id)
);
create index setter_feedback_visitor_date on private.setter_feedback(visitor, created_at);
create index setter_feedback_pending on private.setter_feedback(created_at) where status = 'pending';
alter table private.setter_feedback enable row level security;
revoke all on private.setter_feedback from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on private.setter_feedback to service_role;

create table private.setter_examples (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  feedback_id uuid unique references private.setter_feedback(id),
  question text not null check (char_length(question) between 5 and 500),
  answer text not null check (char_length(answer) between 10 and 1000),
  topic text not null check (topic in ('consultation','therapies','course','online','nature','unknown')),
  enabled boolean not null default true,
  reviewed_by text not null check (char_length(trim(reviewed_by)) > 0),
  reviewed_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table private.setter_examples enable row level security;
revoke all on private.setter_examples from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on private.setter_examples to service_role;

create or replace function public.setter_feedback_save(p_visitor uuid, p_values jsonb)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare existing private.setter_feedback; answer jsonb;
begin
  if p_values->'consent' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','invalid');
  end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_visitor::text, 8934));
  select * into existing from private.setter_feedback
    where visitor = p_visitor and request_id = (p_values->>'request_id')::uuid;
  if found then
    if existing.id = (p_values->>'id')::uuid and existing.question = p_values->>'question'
      and existing.suggestion = p_values->>'suggestion' and existing.comment = p_values->>'comment'
      and existing.category = p_values->>'category' then
      return jsonb_build_object('status','saved');
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','conflict');
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from private.setter_feedback where visitor=p_visitor
      and created_at >= date_trunc('day',now() at time zone 'America/Santiago') at time zone 'America/Santiago') >= 20 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','rate_limited');
  end if;
  select result into answer from private.setter_requests
    where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=(p_values->>'request_id')::uuid
      and conversation_id=(p_values->>'conversation_id')::uuid and status='completed';
  if answer is null then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  insert into private.setter_feedback(id,visitor,conversation_id,request_id,category,question,actual_reply,suggestion,comment)
    values ((p_values->>'id')::uuid,p_visitor,(p_values->>'conversation_id')::uuid,
      (p_values->>'request_id')::uuid,p_values->>'category',p_values->>'question',answer->>'reply',
      p_values->>'suggestion',coalesce(p_values->>'comment',''));
  return jsonb_build_object('status','saved');
end $$;

create or replace function public.setter_learning_examples()
returns jsonb language sql stable security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('examples', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'question',question,'answer',answer,'topic',topic)), '[]'::jsonb))
  from (select question,answer,topic from private.setter_examples
    where enabled order by reviewed_at desc, id limit 8) examples;
$$;

-- Editorial operation. Never expose this operation through the visitor API.
create or replace function public.setter_feedback_review(p_id uuid, p_approve boolean, p_reviewer text,
  p_question text default null, p_answer text default null, p_topic text default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare item private.setter_feedback;
begin
  if p_reviewer is null or char_length(trim(p_reviewer))=0 then raise exception 'Reviewer required'; end if;
  select * into item from private.setter_feedback where id=p_id for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  if item.status <> 'pending' then return jsonb_build_object('status','already_reviewed'); end if;
  if p_approve then
    if p_question is null or p_answer is null or p_topic is null then raise exception 'Reviewed example required'; end if;
    insert into private.setter_examples(feedback_id,question,answer,topic,reviewed_by)
      values (p_id,p_question,p_answer,p_topic,p_reviewer);
  end if;
  update private.setter_feedback set status=case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end,
    reviewed_at=now(),reviewed_by=p_reviewer where id=p_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('status',case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end);
end $$;
```

<a id="archivo-database-setter-refresh-conversation-sql"></a>

### `database/setter_refresh_conversation.sql`

SHA-256: `352143b364a87df08d2da846bed01174c299e3f752f9626a8f0d72358bc2a0fc` · 142 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Refresh clears conversational context while keeping visitor identity, daily counters and budget.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.setter_transition(p_visitor uuid, p_operation text, p_limits jsonb, p_conversation uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_request uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_result jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_usage jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  c private.setter_conversations%rowtype;
  d private.setter_daily%rowtype;
  r private.setter_requests%rowtype;
  today date := (now() at time zone 'America/Santiago')::date;
  outcome text := 'ready';
  replay jsonb;
  state jsonb;
  blocked text;
  busy boolean;
  reserve_amount bigint;
  daily_budget bigint;
begin
  if p_operation not in ('session','lookup','reserve','complete','fail','restart','refresh','start_capture','cancel_capture') then
    raise exception 'invalid_operation';
  end if;
  insert into private.setter_conversations(visitor) values(p_visitor) on conflict do nothing;
  select * into c from private.setter_conversations where visitor = p_visitor for update;
  insert into private.setter_daily(visitor,day,conversations)
    values(p_visitor,today,case when c.updated_at = now() then 1 else 0 end) on conflict do nothing;
  select * into d from private.setter_daily where visitor=p_visitor and day=today for update;
  update private.setter_requests set status='uncertain'
    where visitor=p_visitor and status='reserved' and created_at < now()-interval '75 seconds';
  busy := exists(select 1 from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and conversation_id=c.conversation_id and status='reserved');
  if not busy and c.provider_attempts >= 12 and c.closed_at is null then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
  if p_operation != 'session' and p_conversation is distinct from c.conversation_id then
    outcome := 'conversation_changed';
  elsif p_operation in ('lookup','reserve') then
    select * into r from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
    if found then
      if r.fingerprint != p_hash or r.conversation_id != p_conversation then
        outcome := 'request_conflict';
      else
        outcome := case when r.status='completed' then 'completed' when r.status='reserved' then 'pending' else r.status end;
        replay := r.result;
      end if;
    else
      outcome := 'new';
    end if;
  end if;
  blocked := case
    when c.closed_at is not null or c.completed_rounds >= (p_limits->>'max_completed_rounds')::integer then 'conversation_closed'
    when c.provider_attempts >= (p_limits->>'max_provider_attempts_per_conversation')::integer then 'attempt_budget_exhausted'
    when d.completed_rounds >= (p_limits->>'max_completed_rounds_per_visitor_day')::integer
      or d.provider_attempts >= (p_limits->>'max_provider_attempts_per_visitor_day')::integer then 'daily_limit'
    when c.capturing then 'capture_active'
    when busy then 'pending'
    else null end;
  if outcome='new' then
    if blocked is not null then
      outcome := blocked;
    elsif p_operation='reserve' then
      reserve_amount := (p_limits->>'reservation_micro_usd')::bigint;
      daily_budget := (p_limits->>'daily_budget_micro_usd')::bigint;
      if reserve_amount is null or reserve_amount <= 0 or daily_budget is null or daily_budget <= 0 then
        raise exception 'budget_not_configured';
      end if;
      insert into private.setter_budget(day) values(today) on conflict do nothing;
      -- The conditional UPDATE serializes global reservations across every visitor/instance.
      update private.setter_budget set reserved_micro_usd=reserved_micro_usd+reserve_amount
        where day=today and reserved_micro_usd+reserve_amount <= daily_budget;
      if not found then
        outcome := 'global_budget_exhausted';
      else
        insert into private.setter_requests(visitor,request_id,conversation_id,fingerprint,status,reserved_micro_usd,day)
          values(p_visitor,p_request,c.conversation_id,p_hash,'reserved',reserve_amount,today);
        c.provider_attempts := c.provider_attempts+1;
        d.provider_attempts := d.provider_attempts+1;
        outcome := 'reserved';
        busy := true;
      end if;
    end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation in ('complete','fail') then
    select * into r from private.setter_requests where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
    if not found or r.status != 'reserved' or r.conversation_id != c.conversation_id then
      outcome := 'uncertain';
    elsif p_operation='fail' then
      update private.setter_requests set status='failed' where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
      outcome := 'failed';
      busy := false;
      if c.provider_attempts >= 12 then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
    else
      update private.setter_requests set status='completed', result=p_result, usage=p_usage where visitor=p_visitor and request_id=p_request;
      c.completed_rounds := c.completed_rounds+1;
      -- Attempts belong to the request day; delivered responses to the completion day.
      d.completed_rounds := d.completed_rounds+1;
      c.topic := p_result->>'topic';
      c.action := p_result->>'action';
      c.contact_declined := (p_result->>'contact_declined')::boolean;
      c.capturing := c.action='start_contact_capture';
      c.last_result := p_result;
      if c.completed_rounds >= 10 or c.provider_attempts >= 12 or (p_result->>'stop')::boolean then c.closed_at := now(); end if;
      outcome := 'completed';
      replay := p_result;
      busy := false;
    end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation='start_capture' then
    if busy then outcome := 'pending';
    else c.capturing := true; c.contact_declined := false; end if;
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation='cancel_capture' then
    c.capturing := false;
    c.contact_declined := true;
    c.action := 'none';
  elsif outcome='ready' and p_operation in ('restart','refresh') then
    if p_operation='restart' and (busy or c.capturing or c.closed_at is null) then outcome := 'conversation_active';
    elsif busy then outcome := 'pending';
    elsif p_operation='refresh' and c.completed_rounds=0 and c.provider_attempts=0 and c.closed_at is null then
      -- An unused conversation can be cleared repeatedly without spending the daily conversation allowance.
      c.topic := 'unknown'; c.action := 'none'; c.contact_declined := false; c.last_result := null; c.capturing := false;
    elsif c.closed_at is not null and c.closed_at + make_interval(mins => (p_limits->>'cooldown_minutes_after_close')::integer) > now() then outcome := 'cooldown';
    elsif d.conversations >= (p_limits->>'max_new_conversations_per_visitor_day')::integer then outcome := 'daily_conversation_limit';
    elsif d.completed_rounds >= 30 or d.provider_attempts >= 36 then outcome := 'daily_limit';
    else
      c.conversation_id := gen_random_uuid(); c.completed_rounds := 0; c.provider_attempts := 0;
      c.closed_at := null; c.topic := 'unknown'; c.action := 'none'; c.contact_declined := false; c.last_result := null; c.capturing := false;
      d.conversations := d.conversations+1;
    end if;
  end if;
  update private.setter_conversations set conversation_id=c.conversation_id, completed_rounds=c.completed_rounds,
    provider_attempts=c.provider_attempts, topic=c.topic, action=c.action, contact_declined=c.contact_declined,
    capturing=c.capturing, last_result=c.last_result, closed_at=c.closed_at, updated_at=now() where visitor=p_visitor;
  update private.setter_daily set completed_rounds=d.completed_rounds, provider_attempts=d.provider_attempts,
    conversations=d.conversations where visitor=p_visitor and day=today;
  state := jsonb_build_object('conversation_id',c.conversation_id,'completed_rounds',c.completed_rounds,
    'provider_attempts',c.provider_attempts,'topic',c.topic,'action',c.action,'contact_declined',c.contact_declined,
    'capturing',c.capturing,'closed',c.closed_at is not null or c.completed_rounds >= 10 or c.provider_attempts >= 12,
    'daily_completed_rounds',d.completed_rounds,'daily_provider_attempts',d.provider_attempts,'daily_new_conversations',d.conversations,
    'busy',busy,'can_send',c.closed_at is null and c.completed_rounds<10 and c.provider_attempts<12
      and d.completed_rounds<30 and d.provider_attempts<36 and not c.capturing and not busy,
    'restart_at',c.closed_at+interval '30 minutes','last_result',c.last_result);
  return jsonb_build_object('status',outcome,'state',state,'result',replay);
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.setter_transition(uuid,text,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.setter_transition(uuid,text,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb) to service_role;
```

### `scripts/configure_vercel_env.py`

SHA-256: `07e4c73dfd28a3099743b6411962e92834f2d3352ca86be9b2eb5b075b72ff1b` · 46 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```python
"""Upload only the setter's managed settings; never print secret values."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from backend.chat_identity import secret
from backend.chat_store import budget_limits
from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment

PROJECT = 'prj_9NLR5XePMoPl4dVGO06bZHQ0r5jq'
TEAM = 'team_wpjRCdTWmM7mt6hz8P5oOwtr'
MANAGED_KEYS = ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_MODEL', 'CHAT_COOKIE_SECRET', 'CHAT_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION',
                'CHAT_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION', 'CHAT_DAILY_BUDGET_MICRO_USD')


def main():
    load_local_environment(ROOT)
    if any(not os.environ.get(key, '').strip() for key in MANAGED_KEYS):
        print('Missing settings: ' + ', '.join(key for key in MANAGED_KEYS if not os.environ.get(key, '').strip()))
        return 1
    secret()
    budget_limits()
    executable = shutil.which('vercel.cmd') or shutil.which('vercel')
    if not executable:
        print('Vercel CLI is required.')
        return 1
    for key in MANAGED_KEYS:
        value = os.environ[key].strip()
        command = [executable, 'env', 'add', key, 'preview,production', '--sensitive', '--force', '--yes',
                   '--project', PROJECT, '--scope', TEAM]
        # Values go through stdin, not command arguments, temporary files or logs.
        completed = subprocess.run(command, input=value, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120, cwd=ROOT)
        if completed.returncode:
            print(f'Failed to configure {key}. Details withheld to avoid printing secrets.')
            return completed.returncode
        print(f'Configured {key}: Preview, Production', flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

<a id="archivo-scripts-dev-mjs"></a>

### `scripts/dev.mjs`

SHA-256: `e93d2dbb8054cb86f15f14c03ed157100112e85c733ef69123fe402751c04363` · 59 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { setTimeout as pause } from 'node:timers/promises'

const projectRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')

// Start the API first: a Vite-only process cannot serve the application's forms.
// Direct executables (no npm shell children) make shutdown reliable on Windows.
export async function startDevelopment({
  root = projectRoot, spawnChild = spawn, exists = existsSync, request = fetch,
  wait = pause, now = Date.now, apiOnly = false,
  log = console.log, report = console.error, fail = () => { process.exitCode = 1 },
} = {}) {
  const children = []
  let stopped = false
  function stop() {
    if (stopped) return
    stopped = true
    for (const child of children) if (child.exitCode == null && !child.killed) child.kill()
  }
  function failed(message) {
    if (stopped) return
    report(message)
    stop()
    fail()
  }
  function launch(command, args, label) {
    const child = spawnChild(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit', windowsHide: true })
    children.push(child)
    child.on('error', () => failed(`No se pudo iniciar ${label}. Comprueba la instalación y los puertos disponibles.`))
    child.on('exit', () => failed(`${label} se cerró. Se detuvo el desarrollo para evitar errores de conexión con /api.`))
    return child
  }
  const localPython = join(root, '.venv', process.platform === 'win32' ? 'Scripts/python.exe' : 'bin/python')
  launch(exists(localPython) ? localPython : 'python', ['-u', '-m', 'backend.dev_server'], 'la API Python')
  const started = now()
  let ready = false
  while (!stopped && now() - started < 15000) {
    try {
      const response = await request('http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1000) })
      if (response.ok && (await response.json()).status === 'ready') { ready = true; break }
    } catch { /* The API may still be importing its modules. */ }
    await wait(250)
  }
  if (!stopped && !ready) failed('La API no está disponible en 127.0.0.1:3001. Revisa Python y si el puerto ya está ocupado.')
  if (!stopped && ready) {
    log('API lista en http://127.0.0.1:3001. Las rutas /api se atenderán desde el mismo origen de Vite.')
    if (!apiOnly) launch(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js')], 'Vite')
  }
  return { stop }
}

if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  // Register before startup so Ctrl+C also works while waiting for Python.
  const startup = startDevelopment({ apiOnly: process.argv.includes('--api-only') })
  for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) process.once(signal, () => { void startup.then(({ stop }) => stop()) })
}
```

<a id="archivo-scripts-dev-test-js"></a>

### `scripts/dev.test.js`

SHA-256: `06b1a6ffb92ba23bc5fe472e5aa04c441dd8a31904f41621de203d0ee2d8f578` · 66 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
// @vitest-environment node
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'
import { expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { startDevelopment } from './dev.mjs'

function setup() {
  const children = []
  const spawnChild = vi.fn(() => {
    const child = new EventEmitter()
    child.kill = vi.fn(() => { child.killed = true; child.emit('exit', 0) })
    children.push(child)
    return child
  })
  return { children, spawnChild }
}

it('waits for the API before starting Vite and stops both children together', async () => {
  const { children, spawnChild } = setup()
  let finish
  const request = vi.fn(() => new Promise((resolve) => { finish = resolve }))
  const running = startDevelopment({ spawnChild, exists: () => true, request, log: vi.fn() })
  expect(spawnChild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  finish({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ status: 'ready' }) })
  const { stop } = await running
  expect(spawnChild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  expect(spawnChild.mock.calls[0][1]).toEqual(['-u', '-m', 'backend.dev_server'])
  expect(spawnChild.mock.calls[1][1][0]).toContain('vite')
  stop()
  expect(children.every((child) => child.kill.mock.calls.length === 1)).toBe(true)
})

it('reports an API startup failure without leaving Vite running', async () => {
  const { children, spawnChild } = setup()
  const report = vi.fn(), fail = vi.fn()
  const pending = startDevelopment({ spawnChild, exists: () => false, request: async () => {
    children[0].emit('error', new Error('ENOENT'))
    throw Error('not ready')
  }, wait: async () => {}, report, fail })
  await pending
  expect(spawnChild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  expect(report).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('No se pudo iniciar'))
  expect(fail).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})

it('times out an unreachable API and shuts down its process', async () => {
  const { children, spawnChild } = setup()
  let clock = 0
  const fail = vi.fn()
  await startDevelopment({ spawnChild, exists: () => false, request: async () => { throw Error('unreachable') },
    now: () => clock, wait: async (delay) => { clock += delay }, report: vi.fn(), fail })
  expect(spawnChild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  expect(children[0].kill).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  expect(fail).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})

it('supports an API-only session and stops the other process after a runtime failure', async () => {
  const { children, spawnChild } = setup()
  const fail = vi.fn()
  const { stop } = await startDevelopment({ spawnChild, exists: () => false, apiOnly: true,
    request: async () => ({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ status: 'ready' }) }), log: vi.fn(), report: vi.fn(), fail })
  expect(spawnChild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  children[0].exitCode = 1
  children[0].emit('exit', 1)
  expect(fail).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  stop()
})
```

<a id="archivo-scripts-export-marketing-report-py"></a>

### `scripts/export_marketing_report.py`

SHA-256: `5f707e254c112a03570afda140fd9bd7ada4e53439ecf3bcdac53552449fefe4` · 54 líneas · sin seguimiento previo.

```python
"""Export anonymous marketing aggregates. Offline input never loads credentials."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment
from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable
from backend.marketing_ledger import InvalidMarketingData
from backend.marketing_metrics import build_report
from backend.marketing_report_export import export_report
from backend.marketing_report_store import MarketingReportStore
from backend.marketing_report_contract import apply_coverage

MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument('--input', type=Path, help='Closed-schema aggregate JSON snapshot; no raw contacts/events')
    source.add_argument('--database', action='store_true', help='Read server-only aggregates, explicitly gated')
    parser.add_argument('--start', help='Inclusive Santiago date, required with --database')
    parser.add_argument('--end', help='Inclusive Santiago date, maximum 366 days')
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path, help='New private directory; never overwrite an existing report')
    parser.add_argument('--coverage', type=Path, help='Optional explicit reconciliation attestation for this exact period')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.database and (not args.start or not args.end): parser.error('--database requires --start and --end')
    if args.input and (args.start or args.end): parser.error('Offline reports use the period declared in the snapshot')
    try:
        if args.output.exists(): raise InvalidMarketingData('report_destination_exists')
        if args.input:
            with args.input.open('rb') as source_file: content = source_file.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
            if len(content) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES: raise InvalidMarketingData('report_input_too_large')
            snapshot = json.loads(content.decode('utf-8-sig'))
        else:
            # Validate dates before accessing any environment or network.
            from backend.marketing_report_contract import report_period
            report_period(args.start, args.end)
            load_local_environment()
            snapshot = MarketingReportStore().snapshot(args.start, args.end)
        if args.coverage:
            with args.coverage.open('rb') as coverage_file: coverage_body = coverage_file.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
            if len(coverage_body) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES: raise InvalidMarketingData('report_input_too_large')
            snapshot = apply_coverage(snapshot, json.loads(coverage_body.decode('utf-8-sig')))
        manifest = export_report(build_report(snapshot), args.output)
        print(json.dumps({'status': 'exported', 'schema_version': 1, 'datasets': {key: value['rows'] for key, value in manifest['datasets'].items()}}))
        return 0
    except (InvalidMarketingData, StoreUnavailable, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, OverflowError):
        # Paths, raw source values, tokens and contact information never enter logs.
        print(json.dumps({'status': 'unavailable', 'error': 'invalid_report_or_source_unavailable'}))
        return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

```javascript
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path'
import { SITE_ORIGIN, SITE_ROUTES } from '../src/config/siteRoutes.js'
import { htmlWithSeo, sitemapXml } from '../src/services/seoService.js'

const output = resolve('dist')
const template = await readFile(join(output, 'index.html'), 'utf8')
// Production indexation requires an explicit opt-in as well as Vercel's real
// deployment environment. A local or preview build never turns it on by hostname.
const indexingEnabled = process.env.VERCEL_ENV === 'production' && process.env.SEO_ALLOW_INDEXING === 'true'
for (const { path } of SITE_ROUTES) {
  const directory = path === '/' ? output : join(output, path.slice(1))
  await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true })
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'index.html'), htmlWithSeo(template, path, { indexingEnabled }))
}
await writeFile(join(output, '404.html'), htmlWithSeo(template, '/404', { indexingEnabled: false }))
await writeFile(join(output, 'sitemap.xml'), sitemapXml(indexingEnabled))
await writeFile(join(output, 'robots.txt'), `User-agent: *\nAllow: /\n${indexingEnabled ? `Sitemap: ${SITE_ORIGIN}/sitemap.xml\n` : ''}`)
console.log(`SEO: ${SITE_ROUTES.length} routes generated; indexing ${indexingEnabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}.`)
```

### `scripts/import_marketing_data.py`

SHA-256: `af167ae765ef4242d6c690e1dfd9c59269b39ac97e74688a3405a2a3f8bac84d` · 36 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```python
"""Run: python -m scripts.import_marketing_data FILE --kind movements --dry-run."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment
from backend.marketing_imports import parse_marketing_csv, apply_marketing_batch, MAX_BYTES
from backend.marketing_ledger import InvalidMarketingData
from backend.marketing_store import MarketingStore
from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Validate marketing CSV without exposing its raw values.')
    parser.add_argument('file', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=['movements', 'spend'], default='movements')
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true')
    mode.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        with args.file.open('rb') as source:
            batch = parse_marketing_csv(source.read(MAX_BYTES + 1), args.kind)
        summary = {'mode': 'apply' if args.apply else 'dry-run', 'valid': batch['valid'],
                   'accepted_rows': len(batch['rows']), 'errors': batch['errors'], 'file_digest': batch['file_digest']}
        if args.apply and batch['valid']:
            load_local_environment()
            summary['result'] = apply_marketing_batch(batch, MarketingStore())
        print(json.dumps(summary))
        return 0 if batch['valid'] else 1
    except (InvalidMarketingData, StoreUnavailable, OSError):
        print(json.dumps({'valid': False, 'error': 'invalid_file_or_storage_unavailable'}))
        return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

### `scripts/review_chatbot_feedback.py`

SHA-256: `18524bdf61afd148ccd1c66bc24d3ffea85d8a0dd17fe666de0c7c808191f4ad` · 45 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```python
"""Apply an explicit editorial decision using the server-only Supabase key."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from uuid import UUID

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment
from backend.chat_store import rpc, StoreUnavailable


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--id', required=True, type=UUID)
    parser.add_argument('--reviewer', required=True)
    decision = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    decision.add_argument('--approve-file', type=Path, help='Reviewed JSON with question, answer and topic')
    decision.add_argument('--reject', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    values = {'p_id': str(args.id), 'p_approve': bool(args.approve_file), 'p_reviewer': args.reviewer.strip()}
    if not values['p_reviewer']:
        parser.error('Reviewer must not be empty')
    if args.approve_file:
        reviewed = json.loads(args.approve_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        if set(reviewed) != {'question', 'answer', 'topic'}:
            parser.error('Expected exactly question, answer and topic')
        for key, minimum, maximum in (('question', 5, 500), ('answer', 10, 1000)):
            if not isinstance(reviewed[key], str) or not minimum <= len(reviewed[key].strip()) <= maximum:
                parser.error('Invalid ' + key)
        if reviewed['topic'] not in ('consultation', 'therapies', 'course', 'online', 'nature', 'unknown'):
            parser.error('Invalid topic')
        values.update({f'p_{key}': value for key, value in reviewed.items()})
    load_local_environment()
    try:
        result = rpc('setter_feedback_review', values)
    except StoreUnavailable:
        raise SystemExit('No se pudo confirmar la revisión; comprueba la conexión y la configuración.') from None
    print(json.dumps({'status': result.get('status')}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if result.get('status') not in ('approved', 'rejected'):
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```css
.site-app { min-height: 100vh; }
```

```jsx
afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/') })
describe('App hydration contract', () => {
  it('hydrates a nature page without duplicated content or recoverable mismatches', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
```

### `src/app/App.jsx`

SHA-256: `2cc809b0fc8620c9b7c52281739b496544e3525a95a2cfc09ced029ede5fe347` · 112 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { HydrationProvider, useHydrated } from '../contexts/HydrationContext/HydrationContext.jsx'
import { AnalyticsConsentProvider, useAnalyticsConsent } from '../contexts/AnalyticsConsentContext/AnalyticsConsentContext.jsx'
import AnalyticsConsent from '../components/AnalyticsConsent/AnalyticsConsent.jsx'
import AnalyticsConsentSkeleton from '../components/AnalyticsConsent/AnalyticsConsentSkeleton.jsx'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { SiteContentProvider, useSiteContent } from '../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import { ChatbotProvider } from '../contexts/ChatbotContext/ChatbotContext.jsx'
import { useSiteNavigation } from '../hooks/useSiteNavigation/useSiteNavigation.js'
import { SITE_ROUTES, normalizeSitePath } from '../config/siteRoutes.js'
import { applySeoMetadata } from '../services/seoService.js'
import { usePageDelay } from '../hooks/usePageDelay/usePageDelay.js'
import { usePageAnalytics } from '../hooks/usePageAnalytics/usePageAnalytics.js'
import { usePageSensors } from '../hooks/usePageSensors/usePageSensors.js'
import SiteHeader from '../components/SiteHeader/SiteHeader.jsx'
import SiteHeaderSkeleton from '../components/SiteHeader/SiteHeaderSkeleton.jsx'
import SiteFooter from '../components/SiteFooter/SiteFooter.jsx'
import SiteFooterSkeleton from '../components/SiteFooter/SiteFooterSkeleton.jsx'
import HomePage from '../pages/HomePage/HomePage.jsx'
import HomePageSkeleton from '../pages/HomePage/HomePageSkeleton.jsx'
import TherapiesPage from '../pages/TherapiesPage/TherapiesPage.jsx'
import TherapiesPageSkeleton from '../pages/TherapiesPage/TherapiesPageSkeleton.jsx'
import ConsultationPage from '../pages/ConsultationPage/ConsultationPage.jsx'
import ConsultationPageSkeleton from '../pages/ConsultationPage/ConsultationPageSkeleton.jsx'
import CoursesPage from '../pages/CoursesPage/CoursesPage.jsx'
import CoursesPageSkeleton from '../pages/CoursesPage/CoursesPageSkeleton.jsx'
import PrivacyPage from '../pages/PrivacyPage/PrivacyPage.jsx'
import PrivacyPageSkeleton from '../pages/PrivacyPage/PrivacyPageSkeleton.jsx'
import NotFoundPage from '../pages/NotFoundPage/NotFoundPage.jsx'
import NotFoundPageSkeleton from '../pages/NotFoundPage/NotFoundPageSkeleton.jsx'
import Chatbot from '../components/Chatbot/Chatbot.jsx'
import ChatbotSkeleton from '../components/Chatbot/ChatbotSkeleton.jsx'
import './App.css'
import AboutPage from '../pages/AboutPage/AboutPage.jsx'
import AboutPageSkeleton from '../pages/AboutPage/AboutPageSkeleton.jsx'
import NaturePage from '../pages/NaturePage/NaturePage.jsx'
import NaturePageSkeleton from '../pages/NaturePage/NaturePageSkeleton.jsx'
import ChatbotPage from '../pages/ChatbotPage/ChatbotPage.jsx'
import ChatbotPageSkeleton from '../pages/ChatbotPage/ChatbotPageSkeleton.jsx'
import AdminPage from '../pages/AdminPage/AdminPage.jsx'

const routes = {
  '/sobre-mi': { Page: AboutPage, Skeleton: AboutPageSkeleton },
  '/naturaleza': { Page: NaturePage, Skeleton: NaturePageSkeleton },
  '/chatbot': { Page: ChatbotPage, Skeleton: ChatbotPageSkeleton },
  '/': { Page: HomePage, Skeleton: HomePageSkeleton },
  '/consulta': { Page: ConsultationPage, Skeleton: ConsultationPageSkeleton },
  '/terapias': { Page: TherapiesPage, Skeleton: TherapiesPageSkeleton },
  '/cursos': { Page: CoursesPage, Skeleton: CoursesPageSkeleton },
  '/privacidad': { Page: PrivacyPage, Skeleton: PrivacyPageSkeleton },
}
const routePaths = SITE_ROUTES.map(({ path }) => path)

export function normalizePath(pathname) { return normalizeSitePath(pathname) }

function updateMetadata(path) {
  const enabled = document.querySelector('meta[name="site-indexing-enabled"]')?.content === 'true'
    && ['www.nicolaszamara.com', 'nicolaszamara.com'].includes(window.location.hostname)
  applySeoMetadata(document, path, enabled)
}

function AppContent({ location }) {
  const hydrated = useHydrated()
  const preferences = useAnalyticsConsent()
  const content = useSiteContent()
  const path = normalizePath(location.pathname)
  const route = routes[path] || { Page: NotFoundPage, Skeleton: NotFoundPageSkeleton }
  const ready = usePageDelay(path)
  const assistantReady = usePageDelay('global-assistant')
  usePageAnalytics(path, ready)
  usePageSensors(path, ready)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return
    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (!location.hash) { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }); return }
      try { document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)))?.scrollIntoView() } catch { /* Invalid URL escape: keep the page usable. */ }
    })
    return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame)
  }, [path, location.hash, ready])

  const { Page, Skeleton } = route
  return (
    <div className="site-app" data-brand={content.brand}>
      <a className="skip-link" href="#main-content">Saltar al contenido</a>
      <div className="site-app__loading-shell" data-hydrated={hydrated ? 'true' : undefined} data-ready={ready ? 'true' : undefined}>
        {!ready && <div className="site-app__loading-skeleton"><SiteHeaderSkeleton /><Skeleton /><SiteFooterSkeleton /></div>}
        <div className="site-app__page-content" aria-hidden={hydrated && !ready ? true : undefined}>
          <SiteHeader currentPath={path} />
          <Page />
          <SiteFooter onOpenAnalytics={preferences.openPreferences} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {preferences.visible && (assistantReady
        ? <AnalyticsConsent key={preferences.consent.updatedAt || 'initial'} consent={preferences.consent} onSave={preferences.savePreferences} onClose={preferences.closePreferences} />
        : <AnalyticsConsentSkeleton />)}
      {assistantReady ? <Chatbot hidden={path === '/chatbot'} /> : path !== '/chatbot' && (hydrated ? createPortal(<ChatbotSkeleton />, document.body) : <ChatbotSkeleton />)}
    </div>
  )
}

function AppRoutes({ initialPath }) {
  const location = useSiteNavigation(routePaths, initialPath)
  const path = normalizePath(location.pathname)
  useEffect(() => { updateMetadata(path) }, [path])
  // A separate branch unmounts public sensors, consent UI and the assistant.
  return path === '/admin' ? <AdminPage /> : <AppContent location={location} />
}

export default function App({ initialPath = '/' }) {
  return <HydrationProvider><SiteContentProvider><AnalyticsConsentProvider><ChatbotProvider><AppRoutes initialPath={initialPath} /></ChatbotProvider></AnalyticsConsentProvider></SiteContentProvider></HydrationProvider>
}
```

```jsx
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(1))
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: heading })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(document.title).toBe(title)
    expect(within(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Navegación principal' })).getByRole('link', { name: label })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Flores de Bach para la vida cotidiana' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('muestra la página no encontrada para rutas desconocidas', () => {
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/ruta-inexistente')
    render(<App />)
    act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(800))
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: /este camino todavía no está en el mapa/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('abre terapias directamente y respeta los 800 ms antes de mostrar los servicios', () => {
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/terapias')
    render(<App />)
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Cargando terapias')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
    act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(799))
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Terapias' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(1))
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Terapias' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Terapias' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    expect(document.title).toBe('Terapias y servicios | Nicolás Zamara')
  })
})
```

```jsx
import './ActionLink.css'
import { ctaAttributes } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'
import { currentSourcePath } from '../../services/sourceContext.js'

export default function ActionLink({ href, variant = 'primary', className = '', children, analytics, onClick, ...linkProps }) {
  return (
    <a className={`action-link action-link--${variant} ${className}`.trim()} href={href} {...linkProps} {...ctaAttributes(analytics)} onClick={(event) => {
      onClick?.(event)
      if (analytics && !event.defaultPrevented && (href?.startsWith('/') || href?.startsWith('#'))) {
        trackEvent('cta_click', { ...analytics, destination_path: href.split(/[?#]/)[0] || currentSourcePath() })
      }
    }}>
      {children}
    </a>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'
vi.mock('../../services/analyticsService.js', () => ({ trackEvent: vi.fn(() => true) }))
import ActionLink from './ActionLink.jsx'
import ActionLinkSkeleton from './ActionLinkSkeleton.jsx'

describe('ActionLink', () => {
  it('records an explicit internal CTA once while preserving the user action', () => {
    const onClick = vi.fn()
    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { once: true })
    render(<ActionLink href="/naturaleza" onClick={onClick} analytics={{ element_id: 'hero_nature', placement: 'home_hero', service: 'nature' }}>Nature</ActionLink>)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Nature' }))

  })

  it('ofrece un skeleton propio', () => {
```

<a id="archivo-src-components-admindashboard-admindashboard-jsx"></a>

### `src/components/AdminDashboard/AdminDashboard.jsx`

SHA-256: `fcb302d7eee358651a71a0d3972590be70f94f0fb4e62a801736b0b6d779cd51` · 72 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useAdminQuery } from '../../hooks/useAdminQuery/useAdminQuery.js'
import { getAdminInterests, adminErrorMessage } from '../../services/adminService.js'
import { adminDate, interestLabels, preferenceLabels, managementLabels, sourceLabel } from '../../services/adminFormatting.js'
import AdminInterestModal from '../AdminInterestModal/AdminInterestModal.jsx'
import AdminPasswordForm from '../AdminPasswordForm/AdminPasswordForm.jsx'
import AdminDashboardSkeleton from './AdminDashboardSkeleton.jsx'
import './AdminDashboard.css'

export default function AdminDashboard({ onExpired, onPasswordChanged, load = getAdminInterests }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('all')
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ mode: 'all', interest: '', reading: 'unread' })
  const [cursors, setCursors] = useState([null])
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null)
  const [passwordOpen, setPasswordOpen] = useState(false)
  const key = JSON.stringify({ filters, cursor: cursors.at(-1) })
  const query = useAdminQuery(load, key)
  useEffect(() => { if (query.error?.status === 'unauthorized') onExpired() }, [query.error, onExpired])
  function apply(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    if (mode === 'range' && form.get('end') < form.get('start')) {
      event.currentTarget.elements.end.setCustomValidity('La fecha final debe ser igual o posterior a la inicial.')
      event.currentTarget.elements.end.reportValidity()
      return
    }
    const next = { mode, interest: form.get('interest'), reading: form.get('reading') }
    if (mode === 'day') next.day = form.get('day')
    if (mode === 'month') next.month = form.get('month')
    if (mode === 'range') { next.start = form.get('start'); next.end = form.get('end') }
    setFilters(next); setCursors([null]); setSelected(null)
    if (JSON.stringify(next) === JSON.stringify(filters) && cursors.length === 1) query.reload()
  }
  const data = query.data
  return <div className="admin-dashboard">
    <section className="admin-dashboard__intro"><div><p className="admin-dashboard__eyebrow">Vista general</p><h1>Intereses recibidos</h1><p>Revisa cada solicitud y encuentra el momento para responder.</p></div>
      <button type="button" aria-expanded={passwordOpen} onClick={() => setPasswordOpen((value) => !value)}>Cambiar contraseña</button></section>
    {passwordOpen && <AdminPasswordForm onChanged={onPasswordChanged} onExpired={onExpired} />}
    <form className="admin-dashboard__filters" onSubmit={apply} aria-label="Filtrar intereses">
      <label>Período<select name="mode" value={mode} onChange={(event) => setMode(event.target.value)}>
        <option value="all">Todo el historial</option><option value="day">Un día</option><option value="month">Un mes</option><option value="range">Rango de fechas</option>
      </select></label>
      {mode === 'day' && <label>Día<input name="day" type="date" required /></label>}
      {mode === 'month' && <label>Mes<input name="month" type="month" required /></label>}
      {mode === 'range' && <><label>Desde<input name="start" type="date" required onChange={(event) => event.currentTarget.form.elements.end.setCustomValidity('')} /></label><label>Hasta<input name="end" type="date" required onChange={(event) => event.currentTarget.setCustomValidity('')} /></label></>}
      <label>Servicio<select name="interest"><option value="">Todos los servicios</option>{Object.entries(interestLabels).map(([value, label]) => <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>)}</select></label>
      <label>Lectura<select name="reading" defaultValue="unread"><option value="unread">Nuevos (sin leer)</option><option value="read">Leídos</option><option value="all">Todos</option></select></label>
      <button type="submit" disabled={query.pending}>Aplicar filtros</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => { setCursors([null]); query.reload() }} disabled={query.pending}>Actualizar</button>
      <p>Fechas en America/Santiago. Los rangos incluyen ambos días.</p>
    </form>
    {query.pending && <AdminDashboardSkeleton />}
    {query.error && <div className="admin-dashboard__error" role="alert"><p>{adminErrorMessage(query.error)}</p><button type="button" onClick={query.reload}>Reintentar carga</button></div>}
    {data && !query.pending && <>
      <section className="admin-dashboard__metrics" aria-label="Resumen de intereses">
        <article><span>Historial completo</span><strong>{data.all_total}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Con los filtros aplicados</span><strong>{data.summary.total}</strong></article>
        {Object.entries(interestLabels).map(([value, label]) => <article key={value}><span>{label}</span><strong>{data.summary[value]}</strong></article>)}
      </section>
      <div className="admin-dashboard__list-heading"><h2>Solicitudes</h2><p>{data.summary.new} nuevas · {data.summary.read || 0} leídas · {data.summary.form} desde formularios · {data.summary.chatbot} desde el asistente</p></div>
      {data.items.length ? <div className="admin-dashboard__table-wrap"><table><caption>Intereses del filtro aplicado, del más reciente al más antiguo</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Persona</th><th scope="col">Interés</th><th scope="col">Fecha</th><th scope="col">Origen</th><th scope="col">Contacto</th><th scope="col">Lectura</th><th scope="col">Gestión</th><th scope="col">Detalle</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{data.items.map((item) => <tr key={item.id}><td>{item.full_name}</td><td>{interestLabels[item.interest] || item.interest}</td><td>{adminDate(item.created_at)}</td><td>{sourceLabel(item.source)}</td><td>{preferenceLabels[item.contact_preference] || 'Sin registro'}</td><td><span className="admin-dashboard__badge">{item.read_at ? 'Leído' : 'Nuevo'}</span></td><td>{managementLabels[item.management_status] || 'Sin registro'}</td><td><button type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(item.id)} aria-label={`Ver detalle de ${item.full_name}`}>Ver detalle ↗</button></td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
        : <p className="admin-dashboard__empty" role="status">No hay intereses para los filtros seleccionados.</p>}
      <nav className="admin-dashboard__pagination" aria-label="Páginas de intereses">
        <button type="button" disabled={cursors.length === 1} onClick={() => setCursors((values) => values.slice(0, -1))}>Anterior</button>
        <span>Página {cursors.length} · hasta 20 solicitudes por página</span>
        <button type="button" disabled={!data.next_cursor} onClick={() => setCursors((values) => [...values, data.next_cursor])}>Siguiente</button>
      </nav>
    </>}
    {selected && <AdminInterestModal key={selected} id={selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} onExpired={onExpired} onRead={() => { setCursors([null]); query.reload() }} />}
  </div>
}
```

```jsx
vi.mock('../AdminInterestModal/AdminInterestModal.jsx', () => ({ default: ({ id, onClose, onRead }) => <div role="dialog" aria-label="Detalle simulado"><p>{id}</p><button onClick={onClose}>Cerrar</button><button onClick={onRead}>Lectura simulada</button></div> }))

const data = { all_total: 45, summary: { total: 25, consultation: 5, course: 5, online: 5, nature: 10, new: 20, form: 15, chatbot: 10 }, items: [item], next_cursor: { created_at: item.created_at, id: item.id } }

afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

  render(<AdminDashboardSkeleton />)

})

  const load = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(data)

  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Período'), { target: { value: 'month' } })

  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ver detalle de Persona de prueba' }))

  expect(expired).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})
it('starts with unread interests, refreshes after a read and permits read/all filters', async () => {
  const load = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(data)
  render(<AdminDashboard load={load} onExpired={vi.fn()} onPasswordChanged={vi.fn()} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(JSON.parse(load.mock.calls[0][1]).filters.reading).toBe('unread')
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Siguiente' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ver detalle de Persona de prueba' }))
  load.mockResolvedValue({ ...data, items: [], next_cursor: null, summary: { ...data.summary, new: 0 } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Lectura simulada' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(JSON.parse(load.mock.calls.at(-1)[1]).cursor).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.getByText(/0 nuevas/)).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.queryByText('Persona de prueba')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cerrar' }))
  for (const reading of ['read', 'all']) {
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Lectura'), { target: { value: reading } })
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Aplicar filtros' }))
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
    expect(JSON.parse(load.mock.calls.at(-1)[1]).filters.reading).toBe(reading)
  }
})
```

### `src/components/AdminInterestModal/AdminInterestModal.jsx`

SHA-256: `c8f180dc6424d6dc101caa88c1855c030e08bf108927ce60b1b8a89e24a10049` · 68 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { useAdminQuery } from '../../hooks/useAdminQuery/useAdminQuery.js'
import { getAdminInterest, markAdminInterestRead, adminErrorMessage } from '../../services/adminService.js'
import { useDelayedOperation } from '../../hooks/useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js'
import { adminDate, interestLabels, preferenceLabels, managementLabels, sourceLabel } from '../../services/adminFormatting.js'
import AdminInterestModalSkeleton from './AdminInterestModalSkeleton.jsx'
import './AdminInterestModal.css'

const consent = (value) => value === true ? 'Sí' : value === false ? 'No' : 'Sin registro'

export default function AdminInterestModal({ id, onClose, onExpired, onRead, load = getAdminInterest, markRead = markAdminInterestRead }) {
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const query = useAdminQuery(load, id)
  const operation = useDelayedOperation(15000)
  const [readAt, setReadAt] = useState(null)
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState(null)
  function markAsRead() {
    setSaveError(null)
    operation.run((signal) => markRead(id, signal), ({ value, error }) => {
      if (error?.status === 'unauthorized') onExpired()
      else if (error) setSaveError(error)
      else { setReadAt(value.read_at); onRead?.() }
    })
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = document.activeElement
    const dialog = ref.current
    const overflow = document.body.style.overflow
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    dialog.showModal()
    return () => { dialog.close(); document.body.style.overflow = overflow; if (previous?.isConnected) previous.focus() }
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => { if (query.error?.status === 'unauthorized') onExpired() }, [query.error, onExpired])
  const record = query.data?.record
  const effectiveReadAt = readAt || record?.read_at
  const fields = record ? [
    ['Nombre', record.full_name], ['Interés', interestLabels[record.interest] || record.interest],
    ['Registrado', adminDate(record.created_at)], ['Correo', record.email], ['Teléfono', record.phone],
    ['Preferencia de contacto', preferenceLabels[record.contact_preference] || record.contact_preference],
    ['Canal registrado', preferenceLabels[record.contact_channel] || record.contact_channel],
    ['País', record.country], ['Ciudad', record.city], ['Experiencia', record.experience],
    ['Origen', sourceLabel(record.source)], ['Página de origen', record.source_path],
    ['Estado de gestión', managementLabels[record.management_status] || record.management_status],
    ['Lectura', effectiveReadAt ? 'Leído' : 'Nuevo'], ['Fecha de lectura', adminDate(effectiveReadAt)],
    ['Autoriza privacidad', consent(record.privacy_consent)], ['Versión de privacidad', record.privacy_version],
    ['Fecha de autorización', adminDate(record.privacy_accepted_at)],
    ['Autoriza contacto', consent(record.contact_consent)], ['Fecha de contacto autorizado', adminDate(record.contact_accepted_at)],
    ['Autoriza novedades', consent(record.updates_consent)], ['Identificador', record.id],
  ] : []
  return createPortal(<dialog ref={ref} className="admin-interest-modal" aria-labelledby="interest-detail-title"
    onCancel={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); onClose() }} onClick={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose() }}>
    <div className="admin-interest-modal__content">
      <header><div><p>Solicitud de contacto</p><h2 id="interest-detail-title">Detalle del interés</h2></div><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar detalle">×</button></header>
      <p className="admin-interest-modal__timezone">Fechas en horario de Chile.</p>
      {query.pending && <AdminInterestModalSkeleton />}
      {query.error && <div role="alert"><p>{adminErrorMessage(query.error)}</p><button type="button" onClick={query.reload}>Reintentar detalle</button></div>}
      {record && !query.pending && <section className="admin-interest-modal__reading" aria-label="Lectura del interés" aria-busy={operation.pending}>
        <p>{effectiveReadAt ? 'Este interés ya está leído y no aparece en Nuevos.' : 'Cuando termines de revisarlo, márcalo como leído para quitarlo de Nuevos.'}</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={markAsRead} disabled={operation.pending || Boolean(effectiveReadAt)}>{effectiveReadAt ? 'Leído' : 'Marcar como leído'}</button>
        {operation.pending && <AdminInterestModalSkeleton compact label="Guardando lectura" />}
        {saveError && <p role="alert">{adminErrorMessage(saveError)}</p>}
        {readAt && <p role="status">Interés marcado como leído.</p>}
      </section>}
      {record && !query.pending && <dl>{fields.map(([label, value]) => <div key={label}><dt>{label}</dt><dd>{value || 'Sin registro'}</dd></div>)}</dl>}
    </div>
  </dialog>, document.body)
}
```

```jsx
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import AdminInterestModal from './AdminInterestModal.jsx'
import AdminInterestModalSkeleton from './AdminInterestModalSkeleton.jsx'

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.useFakeTimers()
  HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal = function () { this.setAttribute('open', '') }
  HTMLDialogElement.prototype.close = function () { this.removeAttribute('open') }

  render(<AdminInterestModalSkeleton />)

})
it('loads one record, reveals after 800 ms and supports close and focus restoration', async () => {

  const trigger = document.createElement('button')
  document.body.append(trigger); trigger.focus()

  expect(screen.getByRole('dialog')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Cargando detalle')).toBeInTheDocument()

  expect(screen.getByText('unit@example.invalid')).toBeInTheDocument()

  render(<AdminInterestModal id="unit" load={load} onClose={close} onExpired={vi.fn()} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reintentar detalle' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.getByText('Recuperado')).toBeInTheDocument()
  fireEvent(screen.getByRole('dialog'), new Event('cancel', { bubbles: false, cancelable: true }))
  expect(close).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})
it('marks a reviewed interest only on request and reveals success after response plus 800 ms', async () => {
  let finish
  const markRead = vi.fn(() => new Promise((resolve) => { finish = resolve })), onRead = vi.fn()
  render(<AdminInterestModal id="unit" onClose={vi.fn()} onExpired={vi.fn()} onRead={onRead} markRead={markRead}
    load={vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ record: { id: 'unit', full_name: 'Persona de prueba', read_at: null } })} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(markRead).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Marcar como leído' }))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Guardando lectura')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Marcar como leído' })).toBeDisabled()
  await act(async () => { await Promise.resolve(); finish({ status: 'ready', read_at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z' }) })
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
  expect(onRead).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(onRead).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Leído' })).toBeDisabled()
  expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Interés marcado como leído')
})
it('keeps a failed write unread and allows retry; an existing read cannot be marked twice', async () => {
  const markRead = vi.fn().mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('network')).mockResolvedValue({ status: 'ready', read_at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z' }), onRead = vi.fn()
  const { unmount } = render(<AdminInterestModal id="unit" onClose={vi.fn()} onExpired={vi.fn()} onRead={onRead} markRead={markRead}
    load={vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ record: { id: 'unit', full_name: 'Persona de prueba' } })} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Marcar como leído' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('No pudimos')
  expect(onRead).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Marcar como leído' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(onRead).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  unmount()
  render(<AdminInterestModal id="unit" onClose={vi.fn()} onExpired={vi.fn()} markRead={markRead}
    load={vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ record: { id: 'unit', read_at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z' } })} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Leído' })).toBeDisabled()
  expect(markRead).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
})
```

### `src/components/AdminLogin/AdminLogin.jsx`

SHA-256: `c85b9b79236c2ddae4240b6ad233daedadfcbd307ab089e1ded6b96e9ce06909` · 37 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useDelayedOperation } from '../../hooks/useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js'
import { adminRequest, adminErrorMessage } from '../../services/adminService.js'
import AdminLoginSkeleton from './AdminLoginSkeleton.jsx'
import './AdminLogin.css'

export default function AdminLogin({ onAuthenticated, notice, request = adminRequest }) {
  const [error, setError] = useState(null)
  const remote = useDelayedOperation(15000)
  function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    const values = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    const payload = { operation: 'login', username: values.get('username'), password: values.get('password') }
    setError(null)
    remote.run((signal) => request(payload, signal), ({ value, error: failure }) => {
      if (failure) setError(failure)
      else onAuthenticated(value.username)
    })
  }
  return <section className="admin-login" aria-labelledby="admin-login-title">
    <p className="admin-login__eyebrow">Nicolás Zamara · Administración</p>
    <h1 id="admin-login-title">Un espacio para gestionar tus intereses.</h1>
    <p>Ingresa para revisar las solicitudes de contacto y su información.</p>
    {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
    <form onSubmit={submit} aria-busy={remote.pending}>
      <fieldset disabled={remote.pending}>
        <legend>Acceso privado</legend>
        <label>Usuario<input name="username" autoComplete="username" required maxLength={80} /></label>
        <label>Contraseña<input name="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required maxLength={128} /></label>
        <button type="submit">Ingresar</button>
      </fieldset>
    </form>
    {remote.pending && <AdminLoginSkeleton />}
    {error && <p role="alert">{adminErrorMessage(error)}</p>}
    <a href="/">Volver al sitio</a>
  </section>
}
```
