### `src/components/AdminPasswordForm/AdminPasswordForm.jsx`

SHA-256: `5fe745be4b6b848e409ef318e4487e0d07a4c416ff1ef1f8b95ab3ea4d894b27` · 36 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useDelayedOperation } from '../../hooks/useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js'
import { adminRequest, adminErrorMessage } from '../../services/adminService.js'
import AdminPasswordFormSkeleton from './AdminPasswordFormSkeleton.jsx'
import './AdminPasswordForm.css'

export default function AdminPasswordForm({ onChanged, onExpired, request = adminRequest }) {
  const remote = useDelayedOperation(15000)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    const fields = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    if (fields.get('newPassword') !== fields.get('confirmation')) { setError('Las contraseñas nuevas no coinciden.'); return }
    setError('')
    remote.run((signal) => request({ operation: 'password', currentPassword: fields.get('currentPassword'), newPassword: fields.get('newPassword') }, signal), ({ error: failure }) => {
      if (failure?.status === 'unauthorized') onExpired()
      else if (failure) setError(adminErrorMessage(failure))
      else onChanged()
    })
  }
  return <section className="admin-password" aria-labelledby="admin-password-title">
    <h2 id="admin-password-title">Cambiar contraseña</h2>
    <p>Usa entre 12 y 128 caracteres. El cambio cerrará todas las sesiones, incluida esta.</p>
    <form onSubmit={submit} aria-busy={remote.pending}>
      <fieldset disabled={remote.pending}>
        <legend>Actualizar acceso</legend>
        <label>Contraseña actual<input type="password" name="currentPassword" autoComplete="current-password" required maxLength={128} /></label>
        <label>Nueva contraseña<input type="password" name="newPassword" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={12} maxLength={128} /></label>
        <label>Confirmar nueva contraseña<input type="password" name="confirmation" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={12} maxLength={128} /></label>
        <button type="submit">Guardar contraseña</button>
      </fieldset>
    </form>
    {remote.pending && <AdminPasswordFormSkeleton />}
    {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
  </section>
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-components-adminpasswordform-adminpasswordform-test-jsx"></a>

### `src/components/AdminPasswordForm/AdminPasswordForm.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `f9a7380579d4889ad3de97d9488e7b1ba1d784e9d930bf1990ed0617ab7d0f55` · 41 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import AdminPasswordForm from './AdminPasswordForm.jsx'
import AdminPasswordFormSkeleton from './AdminPasswordFormSkeleton.jsx'
import { AdminError } from '../../services/adminService.js'

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())
function fill() {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Contraseña actual'), { target: { value: 'old-password' } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Nueva contraseña'), { target: { value: 'a-new-password' } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Confirmar nueva contraseña'), { target: { value: 'a-new-password' } })
}
it('renders a pending skeleton without its own delay', () => {
  render(<AdminPasswordFormSkeleton />)
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Guardando contraseña')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
})
it('requires matching passwords, then reports change after the remote delay', async () => {
  const request = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ status: 'password_changed' }), changed = vi.fn()
  render(<AdminPasswordForm request={request} onChanged={changed} onExpired={vi.fn()} />)
  fill()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Confirmar nueva contraseña'), { target: { value: 'different-password' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar contraseña' }))
  expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('no coinciden')
  expect(request).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Confirmar nueva contraseña'), { target: { value: 'a-new-password' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar contraseña' }))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Guardando contraseña')).toBeInTheDocument()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
  expect(changed).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})
it('returns an expired session to the login flow', async () => {
  const expired = vi.fn()
  render(<AdminPasswordForm request={vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new AdminError('unauthorized'))} onChanged={vi.fn()} onExpired={expired} />)
  fill()
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar contraseña' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(expired).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
})
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import './AnalyticsConsent.css'

export default function AnalyticsConsent({ consent, onSave, onClose }) {
  const [configure, setConfigure] = useState(false)
  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState(consent.analytics)
  const [experience, setExperience] = useState(consent.experience)
  return <section className="analytics-consent" aria-labelledby="analytics-consent-title" data-clarity-mask="true">
    <h2 id="analytics-consent-title">Tus preferencias de privacidad</h2>
    <p>Con tu permiso podemos medir qué secciones son útiles y observar cómo se usa la página para mejorarla.
      Puedes rechazar estas herramientas y seguir consultando nuestros servicios. <a href="/privacidad">Más información</a>.</p>
    {configure && <fieldset>
      <legend>Elige qué permites</legend>
      <label><input type="checkbox" checked={analytics} onChange={(event) => setAnalytics(event.target.checked)} />Analítica de navegación y conversiones</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" checked={experience} onChange={(event) => setExperience(event.target.checked)} />Mapas de interacción y reconstrucción de sesiones con contenido protegido</label>
      <p>Estas preferencias son independientes de las autorizaciones para contactarte y enviarte novedades.</p>
    </fieldset>}
    <div className="analytics-consent__actions">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onSave({ analytics: false, experience: false })}>Rechazar opcionales</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onSave({ analytics: true, experience: true })}>Aceptar opcionales</button>
      {configure
        ? <button type="button" onClick={() => onSave({ analytics, experience })}>Guardar preferencias</button>
        : <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfigure(true)}>Configurar</button>}
      {consent.status !== 'unknown' && <button type="button" onClick={onClose}>Cerrar preferencias</button>}
    </div>
  </section>
}
```

### `src/components/AnalyticsConsent/AnalyticsConsent.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `625684702bdaabbea648c488331d2b6a5613d26571edc8270cdbc9945e13a4d5` · 36 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import AnalyticsConsent from './AnalyticsConsent.jsx'
import AnalyticsConsentSkeleton from './AnalyticsConsentSkeleton.jsx'
import { UNKNOWN_CONSENT } from '../../services/consentService.js'

describe('AnalyticsConsent', () => {
  it('offers equally available acceptance and rejection without selecting categories', () => {
    const save = vi.fn()
    render(<AnalyticsConsent consent={UNKNOWN_CONSENT} onSave={save} />)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rechazar opcionales' }))
    expect(save).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ analytics: false, experience: false })
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Aceptar opcionales' }))
    expect(save).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ analytics: true, experience: true })
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Cerrar preferencias' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
  it('saves categories independently and does not touch form consents', () => {
    const save = vi.fn()
    render(<AnalyticsConsent consent={UNKNOWN_CONSENT} onSave={save} />)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Configurar' }))
    const checkboxes = screen.getAllByRole('checkbox')
    expect(checkboxes.every((input) => !input.checked)).toBe(true)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /mapas de interacción/i }))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar preferencias' }))
    expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ analytics: false, experience: true })
  })
  it('can close existing preferences and displays a noninteractive skeleton immediately', () => {
    const close = vi.fn()
    const { rerender, container } = render(<AnalyticsConsent consent={{ ...UNKNOWN_CONSENT, status: 'rejected' }} onClose={close} />)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cerrar preferencias' }))
    expect(close).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    rerender(<AnalyticsConsentSkeleton />)
    expect(container.firstChild).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
```

```jsx
import ActionLink from '../ActionLink/ActionLink.jsx'
import './AreaGrid.css'
import { ctaAttributes } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'

const areaTypes = { '/consulta': ['consultation', 'consultation'], '/cursos': ['courses', 'course'], '/naturaleza': ['nature', 'nature'] }
function measurement(area, type) {
  const values = areaTypes[area.href]
  return values ? { element_id: `area_${values[0]}_${type}`, placement: 'home_areas', service: values[1] } : undefined
}

const illustrations = [
  'M59 100V57M59 75C34 77 23 61 24 45C44 42 56 53 59 68M60 58C61 37 75 26 95 28C95 47 80 58 60 58M48 98H72M58 49C44 38 44 22 57 13C71 22 73 37 58 49',
  'M60 92C45 80 30 77 15 80V25C31 23 48 28 60 40C72 28 89 23 105 25V80C90 77 75 80 60 92ZM60 40V92M27 40C37 41 43 44 49 49M27 53C36 54 43 57 49 61M73 49C80 44 87 41 94 40M73 61C80 57 87 54 94 53',
  'M10 96L47 35L72 74L88 50L112 96ZM33 58L47 63L59 55M80 65L88 72L95 63M79 25A10 10 0 1 0 99 25A10 10 0 1 0 79 25M21 108H102',
]

export default function AreaGrid({ areas }) {
  return (
    <div className="area-grid">
      {areas.map((area, index) => (
        <article className="area-card" key={area.number}>
          <a className="area-card__visual" href={area.href} aria-label={`Ir a ${area.title}`} {...ctaAttributes(measurement(area, 'visual'))} onClick={() => {
            const params = measurement(area, 'visual')
            if (params) trackEvent('cta_click', { ...params, destination_path: area.href })
          }}><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 120 120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d={illustrations[index % illustrations.length]} /></svg></a>
          <span className="area-card__number">{area.number}</span>
          <h3>{area.title}</h3>
          <p>{area.description}</p>
          <ActionLink analytics={measurement(area, 'text')} className="area-card__link" href={area.href} variant="text">{area.link} <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></ActionLink>
        </article>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import BrandMark from './BrandMark.jsx'
import BrandMarkSkeleton from './BrandMarkSkeleton.jsx'

describe('BrandMark', () => {
  it('respeta el nombre y el descriptor recibidos', () => {
    render(<BrandMark name="Nicolás Zamara" descriptor="Consulta y naturaleza" />)
    expect(screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Nicolás Zamara' })).toHaveAttribute('src', '/brand/nicolas-zamara-logo.svg')

    expect(screen.getByText('Consulta y naturaleza')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('permite omitir el descriptor y presenta un skeleton decorativo', () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(<BrandMark name="Nicolás" />)
    expect(container.querySelector('.brand-mark__descriptor')).toBeNull()
    rerender(<BrandMarkSkeleton />)
    expect(container.firstChild).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
  })
})
```

### `src/components/ChatContactForm/ChatContactForm.jsx`

SHA-256: `07ab94cd3bfb7cdcc6de64977e550f8c3401dae6ac44165434021d72721f02dc` · 73 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { submitInterest } from '../../services/interestService.js'
import { useContactCapture } from '../../hooks/useContactCapture/useContactCapture.js'
import ContactPreference from '../ContactPreference/ContactPreference.jsx'
import contactConfig from '../../../config/interests/contact.config.json'
import ChatContactFormSkeleton from './ChatContactFormSkeleton.jsx'
import './ChatContactForm.css'
import { useFormMetrics } from '../../hooks/useFormMetrics/useFormMetrics.js'
import { useHydrated } from '../../contexts/HydrationContext/HydrationContext.jsx'

const services = { consultation: 'Consulta y terapias', course: 'Curso actual', online: 'Curso online', nature: 'Naturaleza' }
const preferences = Object.fromEntries(contactConfig.preferences.map(({ value, label }) => [value, label]))

export default function ChatContactForm({ conversationId, initialTopic, onCancel, onSaved, submitContact = submitInterest, placement = 'floating_chat_form' }) {
  const hydrated = useHydrated()
  const [service, setService] = useState(initialTopic === 'therapies' ? 'consultation' : services[initialTopic] ? initialTopic : '')
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [preference, setPreference] = useState('')
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false)
  const [updates, setUpdates] = useState(false)
  const [review, setReview] = useState(false)
  const metrics = useFormMetrics({ kind: 'chat_contact', placement, service, source: 'chatbot' })
  const capture = useContactCapture(submitContact, onSaved, metrics)

  function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    if (!event.currentTarget.reportValidity()) return
    if (!review) { setReview(true); return }
    if (!consent) return
    const fields = { source: 'chatbot', interest: service, conversation_id: conversationId,
      values: { name, phone, email, contactPreference: preference }, privacyConsent: true, contactConsent: true, updatesConsent: updates }
    capture.save(fields)
  }

  function edit() {
    setReview(false)
    setConsent(false)
    capture.reset()
  }

  if (capture.status === 'saved') return <p className="chat-contact__saved" role="status">Recibimos tu solicitud. Te contactaremos por el canal que elegiste.</p>
  return <form className="chat-contact" aria-label="Solicitud de contacto" onSubmit={submit} data-clarity-mask="true"
    onFocusCapture={() => metrics.start()} onChange={() => metrics.start()} onInvalidCapture={(event) => metrics.invalid(event.target)}>
    <p>Déjanos tus datos para que podamos contactarte. Este formulario no confirma una reserva.</p>
    <p className="chat-contact__review-notice">Versión de pruebas: utiliza datos ficticios para probar este formulario.</p>
    <fieldset disabled={!hydrated || capture.pending}>
      <label>Servicio<select required value={service} onChange={(event) => { setService(event.target.value); edit() }}>
        <option value="">Elige un servicio</option>{Object.entries(services).map(([value, label]) => <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>)}
      </select></label>
      <label>Tu nombre<input name="name" required maxLength={120} autoComplete="name" value={name} onChange={(event) => { setName(event.target.value); edit() }} /></label>
      <ContactPreference value={preference} onChange={(event) => { setPreference(event.target.value); edit() }} />
      <label>Número con prefijo internacional<input name="phone" required type="tel" autoComplete="tel" maxLength={30}
        pattern="\+[1-9][0-9 ]{6,24}" placeholder="+56 9 1234 5678"
        value={phone} onChange={(event) => { setPhone(event.target.value); edit() }} /></label>
      <label>Correo de contacto<input name="email" required type="email"
        autoComplete="email" maxLength={254} placeholder="nombre@correo.cl"
        value={email} onChange={(event) => { setEmail(event.target.value); edit() }} /></label>
      {preference === 'video_call' && <p>Usaremos tu correo para coordinar la videollamada. La solicitud no confirma una cita.</p>}
      {review && <div className="chat-contact__review">
        <p>Revisa tu solicitud: {services[service]}, {name}. Preferencia: {preferences[preference]}. Teléfono: {phone}{email ? `. Correo: ${email}` : ''}. Puedes corregir los campos antes de enviar.</p>
        <label className="chat-contact__check"><input name="privacyConsent" type="checkbox" required checked={consent} onChange={(event) => setConsent(event.target.checked)} />
          Autorizo que el equipo de Nicolás Zamara use estos datos para contactarme por el servicio indicado, según la <a href="/privacidad" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">información de privacidad</a>.</label>
        <label className="chat-contact__check"><input type="checkbox" checked={updates} onChange={(event) => setUpdates(event.target.checked)} />También quiero recibir novedades relacionadas (opcional).</label>
      </div>}
      <div className="chat-contact__buttons"><button type="submit">{review ? 'Solicitar contacto' : 'Revisar solicitud'}</button><button type="button" onClick={onCancel}>Cancelar</button></div>
    </fieldset>
    {capture.pending && <ChatContactFormSkeleton />}
    {capture.status === 'unavailable' && <p role="alert">No pudimos confirmar el registro. Conservamos los campos para que puedas reintentar.</p>}
    {capture.status === 'rate_limited' && <p role="alert">Recibimos varios intentos. Espera un momento antes de reintentar.</p>}
  </form>
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-components-chatcontactform-chatcontactform-test-jsx"></a>

### `src/components/ChatContactForm/ChatContactForm.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `108a3d546ea2d1048e70c585770795f681f262b1be8f764418a3a661acac2b87` · 86 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import ChatContactForm from './ChatContactForm.jsx'

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())
function fill(preference = 'whatsapp') {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Tu nombre'), { target: { value: 'Ana' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: preference === 'phone' ? 'Teléfono' : preference === 'video_call' ? 'Videollamada' : 'WhatsApp' }))
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Número con prefijo internacional'), { target: { value: '+56912345678' } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Correo de contacto'), { target: { value: 'ana@example.invalid' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revisar solicitud' }))
}
function authorize() { fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /autorizo que el equipo/i })) }
function props(extra = {}) { return { conversationId: 'conversation', initialTopic: 'consultation', onSaved: vi.fn(), onCancel: vi.fn(), ...extra } }
describe('ChatContactForm', () => {
  it('requires a review and explicit contact consent with optional updates unchecked', () => {
    const submitContact = vi.fn()
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ submitContact })} />)
    fill()
    expect(screen.getByText(/revisa tu solicitud/i)).toHaveTextContent('Ana')
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('checkbox').every((input) => !input.checked)).toBe(true)
    expect(screen.getByText(/versión de pruebas/i)).toHaveTextContent('utiliza datos ficticios')
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByRole('form'))
    expect(submitContact).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
  it('saves the required phone and preference and delays success after the request', async () => {
    const submitContact = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ status: 'saved' }), onSaved = vi.fn()
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ submitContact, onSaved })} />)
    fill('phone'); authorize()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Solicitar contacto' }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('status', { name: 'Guardando solicitud de contacto' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
    expect(onSaved).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(/recibimos tu solicitud/i)
    expect(submitContact.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchObject({ source: 'chatbot', contactConsent: true, updatesConsent: false,
      values: { name: 'Ana', contactPreference: 'phone', phone: '+56912345678', email: 'ana@example.invalid' } })
    expect(submitContact.mock.calls[0][0]).not.toHaveProperty('messages')
  })
  it('keeps fields and request ID for retry after a save failure', async () => {
    const submitContact = vi.fn().mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('offline')).mockResolvedValue({ status: 'saved' })
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ submitContact })} />)
    fill(); authorize()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Solicitar contacto' }))
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(/no pudimos confirmar/i)
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Tu nombre')).toHaveValue('Ana')
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Solicitar contacto' }))
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
    expect(submitContact.mock.calls[0][0].request_id).toBe(submitContact.mock.calls[1][0].request_id)
  })
  it('lets the visitor cancel without submitting', () => {
    const onCancel = vi.fn(), submitContact = vi.fn()
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ onCancel, submitContact })} />)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancelar' }))
    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    expect(submitContact).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
  it('requires an explicit preference and an email for all channels', () => {
    const submitContact = vi.fn()
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ submitContact })} />)
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('radio').every((radio) => !radio.checked)).toBe(true)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Videollamada' }))
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Correo de contacto')).toBeRequired()
    expect(screen.getByText(/no confirma una cita/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Teléfono' }))
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Correo de contacto')).toBeRequired()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'WhatsApp' }))
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Correo de contacto')).toBeRequired()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('radio', { name: 'Mail' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
  it.each(['Videollamada', 'Teléfono', 'WhatsApp'])('blocks the review without an email when choosing %s', (label) => {
    const submitContact = vi.fn()
    render(<ChatContactForm {...props({ submitContact })} />)
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Tu nombre'), { target: { value: 'Ana' } })
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Número con prefijo internacional'), { target: { value: '+56912345678' } })
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: label }))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revisar solicitud' }))
    expect(screen.queryByText(/revisa tu solicitud/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(submitContact).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Correo de contacto'), { target: { value: 'ana@example.invalid' } })
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revisar solicitud' }))
    expect(screen.getByText(/revisa tu solicitud/i)).toHaveTextContent(label)
  })
})
```

### `src/components/Chatbot/Chatbot.css`

SHA-256: `fce5e816b9736fd8172a2f801e14545c48a2721c9582a16a857d068784a494af` · 124 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```css
.chatbot {
  --chat-accent: #b4d6be;
  --chat-edge: #7baf9d;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 40;
  right: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right));
  bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--color-ink);
}
.chatbot [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.chatbot__launcher { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 32px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-navy); }
.chatbot__invitation { position: absolute; right: calc(100% + 14px); top: 50%; width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw - 110px); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #bdc9bf; border-radius: 15px 15px 4px 15px; background: #f5f3ee; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgb(5 35 75 / 9%); font-size: .71rem; text-align: left; line-height: 1.6; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transform: translate(6px, -50%); transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease, visibility 0s linear .2s; }
.chatbot__invitation--visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto; transform: translate(0, -50%); transition-delay: 0s; }
.chatbot__invitation > span { display: block; color: var(--color-sage-ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem; }
.chatbot__launcher-orb { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 60px; width: 60px; height: 60px; border: 1px solid #8db9a7; border-radius: 22px 22px 8px 22px; color: #d4ebda; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 0%, #355850, transparent 65%), var(--color-navy); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #0d2c40, inset 0 0 0 5px rgb(180 214 190 / 16%), 0 8px 24px rgb(5 35 75 / 25%), 0 0 18px rgb(123 175 157 / 20%); transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s; }
.chatbot__launcher-orb > svg { width: 29px; height: 29px; }
.chatbot__launcher:hover .chatbot__launcher-orb { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #0d2c40, inset 0 0 0 5px rgb(180 214 190 / 35%), 0 10px 28px rgb(5 35 75 / 24%), 0 0 22px rgb(123 175 157 / 40%); }
.chatbot__signal { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 2px solid #183c41; border-radius: 50%; background: #d6e9ba; }
.chatbot__backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: rgb(5 23 39 / 38%); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); touch-action: none; animation: chat-backdrop-in var(--chat-modal-duration) ease-out both; }
.chatbot__panel { position: fixed; z-index: 1; right: 0; bottom: var(--chat-viewport-bottom, 0px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: min(440px, 100vw); height: var(--chat-viewport-height, 100dvh); max-height: var(--chat-viewport-height, 100dvh); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); overflow: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #8ba99c; border-radius: 24px 0 0 24px; background: #f4f2ed; box-shadow: -16px 0 60px rgb(5 35 75 / 20%); animation: chat-enter var(--chat-modal-duration) cubic-bezier(.22, .7, .3, 1) both; }
.chatbot--closing .chatbot__panel { animation: chat-exit var(--chat-modal-duration) ease-in both; }
.chatbot--closing .chatbot__backdrop { animation: chat-backdrop-out var(--chat-modal-duration) ease-in both; }
.chatbot__panel, .chatbot__messages, .chatbot__links, .chatbot__prompts[aria-label], .chatbot__form textarea { scrollbar-width: none; }
.chatbot__panel::-webkit-scrollbar, .chatbot__messages::-webkit-scrollbar, .chatbot__links::-webkit-scrollbar, .chatbot__prompts::-webkit-scrollbar, .chatbot__form textarea::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; width: 0; height: 0; }
.chatbot__panel:focus { outline: none; }
.chatbot__panel > * { flex-shrink: 0; }
.chatbot__header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) 18px 18px; color: #f4f2ed; background: linear-gradient(115deg, var(--color-navy) 35%, #294b48); border-bottom: 1px solid #91b5a0; }
.chatbot__header::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 22px; right: 22px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #c6e4c8, transparent); }
.chatbot__header::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -3px; left: 26px; width: 44px; height: 4px; border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; background: var(--chat-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(180 214 190 / 50%); }
.chatbot__emblem { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 48px; color: var(--chat-accent); }
.chatbot__emblem svg { width: 35px; height: 35px; }
.chatbot__identity { display: grid; gap: 2px; line-height: 1.4; min-width: 0; }
.chatbot__identity .chatbot__eyebrow { color: #c5d8c9; font-size: .56rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.chatbot__identity strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.1; }
.chatbot__subtitle { color: #d0dcd4; font-size: .62rem; }
.chatbot__window-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; }
.chatbot__window-actions a, .chatbot__close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #d8e7db; background: transparent; }
.chatbot__window-actions a:hover, .chatbot__close:hover { background: rgb(180 214 190 / 12%); }
.chatbot__window-actions :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--chat-accent); outline-offset: -3px; }
.chatbot__window-actions svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }
.chatbot__intro { position: relative; padding: 22px 22px 6px; background-image: radial-gradient(#7baf9d35 .7px, transparent .7px); background-size: 12px 12px; }
.chatbot__intro-mark { position: absolute; top: 28px; right: 30px; font-size: 2.5rem; color: var(--color-sage-dark); line-height: 1; }
.chatbot__intro h2 { position: relative; margin: 0; max-width: 270px; color: var(--color-navy); font-size: 2.15rem; line-height: 1.12; }
.chatbot__intro p { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: .72rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.chatbot__messages { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 14px; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; min-height: 0; padding: 18px; }
.chatbot__panel > .chatbot__messages { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.chatbot__messages:empty { padding-block: 6px; }
.chatbot__turn { min-width: 0; max-width: 92%; justify-self: start; }
.chatbot__turn--user { justify-self: end; }
.chatbot__message { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 4px 16px 16px; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.75; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.chatbot__message--assistant { border: 1px solid #d1dcd0; background: #fcfbf8; }
.chatbot__message--user { border-radius: 16px 4px 16px 16px; color: #fff; background: #36554e; }
.chatbot__enrollment { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #668e70; border-radius: 12px 12px 4px 12px; color: #fff; background: var(--color-sage-dark); font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; }
.chatbot__enrollment:hover { background: var(--color-sage-ink); }
.chatbot__enrollment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 3px; }
.chatbot__error { margin: 0; color: #8c342b; font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.chatbot__form { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 8px; margin: 0 16px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #a8bcae; border-radius: 16px 16px 5px 16px; background: #fcfbf8; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgb(5 35 75 / 3%); }
.chatbot__form:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-sage-dark); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(123 175 157 / 15%); }
.chatbot__input-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }
.chatbot__form textarea { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 58px; max-height: 120px; resize: vertical; border: 0; outline: none; padding: 4px; color: var(--color-ink); background: transparent; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.chatbot__form textarea::placeholder { color: #66716b; font-size: .8rem; }
.chatbot__form button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #4b7868; border-radius: 13px 13px 4px 13px; color: #e2efdd; background: var(--color-navy); transition: background .15s; }
.chatbot__form button svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; }
.chatbot__form button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #254c48; }
.chatbot__form button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }
.chatbot__send-status { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .7rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.chatbot__links { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 7px; margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 4px 16px 10px; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; }
.chatbot__links a, .chatbot__links button, .chatbot__prompts button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #b6c5b8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #36513b; background: #edf0e8; font-size: .7rem; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.chatbot__links a:hover, .chatbot__links button:hover, .chatbot__prompts button:hover { border-color: #719b7e; background: #e1e9df; }
.chatbot__links :focus-visible, .chatbot__prompts :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: -3px; }
.chatbot__links button:disabled, .chatbot__prompts button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; }
.chatbot__prompts { display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 0 16px 12px; }
.chatbot__prompts button { justify-self: start; white-space: normal; text-align: left; }
.chatbot__prompts[aria-label] { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; }
.chatbot__prompts[aria-label] button { min-height: 44px; font-size: .68rem; background: transparent; white-space: nowrap; }
.chatbot__notice { margin: 0; padding: 4px 18px 14px; color: #59635e; font-size: .62rem; line-height: 1.65; }
.chatbot__notice a { text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.chatbot__panel > .chat-contact { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 120px; margin-top: 16px; }
.chatbot__panel--capturing > .chatbot__messages { flex: 0 1 auto; max-height: 110px; }
.chatbot__panel--capturing .chatbot__intro { display: none; }
.chatbot--embedded { position: static; z-index: auto; min-width: 0; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__panel { position: static; width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: none; padding-bottom: 0; overflow: visible; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; animation: none; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__messages { min-height: 0; max-height: 48dvh; padding: 0 4px 24px; gap: 24px; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__messages--empty { padding: 0; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__turn { max-width: 94%; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__message { font-size: .95rem; padding: 14px 18px; line-height: 1.8; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__message--assistant { border: 0; padding-inline: 0; background: transparent; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__message--user { color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-surface-strong); border-radius: 20px; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__links { margin-top: 18px; padding: 4px 2px 12px; gap: 8px; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__links a, .chatbot--embedded .chatbot__links button { padding: 9px 13px; background: transparent; font-size: .76rem; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__links a:hover, .chatbot--embedded .chatbot__links button:hover { background: var(--color-surface); }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__prompts { padding: 4px 0 12px; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__form { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 24px 24px 8px; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__form textarea { min-height: 84px; max-height: 180px; padding: 7px 0; line-height: 1.6; }
.chatbot--embedded .chatbot__notice { padding: 8px 0 0; font-size: .67rem; text-align: center; }
@keyframes chat-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100%); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
@keyframes chat-exit { from { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100%); } }
@keyframes chat-backdrop-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes chat-backdrop-out { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .chatbot { right: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
  .chatbot__invitation { right: calc(100% + 10px); max-width: calc(100vw - 100px); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: .65rem; }
  .chatbot__launcher-orb { width: 56px; height: 56px; flex-basis: 56px; }
  .chatbot__panel { border-radius: 0; }
  .chatbot__header { padding: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) 14px max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); gap: 8px; }
  .chatbot__emblem { width: 34px; }
  .chatbot__identity strong { font-size: 1.6rem; }
  .chatbot__intro { padding: 24px 18px 8px; }
  .chatbot__intro h2 { font-size: 2rem; }
  .chatbot__messages { padding-inline: 14px; }
  .chatbot__form { margin-inline: 12px; }
  .chatbot__notice { font-size: .6rem; padding-inline: 14px; }
  .chatbot[data-compact] .chatbot__intro, .chatbot[data-compact] .chatbot__prompts[aria-label] { display: none; }
  .chatbot[data-compact] .chatbot__header { padding-block: 8px; }
  .chatbot[data-compact] .chatbot__notice { padding-bottom: 8px; }
  .chatbot--embedded .chatbot__form { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; }
  .chatbot--embedded .chatbot__messages { max-height: 44dvh; }
}
@media (max-height: 600px) {
  .chatbot:not(.chatbot--embedded) .chatbot__intro, .chatbot:not(.chatbot--embedded) .chatbot__prompts[aria-label] { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 360px) { .chatbot__intro-mark { display: none; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .chatbot .chatbot__panel, .chatbot .chatbot__backdrop { animation: none; } .chatbot__launcher-orb, .chatbot__form button, .chatbot__invitation { transition: none; } }
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { ChatbotProvider, useChatbotContext } from '../../contexts/ChatbotContext/ChatbotContext.jsx'
import { useChatbotViewport } from '../../hooks/useChatbotViewport/useChatbotViewport.js'
import { useChatbotModal } from '../../hooks/useChatbotModal/useChatbotModal.js'
import { MODAL_FADE_MS, useModalPresence } from '../../hooks/useModalPresence/useModalPresence.js'
import { useScrollThreshold } from '../../hooks/useScrollThreshold/useScrollThreshold.js'
import { siteSettings } from '../../content/siteContent.js'
import { trackHotmartClick } from '../../services/hotmartTrackingService.js'
import ChatContactForm from '../ChatContactForm/ChatContactForm.jsx'
import ChatReplySkeleton from '../ChatReply/ChatReplySkeleton.jsx'
import './Chatbot.css'
import { ctaAttributes, navigationParams } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'
import FloatingWhatsApp from '../FloatingWhatsApp/FloatingWhatsApp.jsx'

const quickPrompts = ['Quiero conocer las terapias', 'Busco información sobre cursos', 'Quiero consultar disponibilidad']
const serviceLinks = [
  { href: '/consulta', label: 'Consulta' }, { href: '/terapias', label: 'Terapias' },
  { href: '/cursos', label: 'Cursos' }, { href: '/#interes-naturaleza', label: 'Naturaleza' },
  { href: '/cursos#interes-online', label: 'Curso online' },
]

export default function Chatbot({ api, ...props }) {
  const shared = useChatbotContext()
  return shared ? <ChatbotView {...props} {...shared} />
    : <ChatbotProvider api={api}><Chatbot {...props} /></ChatbotProvider>
}

function ChatbotView({ submitContact, embedded = false, hidden = false, chat, open, setOpen, contactSaved, setContactSaved, ensureSession }) {
  const inputRef = useRef(null)
  const listRef = useRef(null)
  const shellRef = useRef(null)
  const panelRef = useRef(null)
  const launcherRef = useRef(null)
  const showInvitation = useScrollThreshold(64, !hidden && !embedded)
  const motion = useModalPresence(open, !hidden && !embedded)
  const visible = !hidden && (embedded || motion.present)
  const state = chat.session?.state
  const canSend = state?.can_send && chat.session?.provider_enabled && !chat.pending
  const action = state?.action

  useEffect(() => { if (embedded && !hidden) ensureSession() }, [embedded, hidden])
  useChatbotViewport(shellRef, motion.present)
  useChatbotModal({ active: motion.present, panelRef, shellRef, launcherRef, onClose: () => setOpen(false) })

  useEffect(() => { if (visible && listRef.current) listRef.current.scrollTop = listRef.current.scrollHeight }, [chat.messages, chat.pending, visible])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible && state?.capturing) trackEvent('chat_contact_open', { placement: embedded ? 'embedded_chat' : 'floating_chat' })
  }, [visible, state?.capturing, embedded])

  function send(text) { return chat.send(text, false, embedded ? 'embedded_chat' : 'floating_chat') }

  function minimize() {
    setOpen(false)
  }

  function toggle() {
    if (open) { minimize(); return }
    ensureSession()
    setOpen(true)
    trackEvent('chatbot_open', { placement: 'floating_contact' })
  }

  if (hidden) return null
  const view = <div ref={shellRef} style={{ '--chat-modal-duration': `${MODAL_FADE_MS}ms` }} className={`chatbot${embedded ? ' chatbot--embedded' : ''}${motion.present ? ' chatbot--open' : ''}${motion.exiting ? ' chatbot--closing' : ''}`}>
    {!embedded && !motion.present && <FloatingWhatsApp phoneNumber={siteSettings.contact.whatsappNumber} />}
    {motion.present && <div className="chatbot__backdrop" aria-hidden="true" onClick={minimize} />}
    {(embedded || motion.present || chat.session || chat.pending || chat.error) && <section ref={panelRef} id={embedded ? 'chatbot-page-panel' : 'chatbot-panel'} hidden={!visible}
      className={`chatbot__panel${state?.capturing ? ' chatbot__panel--capturing' : ''}`} aria-label="Asistente de servicios" role={embedded ? 'region' : 'dialog'} aria-modal={motion.present ? true : undefined} tabIndex={-1}
      onAnimationEnd={motion.finishExit}>
      {!embedded && <header className="chatbot__header">
        <span className="chatbot__emblem" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2"><path d="M16 3 27 9v14l-11 6-11-6V9Z" /><path d="M10 19c0-8 12-9 12-9s0 12-8 12m-4 2 10-12" /></svg></span>
        <div className="chatbot__identity"><span className="chatbot__eyebrow">Nicolás Zamara</span><strong>Conversemos</strong><span className="chatbot__subtitle">Nuestro asistente virtual</span></div>
        <div className="chatbot__window-actions">
          <a href="/chatbot" aria-label="Ampliar conversación" title="Ampliar conversación"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 5h5v5m0-5-6 6M10 19H5v-5m0 5 6-6" /></svg></a>
          <button className="chatbot__close" type="button" aria-label="Cerrar asistente" title="Cerrar" onClick={minimize}><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M6 18 18 6" /></svg></button>
        </div>
      </header>}
      {!embedded && chat.messages.length === 1 && <div className="chatbot__intro"><span className="chatbot__intro-mark" aria-hidden="true">✧</span><h2>¿En qué podemos<br /> ayudarte?</h2><p>Escríbenos o explora nuestros servicios.</p></div>}
      <div className={`chatbot__messages${embedded && chat.messages.length === 1 && !chat.pending && !chat.error ? ' chatbot__messages--empty' : ''}`} ref={listRef} role="log" data-clarity-mask="true" aria-label="Conversación" aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions text">
        {chat.messages.map((message, index) => index === 0 ? null : <div className={`chatbot__turn chatbot__turn--${message.role}`} key={`${index}-${message.role}`}>
          <p className={`chatbot__message chatbot__message--${message.role}`}>{message.content}</p>
          {message.role === 'assistant' && message.action === 'show_hotmart' && <a className="chatbot__enrollment" href={siteSettings.courseUrl}
            target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Inscribirme al curso en Hotmart (abre en otra pestaña)"
            onClick={() => { void trackHotmartClick('chatbot', { element_id: 'chat_hotmart', placement: embedded ? 'embedded_chat' : 'floating_chat', service: 'course' }) }}>Inscribirme en Hotmart ↗</a>}
          {message.role === 'assistant' && message.action === 'show_online_interest' && <a className="chatbot__enrollment" href="/cursos#interes-online" onClick={() => { if (!embedded) minimize() }}>Me interesa la modalidad online</a>}
        </div>)}
        {chat.recovered && <p className="chatbot__notice">Recuperamos la última orientación y el estado de tu conversación. El historial anterior de esta pestaña puede no estar disponible.</p>}
        {chat.pending && <ChatReplySkeleton />}
        {chat.error && <p className="chatbot__error" role="alert">{chat.error}</p>}
        {!chat.pending && state?.closed && <p className="chatbot__message chatbot__message--assistant">Podemos seguir en contacto a través del formulario. También puedes explorar nuestros servicios.</p>}
        {!chat.pending && chat.session && !chat.session.provider_enabled && <p className="chatbot__notice">La orientación por mensajes no está disponible ahora. Puedes explorar los servicios o solicitar contacto.</p>}
        {contactSaved && !state?.capturing && <p role="status">Recibimos tu solicitud. Te contactaremos por el canal que elegiste.</p>}
      </div>
      {state?.capturing ? <ChatContactForm key={state.conversation_id} conversationId={state.conversation_id} initialTopic={state.topic} placement={embedded ? 'embedded_chat_form' : 'floating_chat_form'}
        submitContact={submitContact} onCancel={() => chat.command('cancel_capture')} onSaved={() => { setContactSaved(true); chat.loadSession() }} />
        : <>
          {!embedded && chat.messages.length === 1 && canSend && <div className="chatbot__prompts" aria-label="Temas sugeridos">
            {quickPrompts.map((prompt) => <button key={prompt} type="button" onClick={() => send(prompt)}>{prompt}</button>)}
          </div>}
          {!state?.closed && <form className="chatbot__form" onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); send() }}>
            <label className="chatbot__input-label" htmlFor="chatbot-message">Escribe tu consulta</label>
            <textarea id="chatbot-message" ref={inputRef} value={chat.draft} maxLength={1000} rows={2} disabled={chat.pending && Boolean(state)}
              aria-describedby={!canSend ? 'chatbot-send-status' : undefined}
              onChange={(event) => chat.setDraft(event.target.value)} placeholder="Escríbenos lo que tienes en mente…" />
            <button type="submit" aria-label="Enviar" disabled={!canSend || !chat.draft.trim()}><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M12 19V5m-6 6 6-6 6 6" /></svg></button>
            {!canSend && <p id="chatbot-send-status" className="chatbot__send-status" role="status">
              {chat.pending ? 'Conectando con el asistente… Espera un momento para enviar.'
                : !chat.session ? 'No se pudo conectar con el asistente. Tu mensaje no se ha enviado. Usa «Recuperar estado» para reintentar.'
                  : 'El envío no está disponible en este momento. Puedes recuperar el estado o explorar los servicios.'}
            </p>}
          </form>}
        </>}
      <nav className="chatbot__links" aria-label="Explorar servicios" onClick={(event) => {
        const params = navigationParams(event.target.closest('a')?.getAttribute('href'), embedded ? 'embedded_chat' : 'floating_chat')
        if (params) trackEvent('navigation_click', params)
      }}>
        {serviceLinks.map((link) => <a href={link.href} key={link.href} onClick={(event) => { if (!embedded && event.button === 0 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) minimize() }}>{link.label}</a>)}
        {state?.topic !== 'online' && !['medical_boundary', 'urgent_attention'].includes(state?.last_result?.response_key) && <a href={siteSettings.courseUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Ver el curso e inscribirme (abre en otra pestaña)" onClick={() => { void trackHotmartClick('chatbot', { element_id: 'chat_hotmart', placement: embedded ? 'embedded_chat' : 'floating_chat', service: 'course' }) }}>Inscribirme ↗</a>}
        {state && !state.capturing && <button type="button" aria-label="Solicitar que me contacten" disabled={chat.pending || state.busy} onClick={() => { setContactSaved(false); chat.command('start_capture') }}>Contacto</button>}
        {action === 'show_privacy' && <a href="/privacidad">Información de privacidad</a>}
      </nav>
      {!chat.pending && (chat.error || chat.canRetry || state?.closed || chat.recovered) && <div className="chatbot__prompts">
        {chat.canRetry && <button type="button" onClick={chat.retry}>{chat.retryIsFresh ? 'Reintentar consulta' : 'Consultar estado de mi mensaje'}</button>}
        <button type="button" onClick={chat.loadSession}>Recuperar estado</button>
        {state?.closed && <>
          {state.restart_at && <p className="chatbot__notice">Puedes intentar una nueva conversación desde {new Date(state.restart_at).toLocaleString('es-CL')}.</p>}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => chat.command('restart')}>Iniciar otra conversación</button>
        </>}
      </div>}
      <p className="chatbot__notice">El mensaje se envía a OpenAI. No incluyas datos personales sensibles ni información clínica. Los datos del formulario de contacto se envían por separado. <a href="/privacidad">Privacidad</a></p>
    </section>}
    {!embedded && <button ref={launcherRef} hidden={motion.present} className="chatbot__launcher" {...ctaAttributes({ element_id: 'floating_chatbot', placement: 'floating_contact', service: 'general' })} type="button" aria-label="Abrir asistente: ¿en qué podemos ayudarte?" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={open || chat.session ? 'chatbot-panel' : undefined} onClick={toggle}>
      {!open && <span className={`chatbot__invitation${showInvitation ? ' chatbot__invitation--visible' : ''}`} aria-hidden={!showInvitation}><span>Conversemos</span>¿En qué podemos ayudarte?</span>}
      <span className="chatbot__launcher-orb" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">{open ? <path d="m10 13 6 6 6-6" /> : <><path d="M7 7h18v14H15l-6 5v-5H7Z" /><path d="M12 12h8m-8 4h5" /></>}</svg><span className="chatbot__signal" /></span>
    </button>}
  </div>
  return embedded ? view : createPortal(view, document.body)
}
```

```jsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
```

### `src/components/ContactPreference/ContactPreference.jsx`

SHA-256: `4cbc8b451c260171775bac6c3ce9aad4bba873ad250ab12a98fb675c5d85d850` · 39 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import contactConfig from '../../../config/interests/contact.config.json'
import './ContactPreference.css'

const iconPaths = {
  video_call: ['M3 6h12v12H3z', 'm15 10 6-3v10l-6-3'],
  phone: ['M7 3 3 5c0 9 7 16 16 16l2-4-5-3-2 2a12 12 0 0 1-6-6l2-2z'],
  whatsapp: ['M21 11.5a9 9 0 0 1-13.4 7.9L3 21l1.6-4.6A9 9 0 1 1 21 11.5Z', 'm8 7-1 1c0 4 3 7 7 7l1-1-2-2-1 1a7 7 0 0 1-3-3l1-1-2-2Z'],
}

export default function ContactPreference({ name = 'contactPreference', value, onChange, disabled = false }) {
  const id = useId()
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(null)
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(null)
  return <fieldset className="contact-preference" disabled={disabled}>
    <legend>Preferencia de contacto *</legend>
    <div className="contact-preference__choices">
      {contactConfig.preferences.map((option) => {
        const tooltipId = `${id}-${option.value}-tooltip`
        const showTooltip = hovered === option.value || focused === option.value
        return <label className="contact-preference__option" key={option.value}
          onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(option.value)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}>
          <span className="contact-preference__control">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              {iconPaths[option.value].map((path) => <path d={path} key={path} />)}
            </svg>
            <input type="radio" name={name} value={option.value} required aria-label={option.label}
              checked={value === undefined ? undefined : value === option.value} onChange={onChange}
              aria-describedby={showTooltip ? tooltipId : undefined}
              onFocus={() => setFocused(option.value)} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') { setHovered(null); setFocused(null) } }} />
          </span>
          <span className="contact-preference__label">{option.label}</span>
          {showTooltip && <span role="tooltip" id={tooltipId} className="contact-preference__tooltip">{option.label}</span>}
        </label>
      })}
    </div>
  </fieldset>
}
```

```jsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import ContactPreference from './ContactPreference.jsx'

describe('ContactPreference', () => {
  it('offers three required icon choices with no default and only one selected value', () => {
    const { container } = render(<form aria-label="Preferencia"><ContactPreference /></form>)
    const radios = screen.getAllByRole('radio')
    expect(radios).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(radios.every((radio) => radio.required && !radio.checked)).toBe(true)
    expect(container.querySelectorAll('svg[aria-hidden=true]')).toHaveLength(3)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Videollamada' }))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'WhatsApp' }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'WhatsApp' })).toBeChecked()
    expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Videollamada' })).not.toBeChecked()
    expect(new FormData(screen.getByRole('form')).get('contactPreference')).toBe('whatsapp')
  })
  it.each(['Videollamada', 'Teléfono', 'WhatsApp'])('shows the %s tooltip on hover and hides it when leaving', (label) => {
    render(<ContactPreference />)
    const option = screen.getByRole('radio', { name: label }).closest('label')
    expect(screen.queryByRole('tooltip')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.mouseEnter(option)
    expect(screen.getByRole('tooltip')).toHaveTextContent(label)
    fireEvent.mouseLeave(option)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('tooltip')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
  it('also describes keyboard focus, allows Escape, and reports the chosen value', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn()
    render(<ContactPreference value="" onChange={onChange} />)
    const radio = screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Teléfono' })
    fireEvent.focus(radio)
    expect(screen.getByRole('tooltip')).toHaveTextContent('Teléfono')
    expect(radio).toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby', screen.getByRole('tooltip').id)
    fireEvent.keyDown(radio, { key: 'Escape' })
    expect(screen.queryByRole('tooltip')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.click(radio)
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    fireEvent.blur(radio)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('tooltip')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
```

### `src/components/InterestForm/InterestForm.jsx`

SHA-256: `5772fbdc0ab76452ec0b75c5c0d933e6ebbe7d422506686375e1ff291578bae8` · 105 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { submitInterest as defaultSubmitInterest } from '../../services/interestService.js'
import { useInterestSubmission } from '../../hooks/useInterestSubmission/useInterestSubmission.js'
import ContactPreference from '../ContactPreference/ContactPreference.jsx'
import './InterestForm.css'
import { useFormMetrics } from '../../hooks/useFormMetrics/useFormMetrics.js'
import { formPlacement } from '../../services/formMetrics.js'
import { useHydrated } from '../../contexts/HydrationContext/HydrationContext.jsx'

const phoneField = { name: 'phone', label: 'Teléfono con prefijo internacional', type: 'tel', required: true, autocomplete: 'tel' }
const fieldMap = {
  consultation: [
    { name: 'name', label: 'Nombre', type: 'text', required: true, autocomplete: 'name' },
    { name: 'email', label: 'Correo electrónico', type: 'email', required: true, autocomplete: 'email' },
    phoneField,
  ],
  online: [
    { name: 'name', label: 'Nombre', type: 'text', required: true, autocomplete: 'name' },
    { name: 'email', label: 'Correo electrónico', type: 'email', required: true, autocomplete: 'email' },
    phoneField,
    { name: 'country', label: 'País', type: 'text', required: true, autocomplete: 'country-name' },
    { name: 'experience', label: 'Experiencia previa (opcional)', type: 'text', required: false, autocomplete: 'off' },
  ],
  nature: [
    { name: 'name', label: 'Nombre', type: 'text', required: true, autocomplete: 'name' },
    { name: 'email', label: 'Correo electrónico', type: 'email', required: true, autocomplete: 'email' },
    phoneField,
    { name: 'city', label: 'Ciudad', type: 'text', required: true, autocomplete: 'address-level2' },
  ],
}

const formCopy = {
  consultation: { title: 'Me interesa agendar una consulta', purpose: 'Déjame tus datos para contactarte y coordinar disponibilidad. El registro no confirma una hora.', success: 'Gracias por tu interés. Te contactaremos para coordinar tu consulta. La hora se confirma al acordarla directamente.' },
  online: { title: 'Flores de Bach en modalidad online', purpose: 'Si te gustaría participar desde tu ciudad o país, déjame tus datos para recibir información cuando se abra una edición online.', success: 'Gracias por tu interés. Te avisaré cuando se abra una edición online.' },
  nature: { title: 'Me interesan los baños de bosque', purpose: 'Déjame tus datos para recibir información cuando se confirme un encuentro.', success: 'Gracias por tu interés. Te avisaré cuando se confirme un encuentro.' },
}

export default function InterestForm({ kind, submitInterest = defaultSubmitInterest, placement = formPlacement(kind, '/') }) {
  const hydrated = useHydrated()
  const metrics = useFormMetrics({ kind, placement, service: kind, source: 'form' })
  const { status, submit, reset } = useInterestSubmission(submitInterest, metrics)
  const formRef = useRef(null)
  const fields = fieldMap[kind]
  const copy = formCopy[kind]

  if (!fields || !copy) return null

  function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    if (status === 'submitting' || status === 'saved') return
    if (!event.currentTarget.reportValidity()) return
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    const values = Object.fromEntries(fields.map((field) => [field.name, formData.get(field.name)]))
    values.contactPreference = formData.get('contactPreference')
    void submit({
      interest: kind,
      values,
      updatesConsent: formData.has('updatesConsent'),
      privacyConsent: formData.has('privacyConsent'),
      website: formData.get('website') || '',
    })
  }

  return (
    <section className="interest-form" aria-labelledby={`${kind}-form-title`}>
      <h3 id={`${kind}-form-title`} data-analytics-section={placement}>{copy.title}</h3>
      <p>{copy.purpose} Revisa también la <a href="/privacidad">información de privacidad</a>.</p>
      <p className="interest-form__review-notice">Versión de pruebas: utiliza datos ficticios para probar este formulario.</p>
      <form ref={formRef} onSubmit={handleSubmit} aria-busy={status === 'submitting'} data-clarity-mask="true"
        onFocusCapture={(event) => { if (event.target.name !== 'website') metrics.start() }} onChange={() => metrics.start()}
        onInvalidCapture={(event) => metrics.invalid(event.target)}>
        <fieldset disabled={!hydrated || status === 'submitting' || status === 'saved'}>
        <legend className="interest-form__legend">Datos para registrar tu interés</legend>
        {fields.map((field) => (
          <label className="interest-form__field" key={field.name}>
            <span>{field.label}{field.required ? ' *' : ''}</span>
            <input name={field.name} type={field.type} autoComplete={field.autocomplete} required={field.required}
              pattern={field.name === 'phone' ? '\\+[1-9][0-9 ]{6,24}' : undefined} placeholder={field.name === 'phone' ? '+56 9 1234 5678' : undefined}
              maxLength={field.name === 'phone' ? 30 : field.name === 'email' ? 254 : field.name === 'experience' ? 500 : field.name === 'name' ? 120 : 100} />
          </label>
        ))}
        <ContactPreference />
        <label className="interest-form__consent">
          <input name="privacyConsent" type="checkbox" required />
          <span>Autorizo el uso de mis datos para responder a este interés según mi preferencia de contacto y he leído la información de privacidad. *</span>
        </label>
        <label className="interest-form__consent">
          <input name="updatesConsent" type="checkbox" />
          <span>Quiero recibir novedades relacionadas con este interés (opcional).</span>
        </label>
        <label className="interest-form__trap" aria-hidden="true">Sitio web<input name="website" type="text" tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" /></label>
        <button className="interest-form__submit" type="submit" disabled={status === 'submitting' || status === 'saved'}>
          {status === 'submitting' ? 'Enviando…' : 'Registrar mi interés'}
        </button>
        </fieldset>
      </form>
      <noscript>Para solicitar contacto, visita la página de consulta y utiliza su enlace de WhatsApp.</noscript>
      {status === 'submitting' && <p className="interest-form__message" role="status">Estamos guardando tu interés…</p>}
      {status === 'saved' && <p className="interest-form__message" role="status">{copy.success}</p>}
      {status === 'saved' && <button className="interest-form__submit" type="button" onClick={() => { formRef.current?.reset(); reset() }}>Registrar otro interés</button>}
      {status === 'unavailable' && <p className="interest-form__message interest-form__message--error" role="alert">No pudimos confirmar el registro. Inténtalo nuevamente más tarde.</p>}
      {status === 'rate_limited' && <p className="interest-form__message interest-form__message--error" role="alert">Recibimos varios intentos. Espera un minuto antes de reintentar.</p>}
    </section>
  )
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-components-interestform-interestform-test-jsx"></a>

### `src/components/InterestForm/InterestForm.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `3acc6173808e0c3eaba7176202d4d3fd9291c6eb8277493bd1d9e4fd71830356` · 105 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import InterestForm from './InterestForm.jsx'
import InterestFormSkeleton from './InterestFormSkeleton.jsx'

function fillForm(kind = 'nature') {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/^nombre/i), { target: { value: 'Ana' } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/correo electrónico/i), { target: { value: 'ana@example.com' } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/teléfono con prefijo/i), { target: { value: '+56912345678' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'WhatsApp' }))
  if (kind !== 'consultation') fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(kind === 'nature' ? /ciudad/i : /país/i), { target: { value: 'Chile' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /autorizo el uso/i }))
}

describe('InterestForm', () => {
  beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
  afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

  it('registra consulta después de la petición más 800 ms sin confirmar una reserva', async () => {
    let resolve
    const service = vi.fn(() => new Promise((done) => { resolve = done }))
    render(<InterestForm kind="consultation" submitInterest={service} />)
    fillForm('consultation')
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }))
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1200) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Estamos guardando')
    await act(async () => { resolve({ status: 'saved' }) })
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Estamos guardando')
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Te contactaremos para coordinar tu consulta')
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('La hora se confirma al acordarla directamente')
    expect(service).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ interest: 'consultation', values: { name: 'Ana', email: 'ana@example.com', phone: '+56912345678', contactPreference: 'whatsapp' }, privacyConsent: true, updatesConsent: false, website: '' }, { signal: expect.any(AbortSignal) })
  })

  it('requiere autorización y mantiene novedades sin marcar', () => {
    const service = vi.fn()
    render(<InterestForm kind="nature" submitInterest={service} />)
    expect(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /autorizo/i })).not.toBeChecked()
    expect(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /novedades/i })).not.toBeChecked()
    expect(screen.getByText(/versión de pruebas/i)).toHaveTextContent('utiliza datos ficticios')
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }).closest('form'))
    expect(service).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it.each(['nature', 'consultation'])('muestra error honesto y conserva los campos para reintentar en %s', async (kind) => {
    const service = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('offline'))
    render(<InterestForm kind={kind} submitInterest={service} />)
    fillForm(kind)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }))
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('No pudimos confirmar el registro')
    expect(screen.queryByText('Gracias por tu interés. Te avisaré cuando se confirme un encuentro.')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^nombre/i)).toHaveValue('Ana')
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' })).toBeEnabled()
  })

  it.each(['online', 'nature'])('confirma persistencia de %s tras 800 ms y permite un registro nuevo', async (kind) => {
    const service = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ status: 'saved' })
    render(<InterestForm kind={kind} submitInterest={service} />)
    fillForm(kind)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }))
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Estamos guardando')
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(kind === 'online' ? 'Gracias por tu interés. Te avisaré cuando se abra una edición online.' : 'Gracias por tu interés. Te avisaré cuando se confirme un encuentro.')
    expect(service).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ interest: kind, values: kind === 'online' ? { name: 'Ana', email: 'ana@example.com', phone: '+56912345678', contactPreference: 'whatsapp', country: 'Chile', experience: '' } : { name: 'Ana', email: 'ana@example.com', phone: '+56912345678', contactPreference: 'whatsapp', city: 'Chile' }, privacyConsent: true, updatesConsent: false, website: '' }, { signal: expect.any(AbortSignal) })
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar otro interés' }))
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^nombre/i)).toHaveValue('')
    expect(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /autorizo/i })).not.toBeChecked()
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/teléfono con prefijo/i)).toHaveValue('')
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('radio').every((radio) => !radio.checked)).toBe(true)
  })

  it('evita envíos simultáneos y diferencia límites de frecuencia', async () => {
    const service = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ status: 'rate_limited' })
    render(<InterestForm kind="nature" submitInterest={service} />)
    fillForm()
    const form = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }).closest('form')
    fireEvent.submit(form)
    fireEvent.submit(form)
    expect(service).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800) })
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Espera un minuto')
  })

  it('ofrece un skeleton propio', () => {
    const { container } = render(<InterestFormSkeleton />)
    expect(container.firstChild).toHaveClass('interest-form-skeleton')
  })
  it.each(['nature', 'online'])('exige teléfono y preferencia en %s aunque el resto del formulario esté completo', (kind) => {
    const service = vi.fn()
    render(<InterestForm kind={kind} submitInterest={service} />)
    fillForm(kind)
    const form = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Registrar mi interés' }).closest('form')
    const phone = screen.getByLabelText(/teléfono con prefijo/i)
    fireEvent.change(phone, { target: { value: '' } })
    fireEvent.submit(form)
    expect(service).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    fireEvent.change(phone, { target: { value: '+56912345678' } })
    screen.getAllByRole('radio').forEach((radio) => { radio.checked = false })
    fireEvent.submit(form)
    expect(service).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})
```

```jsx
import { useSiteContent } from '../../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import BrandMark from '../BrandMark/BrandMark.jsx'
import './SiteFooter.css'
import { navigationParams } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'

export default function SiteFooter({ onOpenAnalytics }) {
  const { brand, descriptor, contact, socialLinks } = useSiteContent()
  return (
    <footer className="site-footer">
      <img className="site-footer__flowers" src="/brand/poppy-line.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" width="240" height="255" />
      <img className="site-footer__needles" src="/brand/acupuncture-line.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" width="210" height="240" />
      <div className="site-footer__inner">
        <a className="site-footer__brand" href="/" aria-label={`${brand}, inicio`} onClick={() => trackEvent('navigation_click', { element_id: 'footer_home', placement: 'footer', destination_path: '/' })}><BrandMark name={brand} descriptor={descriptor} /></a>
        <nav className="site-footer__links" aria-label="Enlaces del pie de página" onClick={(event) => {
          const params = navigationParams(event.target.closest('a')?.getAttribute('href'), 'footer')
          if (params) trackEvent('navigation_click', params)
        }}>
          <div><h2>Consulta</h2><a href="/consulta">La consulta</a><a href="/consulta#consult-steps-title">Cómo comenzar</a><a href="/consulta#consult-contact-title">Disponibilidad</a></div>
          <div><h2>Naturaleza</h2><a href="/naturaleza">Naturaleza y bienestar</a><a href="/naturaleza#interes-naturaleza">Recibir información</a><a href="/sobre-mi">Sobre mí</a></div>
          <div><h2>Cursos</h2><a href="/cursos">Flores de Bach</a><a href="/cursos#interes-online">Curso online</a></div>
          <div><h2>Información</h2><a href="/privacidad">Privacidad</a>{contact.email && <a href={`mailto:${contact.email}`}>Correo</a>}{socialLinks.map((social) => <a key={social.href} href={social.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{social.label}</a>)}</div>
        </nav>
        <div className="site-footer__bottom"><small>© {new Date().getFullYear()} {brand} <span aria-hidden="true">|</span> Todos los derechos reservados</small>
          {onOpenAnalytics && <button className="site-footer__preferences" type="button" onClick={onOpenAnalytics}>Preferencias de privacidad</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  )
}
```

### `src/components/SiteHeader/SiteHeader.jsx`

SHA-256: `1c10dd9d1213e66d72ff58f272123d7a2aeeeb8cfb5b0b79c772ef603aa0878f` · 59 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useSiteContent } from '../../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import ActionLink from '../ActionLink/ActionLink.jsx'
import BrandMark from '../BrandMark/BrandMark.jsx'
import './SiteHeader.css'
import { navigationParams } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'

const navigation = [
  { label: 'Inicio', href: '/' },
  { label: 'Terapias', href: '/terapias' },
  { label: 'Consulta', href: '/consulta' },
  { label: 'Cursos', href: '/cursos' },
  { label: 'Naturaleza', href: '/naturaleza' },
  { label: 'Sobre mí', href: '/sobre-mi' },
]

export default function SiteHeader({ currentPath = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '/' : window.location.pathname }) {
  const { brand } = useSiteContent()
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const toggleRef = useRef(null)

  return (
    <header className="site-header">
      <a className="site-header__brand" href="/" aria-label={`${brand}, inicio`} onClick={() => trackEvent('navigation_click', { element_id: 'brand_home', placement: 'header', destination_path: '/' })}>
        <BrandMark name={brand} />
      </a>
      <button
        ref={toggleRef}
        className="site-header__toggle"
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={menuOpen}
        aria-controls="primary-navigation"
        onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
      >
        <span className="site-header__toggle-label">{menuOpen ? 'Cerrar menú' : 'Menú'}</span>
        <span className="site-header__toggle-icon" aria-hidden="true">{menuOpen ? '×' : '☰'}</span>
      </button>
      <nav
        id="primary-navigation"
        className={`site-header__nav${menuOpen ? ' is-open' : ''}`}
        aria-label="Navegación principal"
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === 'Escape') {
            setMenuOpen(false)
            toggleRef.current?.focus()
          }
        }}
      >
        {navigation.map((item) => <a key={item.href} href={item.href} aria-current={currentPath === item.href ? 'page' : undefined} onClick={() => {
          setMenuOpen(false)
          const params = navigationParams(item.href, 'header')
          if (params) trackEvent('navigation_click', params)
        }}>{item.label}</a>)}
        <ActionLink analytics={{ element_id: 'header_consultation', placement: 'header', service: 'consultation' }} className="site-header__cta" href="/consulta" variant="compact">Conoce la consulta</ActionLink>
      </nav>
    </header>
  )
}
```

```jsx
    for (const link of screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Navegación principal' }).querySelectorAll('a')) {
      expect(link.getAttribute('href')).not.toContain('#')
    }
  })

  it('ofrece un skeleton propio', () => {
    const { container } = render(<SiteHeaderSkeleton />)
    expect(container.firstChild).toHaveClass('site-header-skeleton')
  })

  it('cierra el menú con Escape y devuelve el foco al control', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><SiteHeader /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const toggle = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /menú/i })
    fireEvent.click(toggle)
    const navigation = screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Navegación principal' })
    fireEvent.keyDown(navigation, { key: 'Escape' })
    expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
    expect(toggle).toHaveFocus()
  })
})
```
