### `src/config/analytics.js`

SHA-256: `967a4c198e71bb3c285a30632346a7c32aa678b48462e6b0c9b24cd083a7c8f6` · 117 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { pageMetadata } from '../content/siteContent.js'

export const ANALYTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
export const SITE_VERSION = 'marketing-baseline-v1'
export const ANALYTICS_QUEUE_LIMIT = 50
export const ANALYTICS_QUEUE_TTL_MS = 30000

export function getAnalyticsSettings(env = import.meta.env, hostname = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : window.location.hostname) {
  const qa = env.VITE_ANALYTICS_QA === 'true'
  const production = env.MODE === 'production' && ['www.nicolaszamara.com', 'nicolaszamara.com'].includes(hostname)
  return Object.freeze({
    enabled: env.VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED === 'true' && (qa || production),
    environment: qa ? 'qa' : production ? 'production' : 'development',
    ga4Id: /^G-[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(env.VITE_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID || '') ? env.VITE_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID : '',
    clarityId: /^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(env.VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID || '') ? env.VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID : '',
    siteVersion: SITE_VERSION,
  })
}

const member = (values) => (value) => typeof value === 'string' && values.includes(value)
const routePaths = [...Object.keys(pageMetadata).filter((path) => path !== '/admin'), '/404']
const route = member(routePaths)
const service = member(['consultation', 'therapies', 'course', 'online', 'nature', 'about', 'general'])
const formKind = member(['consultation', 'online', 'nature', 'chat_contact'])
const errorCode = member(['required', 'format', 'too_long', 'consent_required', 'rate_limited', 'timeout', 'network', 'unavailable'])
const fieldId = member(['name', 'email', 'phone', 'contact_preference', 'city', 'country', 'privacy_consent', 'form'])

export const ANALYTICS_SECTIONS = Object.freeze([
  'home_hero', 'home_areas', 'home_consultation', 'home_course', 'home_about', 'home_nature', 'home_nature_form',
  'consultation_intro', 'consultation_steps', 'consultation_details', 'consultation_faq', 'consultation_form', 'consultation_contact',
  'therapies_intro', 'therapies_grid', 'courses_intro', 'courses_offer', 'courses_online_form',
  'nature_intro', 'nature_page_form', 'about_bio',
])

export const ANALYTICS_PLACEMENTS = Object.freeze([
  'header', 'footer', 'home_hero', 'home_areas', 'home_consultation', 'home_course', 'home_nature', 'home_nature_form',
  'consultation_contact', 'consultation_form', 'therapies_grid', 'courses_offer', 'courses_online_form',
  'nature_intro', 'nature_page_form', 'floating_contact', 'floating_chat', 'embedded_chat',
  'floating_chat_form', 'embedded_chat_form',
])

const destinations = ['home', 'therapies', 'consultation', 'courses', 'nature', 'about', 'privacy', 'online', 'availability', 'steps', 'nature_interest']
const therapies = ['acupuntura', 'moxibustion', 'ventosaterapia', 'tuina', 'flores-de-bach', 'medicina-bioenergetica', 'iridologia', 'meditacion-y-mindfulness']
export const ANALYTICS_ELEMENTS = Object.freeze([
  ...['home', 'therapies', 'consultation', 'courses', 'nature', 'about'].map((id) => `nav_${id}`),
  ...destinations.map((id) => `footer_${id}`),
  ...destinations.map((id) => `chat_${id}`),
  ...therapies.map((id) => `therapy_${id}_consultation`),
  ...['consultation', 'courses', 'nature'].flatMap((id) => [`area_${id}_visual`, `area_${id}_text`]),
  'brand_home', 'header_consultation', 'hero_consultation', 'hero_courses', 'hero_nature',
  'home_consultation_details', 'home_course_hotmart', 'home_course_online', 'home_nature_interest',
  'consultation_whatsapp', 'courses_hotmart', 'courses_online_interest', 'nature_interest',
  'floating_whatsapp', 'floating_chatbot', 'chat_hotmart',
  'therapies_consultation',
])

const placement = member(ANALYTICS_PLACEMENTS)
const elementId = member(ANALYTICS_ELEMENTS)
const internalHosts = ['www.nicolaszamara.com', 'nicolaszamara.com']
const referrerHosts = ['www.google.com', 'www.google.cl', 'www.bing.com', 'www.instagram.com', 'www.facebook.com']

function safeLocation(value, referrer = false) {
  if (referrer && value === '') return true
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 254) return false
  try {
    const url = new URL(value)
    if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || url.username || url.password || url.port || url.search || url.hash) return false
    return internalHosts.includes(url.hostname)
      ? route(url.pathname)
      : referrer && referrerHosts.includes(url.hostname) && url.pathname === '/'
  } catch { return false }
}

const cta = { element_id: elementId, placement, service }
const form = { form_kind: formKind, placement }
const eventDefinitions = {
  page_view: { page_title: member([...Object.entries(pageMetadata).filter(([path]) => path !== '/admin').map(([, { title }]) => title), 'Página no encontrada | Nicolás Zamara']), page_location: safeLocation, page_referrer: (value) => safeLocation(value, true) },
  section_view: { section_id: member(ANALYTICS_SECTIONS) },
  cta_view: cta,
  cta_click: { ...cta, destination_path: route },
  navigation_click: { element_id: elementId, placement, destination_path: route },
  whatsapp_click: cta,
  hotmart_click: { ...cta, source: member(['home', 'course', 'chatbot']) },
  form_start: form,
  form_validation_error: { ...form, error_code: errorCode, field_id: fieldId },
  form_submit_attempt: form,
  form_retry: { ...form, error_code: errorCode },
  form_submit_error: { ...form, error_code: errorCode },
  generate_lead: { ...form, service, lead_source: member(['form', 'chatbot']) },
  chatbot_open: { placement },
  chatbot_engaged: { placement },
  chat_contact_open: { placement },
  // No experiment is approved yet. Enabling one requires registering its exact IDs.
  experiment_exposure: { experiment_id: member([]), variant_id: member([]) },
}

export const ANALYTICS_EVENTS = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(eventDefinitions).map(([name, fields]) => [name, Object.freeze({ ...fields })]),
))

// This validates caller-owned fields only. Context/UUIDs are added by the emitter,
// never accepted from a control. No script or network request is made here.
export function validateAnalyticsEvent(name, params) {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(ANALYTICS_EVENTS, name) || !params || typeof params !== 'object' || Array.isArray(params)) return false
  const definition = ANALYTICS_EVENTS[name]
  if (Object.keys(params).length !== Object.keys(definition).length) return false
  return Object.keys(params).every((key) => Object.hasOwn(definition, key) && definition[key](params[key]))
}

export const LEGACY_ANALYTICS_EVENTS = Object.freeze({
  online_interest_saved: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'generate_lead', form_kind: 'online', service: 'online', lead_source: 'form' }),
  nature_interest_saved: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'generate_lead', form_kind: 'nature', service: 'nature', lead_source: 'form' }),
  consultation_interest_saved: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'generate_lead', form_kind: 'consultation', service: 'consultation', lead_source: 'form' }),
  chat_contact_saved: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'generate_lead', form_kind: 'chat_contact', lead_source: 'chatbot' }),
  hotmart_click: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'hotmart_click' }),
  whatsapp_click: Object.freeze({ event_name: 'whatsapp_click' }),
})
```

### `src/config/analytics.test.js`

SHA-256: `4538bf9cd8df0e7e2d453cbd671809180ed9eccf6ce38abdc368066288a61528` · 46 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { ANALYTICS_EVENTS, LEGACY_ANALYTICS_EVENTS, validateAnalyticsEvent, getAnalyticsSettings } from './analytics.js'

describe('analytics contract', () => {
  it('defaults to off and requires explicit QA activation outside production hosts', () => {
    expect(getAnalyticsSettings({}, 'www.nicolaszamara.com').enabled).toBe(false)
    expect(getAnalyticsSettings({ MODE: 'production', VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: 'true' }, 'preview.vercel.app').enabled).toBe(false)
    expect(getAnalyticsSettings({ MODE: 'production', VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: 'true' }, 'www.nicolaszamara.com').enabled).toBe(true)
    expect(getAnalyticsSettings({ VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: 'true', VITE_ANALYTICS_QA: 'true' }, 'localhost').environment).toBe('qa')
  })
  const click = { element_id: 'hero_nature', placement: 'home_hero', service: 'nature', destination_path: '/naturaleza' }
  it('accepts a registered action without sending anything', () => {
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('cta_click', click)).toBe(true)
    expect(Object.keys(ANALYTICS_EVENTS)).toHaveLength(17)
    expect(Object.keys(LEGACY_ANALYTICS_EVENTS)).toHaveLength(6)
  })
  it.each([
    { ...click, email: 'person@example.invalid' }, { ...click, event_id: 'caller-id' },
    { ...click, destination_path: '/naturaleza?email=person' }, { ...click, destination_path: '/#naturaleza' },
    { ...click, placement: 'person@example.invalid' }, { ...click, element_id: 'a-phone-56912345678' },
    { ...click, service: 'clinical_diagnosis' }, { ...click, destination_path: 'https://external.invalid' },
    {}, null, [],
  ])('rejects unknown, sensitive or incomplete data: %j', (params) => {
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('cta_click', params)).toBe(false)
  })
  it('rejects unknown event names including object prototype properties', () => {
    for (const name of ['purchase', 'email', '__proto__', 'constructor']) expect(validateAnalyticsEvent(name, {})).toBe(false)
  })
  it('permits only catalog titles and clean known URLs', () => {
    const params = { page_title: 'Cursos y formación | Nicolás Zamara', page_location: 'https://www.nicolaszamara.com/cursos', page_referrer: '' }
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('page_view', params)).toBe(true)
    for (const page_location of ['https://www.nicolaszamara.com/cursos?name=Ana', 'https://www.nicolaszamara.com/custom-person', 'https://user@www.nicolaszamara.com/cursos', 'http://www.nicolaszamara.com/cursos']) {
      expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('page_view', { ...params, page_location })).toBe(false)
    }
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('page_view', { ...params, page_title: 'Ana personal message' })).toBe(false)
  })
  it('accepts lead enums but never a remote request ID or form contents', () => {
    const params = { form_kind: 'chat_contact', placement: 'floating_chat_form', service: 'general', lead_source: 'chatbot' }
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('generate_lead', params)).toBe(true)
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('generate_lead', { ...params, request_id: 'remote' })).toBe(false)
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('generate_lead', { ...params, values: { name: 'Ana' } })).toBe(false)
  })
  it('does not accept experiments until exact IDs are registered', () => {
    expect(validateAnalyticsEvent('experiment_exposure', { experiment_id: 'test', variant_id: 'a' })).toBe(false)
  })
})
```

### `src/contexts/AnalyticsConsentContext/AnalyticsConsentContext.jsx`

SHA-256: `8a78a383bcd712248624964b78252fa5dbd79f2c4abf6561e92f733ebfbf981d` · 18 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import { consentStore } from '../../services/consentService.js'

const AnalyticsConsentContext = createContext(null)

export function AnalyticsConsentProvider({ children, store = consentStore }) {
  const consent = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot, store.getServerSnapshot)
  const [preferencesOpen, setPreferencesOpen] = useState(false)
  function savePreferences(preferences) {
    if (store.save(preferences)) setPreferencesOpen(false)
  }
  return <AnalyticsConsentContext.Provider value={{ consent, visible: preferencesOpen || consent.status === 'unknown',
    openPreferences: () => setPreferencesOpen(true), closePreferences: () => setPreferencesOpen(false), savePreferences }}>
    {children}
  </AnalyticsConsentContext.Provider>
}

export function useAnalyticsConsent() { return useContext(AnalyticsConsentContext) }
```

### `src/contexts/ChatbotContext/ChatbotContext.jsx`

SHA-256: `07f78e646db251add752968930b9fa73e19f65f7cded7500172a028e7fe270d3` · 23 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useChatbot } from '../../hooks/useChatbot/useChatbot.js'

const ChatbotContext = createContext(null)

// Memory belongs to this page lifetime: navigation preserves it; a reload resets it.
export function ChatbotProvider({ api, children }) {
  const chat = useChatbot(api)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [contactSaved, setContactSaved] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => { setContactSaved(false) }, [chat.session?.state.conversation_id])

  function ensureSession() {
    if (!chat.session && !chat.pending) chat.loadSession({ restoreMessages: false, fresh: true })
  }

  return <ChatbotContext.Provider value={{ chat, open, setOpen, contactSaved, setContactSaved, ensureSession }}>
    {children}
  </ChatbotContext.Provider>
}

export function useChatbotContext() { return useContext(ChatbotContext) }
```

```jsx
import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { ChatbotProvider } from './ChatbotContext.jsx'
import Chatbot from '../../components/Chatbot/Chatbot.jsx'
import { mockChatApi } from '../../test/chatbotFixtures.js'

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

it('shares replies and the pending operation when switching views, but resets on a real remount', async () => {
  const api = mockChatApi()
  const view = (embedded) => <ChatbotProvider api={api}><Chatbot key={String(embedded)} embedded={embedded} /></ChatbotProvider>
  const { rerender, unmount } = render(view(false))
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /abrir asistente/i }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta'), { target: { value: 'Curso' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }))
  rerender(view(true))
  expect(screen.getByRole('status', { name: 'Preparando orientación' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.getByText('Aquí tienes el curso.')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(api.session).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  expect(api.send).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  unmount()
  render(view(true))

})

it('finishes initial loading in StrictMode after cleanup and retries the interrupted task', async () => {
  const api = mockChatApi()
  render(<StrictMode><ChatbotProvider api={api}><Chatbot embedded /></ChatbotProvider></StrictMode>)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.queryByRole('status', { name: 'Preparando orientación' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toBeEnabled()
})
```

<a id="archivo-src-hooks-useadminquery-useadminquery-js"></a>

### `src/hooks/useAdminQuery/useAdminQuery.js`

SHA-256: `97b87a017dc6ef7f66ac850b04c29b6c0cb008e055324e5577e76e751a30890e` · 26 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { BASE_DELAY_MS } from '../../config/loading.js'

// Each remote region reveals its result only after request completion + 800 ms.
export function useAdminQuery(load, key = '') {
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0)
  const [state, setState] = useState({ pending: true, data: null, error: null })
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true, timer
    const controller = new AbortController()
    setState({ pending: true, data: null, error: null })
    let deadline
    const timeout = new Promise((_, reject) => {
      deadline = setTimeout(() => { controller.abort(); reject(new Error('timeout')) }, 15000)
    })
    Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(() => load(controller.signal, key)), timeout])
      .then((data) => ({ data, error: null }), (error) => ({ data: null, error }))
      .then((outcome) => {
        clearTimeout(deadline)
        if (!active) return
        timer = setTimeout(() => { if (active) setState({ ...outcome, pending: false }) }, BASE_DELAY_MS)
      })
    return () => { active = false; controller.abort(); clearTimeout(timer); clearTimeout(deadline) }
  }, [load, key, revision])
  return { ...state, reload: () => setRevision((value) => value + 1) }
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-hooks-useadminquery-useadminquery-test-js"></a>

### `src/hooks/useAdminQuery/useAdminQuery.test.js`

SHA-256: `8b7858c5076e5adaadd965e108fee09e6fd79cfd661f53bd947e693df38996d9` · 35 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { useAdminQuery } from './useAdminQuery.js'

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

it('waits for the request and then exactly 800 ms; a new key discards an obsolete request', async () => {
  const finish = {}
  const load = vi.fn((signal, key) => new Promise((resolve) => { finish[key] = resolve }))
  const { result, rerender } = renderHook(({ key }) => useAdminQuery(load, key), { initialProps: { key: 'first' } })
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000))
  expect(result.current.pending).toBe(true)
  rerender({ key: 'second' })
  expect(load.mock.calls[0][0].aborted).toBe(true)
  await act(async () => { await Promise.resolve(); finish.first('obsolete'); finish.second('current') })
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
  expect(result.current.pending).toBe(true)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(result.current.data).toBe('current')
})

it('ends a hung request with delayed error, reloads and cleans up on unmount', async () => {
  const load = vi.fn().mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise(() => {})).mockResolvedValue('ready')
  const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useAdminQuery(load))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(15799))
  expect(result.current.pending).toBe(true)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(result.current.error).toBeInstanceOf(Error)
  act(() => result.current.reload())
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(result.current.data).toBe('ready')
  unmount()
  expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
})
```

```javascript
  const [recovered, setRecovered] = useState(false)
  const current = useRef(null)
  const retry = useRef(null)
  const delivered = useRef(new Set())
  const engaged = useRef(new Set())
  const remote = useDelayedOperation()

  function accept(value, { restore = false, requestId } = {}) {
    if (!value?.state) return
    const changed = current.current && current.current.state.conversation_id !== value.state.conversation_id
    current.current = value
    setSession(value)
    if (changed) { setMessages([welcome]); setDraft(''); setRecovered(false); retry.current = null; delivered.current.clear() }
    const result = value.result || (restore ? value.state.last_result : null)
    const responseId = result?.request_id || requestId || `restored:${value.state.completed_rounds}:${result?.reply}`
    if (result?.reply && !delivered.current.has(responseId)) {
      setMessages((previous) => [...(changed ? [welcome] : previous), { role: 'assistant', content: result.reply,
        requestId: result.request_id || requestId, conversationId: value.state.conversation_id, action: result.action }])
      if (restore) setRecovered(true)
      delivered.current.add(responseId)
      if (retry.current?.payload.request_id === result.request_id) { retry.current = null; setDraft('') }
    }
    if (value.status !== 'ready' && value.status !== 'completed') setError(notices[value.status] || 'No pudimos completar la consulta. Puedes recuperar su estado.')
  }

  function settle(outcome, options) {
    if (outcome.error) {
      if (outcome.error.result?.state) accept(outcome.error.result)
      setError(notices[outcome.error.message] || 'No pudimos confirmar la respuesta. Puedes consultar su estado o explorar nuestros servicios.')
      if (outcome.error.message === 'provider_failed') retry.current = { ...retry.current, fresh: true }
      return
    }
    accept(outcome.value, options)
    if (outcome.value.status === 'completed') { retry.current = null; setDraft('') }
    else if (outcome.value.status === 'failed') retry.current = { ...retry.current, fresh: true }
  }

  function loadSession({ restoreMessages = true, fresh = false } = {}) {
    return remote.run((signal) => api.session({ signal, fresh }), (outcome) => {
      setError('')
      settle(outcome, { restore: restoreMessages })
    })
  }

  function send(text = draft, retrying = false, placement = 'floating_chat') {
    const content = text.trim()
    const state = current.current?.state
    if (!state || !content || content.length > 1000 || (!retrying && (!state.can_send || !current.current.provider_enabled))) return false
    const previousRetry = retry.current
    if (retrying && previousRetry?.fresh && (!state.can_send || !current.current.provider_enabled)) return false
    const payload = retrying && previousRetry
      ? { ...previousRetry.payload, request_id: previousRetry.fresh ? crypto.randomUUID() : previousRetry.payload.request_id }
      : { conversation_id: state.conversation_id, request_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          messages: [...messages, { role: 'user', content }].slice(-12).map(({ role, content: message }) => ({ role, content: message })) }
    const accepted = remote.run((signal) => api.send(payload, { signal }), (outcome) => settle(outcome, { requestId: payload.request_id }))
    if (!accepted) return false
    retry.current = { payload, fresh: false }
    setError('')
    setDraft(content)
    if (!retrying) setMessages((previous) => [...previous, { role: 'user', content }])
    if (!engaged.current.has(state.conversation_id)) {
      engaged.current.add(state.conversation_id)
      trackEvent('chatbot_engaged', { placement })
    }
    return true
  }

  function command(operation) {
    const state = current.current?.state
    if (!state) return false
    return remote.run((signal) => api.command(operation, state.conversation_id, { signal }), (outcome) => {
      setError('')
      settle(outcome)
    })
  }

  return { messages, session, draft, setDraft, error, recovered, pending: remote.pending,
    loadSession, send, command, retry: () => send(retry.current?.payload.messages.at(-1).content || draft, true),
    canRetry: Boolean(retry.current && (!retry.current.fresh || session?.state.can_send)), retryIsFresh: Boolean(retry.current?.fresh) }
}
```

### `src/hooks/useChatbotModal/useChatbotModal.js`

SHA-256: `4cbbe0fa3027b4ec5c4af225bb25fa1ab682d84e8168b485284866d7c3a293c2` · 57 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

const focusableSelector = 'a[href], button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]'

export function useChatbotModal({ active, panelRef, shellRef, launcherRef, onClose }) {
  const close = useRef(onClose)
  close.current = onClose

  useEffect(() => {
    const panel = panelRef.current
    const shell = shellRef.current
    if (!active || !panel || !shell) return

    const background = [...document.body.children].filter((node) => node !== shell)
      .map((node) => ({ node, inert: node.getAttribute('inert') }))
    const savedStyles = []
    function setStyle(node, property, value) {
      savedStyles.push({ node, property, value: node.style.getPropertyValue(property), priority: node.style.getPropertyPriority(property) })
      node.style.setProperty(property, value)
    }
    const root = document.documentElement
    const gutter = root.clientWidth > 0 ? Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - root.clientWidth) : 0
    if (gutter) setStyle(document.body, 'padding-right', `${(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.body).paddingRight) || 0) + gutter}px`)
    setStyle(root, 'overflow', 'hidden')
    setStyle(document.body, 'overflow', 'hidden')
    background.forEach(({ node }) => node.setAttribute('inert', ''))
    panel.focus({ preventScroll: true })

    function containFocus(event) {
      if (!panel.contains(event.target)) panel.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    }
    function keydown(event) {
      if (event.defaultPrevented) return
      if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); close.current(); return }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return
      const controls = [...panel.querySelectorAll(focusableSelector)].filter((node) => {
        const style = getComputedStyle(node)
        return node.tabIndex >= 0 && !node.matches(':disabled') && !node.closest('[hidden], [inert]') && style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden'
      })
      const first = controls[0], last = controls.at(-1)
      const focused = document.activeElement
      if (!first || !panel.contains(focused) || focused === panel || (event.shiftKey ? focused === first : focused === last)) {
        event.preventDefault()
        ;(event.shiftKey ? last || panel : first || panel).focus({ preventScroll: true })
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('focusin', containFocus)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', keydown)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('focusin', containFocus)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', keydown)
      background.forEach(({ node, inert }) => inert === null ? node.removeAttribute('inert') : node.setAttribute('inert', inert))
      savedStyles.reverse().forEach(({ node, property, value, priority }) => value ? node.style.setProperty(property, value, priority) : node.style.removeProperty(property))
      if (launcherRef.current?.isConnected) launcherRef.current.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    }
  }, [active, panelRef, shellRef, launcherRef])
}
```

SHA-256: `c92866ee81dff858d7f059100971eb94a6eb701f4e41dcdc3c07f20cff51d9c8` · 25 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect } from 'react'

// The mobile keyboard can shrink the visual viewport without changing 100dvh.
export function useChatbotViewport(ref, active) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const viewport = window.visualViewport
    const node = ref.current
    if (!active || !viewport || !node) return
    const update = () => {
      node.style.setProperty('--chat-viewport-height', `${viewport.height}px`)
      node.style.setProperty('--chat-viewport-bottom', `${Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - viewport.height - viewport.offsetTop)}px`)
      node.toggleAttribute('data-compact', viewport.height < 600)
    }
    update()
    viewport.addEventListener('resize', update)
    viewport.addEventListener('scroll', update)
    return () => {
      viewport.removeEventListener('resize', update)
      viewport.removeEventListener('scroll', update)
      node.style.removeProperty('--chat-viewport-height')
      node.style.removeProperty('--chat-viewport-bottom')
      node.removeAttribute('data-compact')
    }
  }, [ref, active])
}
```

SHA-256: `8f3eb403858f9ca956880bee638b300a38c25b1316706f414a5d5c17197194f6` · 24 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useDelayedOperation } from '../useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js'

export function useContactCapture(submitContact, onSaved, metrics) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('idle')
  const request = useRef(null)
  const remote = useDelayedOperation(15000)

  function save(fields) {
    const signature = JSON.stringify(fields)
    if (request.current?.signature !== signature) request.current = { signature, id: crypto.randomUUID() }
    const payload = { ...fields, request_id: request.current.id }
    const accepted = remote.run((signal) => submitContact(payload, { signal }), ({ value, error }) => {
      const outcome = !error && value?.status === 'saved' ? 'saved' : value?.status === 'rate_limited' ? 'rate_limited' : 'unavailable'
      setStatus(outcome)
      if (outcome === 'saved') { metrics?.success(); onSaved() }
      else metrics?.error(outcome)
    })
    if (accepted) metrics?.attempt()
    return accepted
  }

  return { status, pending: remote.pending, save, reset: () => setStatus('idle') }
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-hooks-usedelayedoperation-usedelayedoperation-js"></a>

### `src/hooks/useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js`

SHA-256: `fbcd66cfa92bff1df33e129edab45f069191be18d0a57e76bcb49984a37eecb0` · 44 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { BASE_DELAY_MS } from '../../config/loading.js'

// One independent remote region: request/deadline, then the base reveal delay.
export function useDelayedOperation(timeoutMs = 40000) {
  const active = useRef(null)
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => () => {
    const task = active.current
    active.current = null
    task?.controller.abort()
    clearTimeout(task?.deadline)
    clearTimeout(task?.timer)
  }, [])

  function run(work, settle) {
    if (active.current) return false
    const task = { controller: new AbortController() }
    active.current = task
    setPending(true)
    const deadline = new Promise((_, reject) => {
      task.deadline = setTimeout(() => {
        task.controller.abort()
        reject(new Error('request_timeout'))
      }, timeoutMs)
    })
    Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(() => work(task.controller.signal)), deadline])
      .then((value) => ({ value }), (error) => ({ error }))
      .then((outcome) => {
        clearTimeout(task.deadline)
        if (active.current !== task) return
        task.timer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (active.current !== task) return
          active.current = null
          setPending(false)
          settle(outcome)
        }, BASE_DELAY_MS)
      })
    return true
  }

  return { pending, run }
}
```

```javascript
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDelayedOperation())
    act(() => { expect(result.current.run(work, settle)).toBe(true); expect(result.current.run(work, settle)).toBe(false) })
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
    expect(settle).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
    expect(settle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: expect.any(Error) })
    expect(work).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(result.current.pending).toBe(false)
  })
  it('has a deadline even if the adapter ignores abort', async () => {
    const settle = vi.fn()
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDelayedOperation(1000))
    act(() => result.current.run(() => new Promise(() => {}), settle))
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1799))
    expect(settle).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
    expect(settle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ error: expect.objectContaining({ message: 'request_timeout' }) })
  })
  it('aborts and discards late results without scheduling a new timer', async () => {
    let resolve, signal
    const settle = vi.fn()
    const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useDelayedOperation())
    act(() => result.current.run((value) => { signal = value; return new Promise((done) => { resolve = done }) }, settle))
    await act(async () => Promise.resolve())
    unmount()
    expect(signal.aborted).toBe(true)
    await act(async () => resolve('late'))
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
    expect(settle).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})
```

```javascript
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { createFormMetrics } from '../../services/formMetrics.js'

export function useFormMetrics({ kind, placement, service, source }) {
  const selected = useRef(service)
  selected.current = service
  const current = useRef(null)
  const key = `${kind}:${placement}:${source}`
  if (current.current?.key !== key) current.current = { key, metrics: createFormMetrics({ kind, placement, source, service: () => selected.current }) }
  return current.current.metrics
}
```

### `src/hooks/useInterestSubmission/useInterestSubmission.js`

SHA-256: `e84f5552b838e89d2e52b217de3918fad6e16d2dea4e5fe0ba13d407ab1d5dc6` · 45 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { BASE_DELAY_MS } from '../../config/loading.js'

export function useInterestSubmission(submitInterest, metrics) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('idle')
  const active = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => () => {
    active.current?.controller.abort()
    clearTimeout(active.current?.timer)
    clearTimeout(active.current?.deadline)
    active.current = null
  }, [])

  async function submit(payload) {
    if (active.current) return
    metrics?.attempt()
    const task = { controller: new AbortController() }
    active.current = task
    setStatus('submitting')
    task.deadline = setTimeout(() => task.controller.abort(), 20000)
    let outcome = 'unavailable'
    let errorCode = 'unavailable'
    try {
      const result = await submitInterest(payload, { signal: task.controller.signal })
      if (result?.status === 'saved') outcome = 'saved'
      if (result?.status === 'rate_limited') outcome = 'rate_limited'
    } catch {
      errorCode = task.controller.signal.aborted ? 'timeout' : 'network'
      // A failed or interrupted request never produces a success message.
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(task.deadline)
    }
    if (active.current !== task) return
    task.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (active.current !== task) return
      active.current = null
      setStatus(outcome)
      if (outcome === 'saved') metrics?.success()
      else metrics?.error(outcome === 'rate_limited' ? outcome : errorCode)
    }, BASE_DELAY_MS)
  }

  return { status, submit, reset: () => { metrics?.reset(); setStatus('idle') } }
}
```

### `src/hooks/useModalPresence/useModalPresence.js`

SHA-256: `fe7142ef6c9d4b458025f4c73d73ccc56990c66c1f09094da525a22d1aa7ab0e` · 24 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export const MODAL_FADE_MS = 240

// Keep the panel mounted throughout its exit, including rapid close/reopen cycles.
export function useModalPresence(open, enabled = true) {
  const [retained, setRetained] = useState(false)
  const present = enabled && (open || retained)
  const exiting = present && !open

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) { setRetained(false); return }
    if (open) { setRetained(true); return }
    if (window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { setRetained(false); return }
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setRetained(false), MODAL_FADE_MS)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [open, enabled])

  function finishExit(event) {
    if (exiting && event.target === event.currentTarget && event.animationName === 'chat-exit') setRetained(false)
  }

  return { present, exiting, finishExit }
}
```

```javascript
it('retains the modal until its exit ends and cancels stale closing timers on reopen', () => {
  const { result, rerender } = renderHook(({ open }) => useModalPresence(open), { initialProps: { open: false } })
  expect(result.current.present).toBe(false)
  rerender({ open: true })
  expect(result.current.present).toBe(true)

  expect(result.current.present).toBe(true)
  expect(result.current.exiting).toBe(false)

  act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(MODAL_FADE_MS))
  expect(result.current.present).toBe(false)
})
```

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useAnalyticsConsent } from '../../contexts/AnalyticsConsentContext/AnalyticsConsentContext.jsx'
import { createPageContext } from '../../services/analyticsPageContext.js'
import { updateAnalyticsPage } from '../../services/analyticsRuntime.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'

export function usePageAnalytics(path, ready) {
  const preferences = useAnalyticsConsent()
  const current = useRef(null)
  if (current.current?.path !== path) current.current = { path, sent: false,
    page: createPageContext(path, preferences?.consent.analytics
      ? current.current?.page?.page_location || (typeof document === 'undefined' ? '' : document.referrer) : '') }
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = current.current
    updateAnalyticsPage(view.page)
    if (!ready || view.sent || !preferences?.consent.analytics) return
    const { page_title, page_location, page_referrer } = view.page
    if (trackEvent('page_view', { page_title, page_location, page_referrer })) view.sent = true
  }, [path, ready, preferences?.consent])
}
```

### `src/hooks/usePageDelay/usePageDelay.js`

SHA-256: `01f404c43571cddd0877f02e6f0674f23a4ed17dc316798f236d36fef1be5f37` · 18 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

import { BASE_DELAY_MS } from '../../config/loading.js'
export { BASE_DELAY_MS }

export function usePageDelay(key, delay = BASE_DELAY_MS) {
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(null)
  const cycle = useRef({ key, delay, id: 0 })
  if (cycle.current.key !== key || cycle.current.delay !== delay) cycle.current = { key, delay, id: cycle.current.id + 1 }
  const id = cycle.current.id

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setSettled(id), delay)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [key, delay, id])

  return settled === id
}
```

### `src/hooks/usePageSensors/usePageSensors.js`

SHA-256: `732b896327f5a193287aff5444a67624628396dea55f6687e0e753a839a9d74c` · 57 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useAnalyticsConsent } from '../../contexts/AnalyticsConsentContext/AnalyticsConsentContext.jsx'
import { analyticsAllowed } from '../../services/analyticsPermission.js'
import { exposureFor } from '../../services/analyticsSensors.js'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'

export function usePageSensors(path, ready) {
  const preferences = useAnalyticsConsent()
  const view = useRef(null)
  if (view.current?.path !== path) view.current = { path, seen: new Set() }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !preferences?.consent.analytics || !analyticsAllowed() || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return
    const seen = view.current.seen
    const targets = new Map()
    function stop(state) { clearTimeout(state.timer); state.timer = null }
    function schedule(element, state) {
      stop(state)
      if (!state.visible || document.visibilityState !== 'visible' || seen.has(state.key)) return
      state.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (analyticsAllowed() && state.visible && document.visibilityState === 'visible' && trackEvent(state.name, state.params)) {
          seen.add(state.key)
          observer.unobserve(element)
        }
      }, 1000)
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const state = targets.get(entry.target)
        if (!state) continue
        state.visible = entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= .5
        schedule(entry.target, state)
      }
    }, { threshold: [.5] })
    function discover() {
      for (const [element, state] of targets) if (!element.isConnected) { stop(state); observer.unobserve(element); targets.delete(element) }
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-analytics-section], [data-analytics-cta]').forEach((element) => {
        if (targets.has(element)) return
        const exposure = exposureFor(element)
        if (!exposure) return
        const key = `${exposure.name}:${JSON.stringify(exposure.params)}`
        if (seen.has(key)) return
        targets.set(element, { ...exposure, key, timer: null, visible: false })
        observer.observe(element)
      })
    }
    function visibility() { targets.forEach((state, element) => schedule(element, state)) }
    discover()
    const mutations = new MutationObserver(discover)
    mutations.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true })
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility)
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect(); mutations.disconnect()
      targets.forEach(stop)
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility)
    }
  }, [path, ready, preferences?.consent.analytics])
}
```

### `src/hooks/useScrollThreshold/useScrollThreshold.js`

SHA-256: `c980543d938e08863fedae5c11efe5854247392b958eec73ec99a37bb16a2261` · 15 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export function useScrollThreshold(threshold = 64, enabled = true) {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return
    const update = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > threshold)
    update()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', update)
  }, [threshold, enabled])

  return enabled && scrolled
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-hooks-usesitenavigation-usesitenavigation-js"></a>

### `src/hooks/useSiteNavigation/useSiteNavigation.js`

SHA-256: `2d5f964a82f3e6a26ecc62cfe69e848564d969cc308af8a6145ff6a4713800d3` · 34 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const locationSnapshot = () => ({ pathname: window.location.pathname, hash: window.location.hash })

// Keep ordinary anchors (new tabs, downloads and external destinations) native.
export function useSiteNavigation(paths, initialPath = '/') {
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(() => typeof window === 'undefined' ? { pathname: initialPath, hash: '' } : locationSnapshot())

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setLocation(locationSnapshot())
    function navigate(event) {
      if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return
      const anchor = event.target.closest?.('a[href]')
      if (!anchor || (anchor.target && anchor.target !== '_self') || anchor.hasAttribute('download') || anchor.getAttribute('href').startsWith('#')) return
      const url = new URL(anchor.href, window.location.href)
      const path = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
      if (url.origin !== window.location.origin || !paths.includes(path)) return
      event.preventDefault()
      if (url.href === window.location.href) return
      window.history.pushState({}, '', `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`)
      sync()
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', navigate)
    window.addEventListener('popstate', sync)
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', sync)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('click', navigate)
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', sync)
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', sync)
    }
  }, [paths])

  return location
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-hooks-usesitenavigation-usesitenavigation-test-js"></a>

### `src/hooks/useSiteNavigation/useSiteNavigation.test.js`

SHA-256: `2d97146f27534dd33bd75a7c88d4563d9e1235e912c2dc09b6d7a62388f9e6f0` · 48 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { act, fireEvent, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { useSiteNavigation } from './useSiteNavigation.js'

const paths = ['/', '/cursos', '/chatbot']
afterEach(() => { window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/'); vi.restoreAllMocks() })

function click(href, props = {}, event = {}) {
  const anchor = Object.assign(document.createElement('a'), { href, ...props })
  document.body.append(anchor)
  const navigated = !fireEvent.click(anchor, event)
  anchor.remove()
  return navigated
}

it('navigates internal routes and anchors and synchronizes back/forward', () => {
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useSiteNavigation(paths))
  act(() => { expect(click('/cursos#interes-online')).toBe(true) })
  expect(result.current).toEqual({ pathname: '/cursos', hash: '#interes-online' })
  act(() => { window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/chatbot'); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')) })
  expect(result.current.pathname).toBe('/chatbot')
})

it('leaves modified clicks, external URLs, downloads and other targets to the browser', () => {
  // Cancel native jsdom navigation only after our handler has had a chance to run.
  const decisions = []
  renderHook(() => useSiteNavigation(paths))
  const cancel = (event) => { decisions.push(event.defaultPrevented); event.preventDefault() }
  document.addEventListener('click', cancel)
  try {
    click('/cursos', {}, { ctrlKey: true })
    click('/cursos', {}, { metaKey: true })
    click('/cursos', { target: '_blank' })
    click('/cursos', { download: 'file' })
    click('https://example.com/cursos')
    click('/api/chat')
    click('#main-content')
    expect(decisions).toEqual(Array(7).fill(false))
    expect(window.location.pathname).toBe('/')
  } finally { document.removeEventListener('click', cancel) }
})

it('removes global handlers when unmounted', () => {
  const remove = vi.spyOn(document, 'removeEventListener')
  const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useSiteNavigation(paths))
  unmount()
  expect(remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('click', expect.any(Function))
})
```

### `src/pages/AdminPage/AdminPage.jsx`

SHA-256: `4612cb532df87eae8ff1cb39bc12125858786505a9e58b38da1fdc4411064436` · 38 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { useAdminQuery } from '../../hooks/useAdminQuery/useAdminQuery.js'
import { useDelayedOperation } from '../../hooks/useDelayedOperation/useDelayedOperation.js'
import { getAdminSession, adminRequest, adminErrorMessage } from '../../services/adminService.js'
import AdminLogin from '../../components/AdminLogin/AdminLogin.jsx'
import AdminDashboard from '../../components/AdminDashboard/AdminDashboard.jsx'
import AdminPageSkeleton from './AdminPageSkeleton.jsx'
import './AdminPage.css'

export default function AdminPage({ loadSession = getAdminSession }) {
  const session = useAdminQuery(loadSession)
  const [account, setAccount] = useState(undefined)
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState(null)
  const remote = useDelayedOperation(15000)
  const expired = useCallback(() => { setAccount(null); setNotice('Tu sesión terminó. Vuelve a ingresar.') }, [])
  const passwordChanged = useCallback(() => { setAccount(null); setNotice('Contraseña actualizada. Ingresa con tu nueva contraseña.') }, [])
  const username = account === undefined ? session.data?.username : account
  const checking = account === undefined && session.pending
  const failed = account === undefined && session.error && session.error.status !== 'unauthorized'
  function logout() {
    setError(null)
    remote.run((signal) => adminRequest({ operation: 'logout' }, signal), ({ error: failure }) => {
      if (failure && failure.status !== 'unauthorized') setError(failure)
      else { setAccount(null); setNotice('Sesión cerrada.') }
    })
  }
  return <main className="admin-page" id="main-content" data-clarity-mask="true">
    <header className="admin-page__header"><a href="/">Nicolás Zamara <span>Administración</span></a>{username && <div><span>{username}</span><button type="button" onClick={logout} disabled={remote.pending}>{remote.pending ? 'Cerrando sesión…' : 'Cerrar sesión'}</button></div>}</header>
    <div className="admin-page__body">
      {checking ? <AdminPageSkeleton /> : failed ? <section role="alert"><p>{adminErrorMessage(session.error)}</p><button type="button" onClick={session.reload}>Reintentar acceso</button></section>
        : username ? <AdminDashboard onExpired={expired} onPasswordChanged={passwordChanged} />
          : <AdminLogin onAuthenticated={setAccount} notice={notice} />}
      {error && <p role="alert">{adminErrorMessage(error)}</p>}
      {remote.pending && <div className="admin-page__logout" role="status" aria-label="Cerrando sesión" aria-busy="true"><AdminPageSkeleton /></div>}
    </div>
  </main>
}
```

### `src/pages/ChatbotPage/ChatbotPage.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `538a71f895dfe6cb9d7a3a42bcafdfb2e92d4c825276214a69c023a2ef6dee79` · 82 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import ChatbotPage from './ChatbotPage.jsx'
import { mockChatApi, sessionResult } from '../../test/chatbotFixtures.js'

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers())
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

it('allows a draft during session recovery and waits for recovery plus 800 ms before sending', async () => {
  const api = mockChatApi()
  let resolve
  api.session.mockImplementation(() => new Promise((done) => { resolve = done }))
  render(<ChatbotPage api={api} />)
  expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: '¿En qué podemos ayudarte?' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByText('Escríbenos tu consulta o elige una opción para conocer nuestros servicios.')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /cerrar asistente|te ayudamos a elegir/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByRole('status', { name: 'Preparando orientación' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2000))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toBeEnabled()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta'), { target: { value: 'Quiero conocer el curso' } })
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeDisabled()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toHaveAccessibleDescription(/conectando con el asistente/i)
  await act(async () => resolve(sessionResult()))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toHaveValue('Quiero conocer el curso')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeDisabled()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toBeEnabled()
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeEnabled()
  expect(api.session).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  expect(screen.queryByRole('complementary')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Temas sugeridos')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByRole('log', { name: 'Conversación' })).toBeEmptyDOMElement()
  const navigation = screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Explorar servicios' })
  expect(within(navigation).getByRole('link', { name: 'Consulta' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/consulta')
  expect(within(navigation).getByRole('link', { name: 'Curso online' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/cursos#interes-online')
  expect(within(navigation).getAllByRole('link')).toHaveLength(6)
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta').closest('form').compareDocumentPosition(navigation) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar estado' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta'), { target: { value: 'Quiero conocer el curso' } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(api.send).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /ver el curso e inscribirme/i })).toHaveAttribute('target', '_blank')
})

it('requests a fresh conversation and opens without the previous response', async () => {
  const previousReply = 'Para aprender más sobre Flores de Bach, Nicolás ofrece un curso.'
  const api = mockChatApi(sessionResult({ completed_rounds: 2, last_result: { reply: previousReply, request_id: 'previous-request' } }))
  render(<ChatbotPage api={api} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.queryByText(previousReply)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByRole('log', { name: 'Conversación' })).toBeEmptyDOMElement()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toBeEnabled()
  expect(api.session).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ fresh: true }))
  expect(api.command).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  expect(api.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
})

it('shows a recoverable session failure after the delay', async () => {
  const api = mockChatApi()
  api.session.mockRejectedValue(new Error('storage_unavailable'))
  render(<ChatbotPage api={api} />)
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(799))
  expect(screen.queryByRole('alert')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1))
  expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar estado' })).toBeEnabled()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta'), { target: { value: 'Mi consulta pendiente' } })
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toHaveValue('Mi consulta pendiente')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeDisabled()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('status', { name: 'Preparando orientación' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toHaveAccessibleDescription(/tu mensaje no se ha enviado/i)
  api.session.mockResolvedValue(sessionResult())
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar estado' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Escribe tu consulta')).toHaveValue('Mi consulta pendiente')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeEnabled()
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }))
  await act(async () => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(800))
  expect(api.send).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
})
```

```css
.consult-page { max-width: 1000px; padding-block: 75px 90px; }

.consult-page__photo-frame { position: relative; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.consult-page__photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }

.consult-page__steps { margin-top: 65px; }
.consult-page__steps ol { margin: 30px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: step; }
.consult-page__steps li { position: relative; min-height: 90px; padding: 4px 0 28px 65px; color: var(--color-muted); line-height: 1.9; counter-increment: step; }
.consult-page__steps li::before { content: counter(step, decimal-leading-zero); position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; color: var(--color-sage-dark); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2.1rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.consult-page__steps strong { color: var(--color-navy); font-weight: 600; }

.consult-page__details > div:only-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.consult-page__details dl { margin: 0; }
.consult-page__details dl div { padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #a6b4a9; }
.consult-page__details dt { color: var(--color-navy); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; }
.consult-page__details dd { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .82rem; }
.consult-page__faq { margin-top: 70px; }
.consult-page__faq details { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.consult-page__faq details:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.consult-page__faq summary { padding: 22px 5px; color: var(--color-navy); font-weight: 600; font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; }
.consult-page__faq details p { max-width: 760px; padding: 0 5px 24px; margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.9; }

.consult-page__contact h2 { max-width: 500px; margin-bottom: 20px; color: white; font-size: 2.75rem; }
.consult-page__contact p { margin: 0; color: #f1f3ee; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.9; }
.consult-page__contact .action-link { flex: none; }

@media(max-width: 700px) { .consult-page { padding-block: 48px 60px; } .consult-page__details { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 22px; padding: 26px; } .consult-page__contact { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px; } .consult-page__contact h2 { font-size: 2.4rem; } }
@media(max-width: 700px) { .consult-page__intro { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; } .consult-page__photo-frame { width: 100%; max-width: 430px; aspect-ratio: 960 / 1439; justify-self: center; } }
```

### `src/pages/ConsultationPage/ConsultationPage.jsx`

SHA-256: `8be28c3c8ae38feb47ad4780fc3c5402f1d49e19755855f7f4bf6c56ad422aaa` · 86 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { useSiteContent } from '../../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import ActionLink from '../../components/ActionLink/ActionLink.jsx'
import InterestForm from '../../components/InterestForm/InterestForm.jsx'
import { trackEvent } from '../../services/analyticsService.js'
import { homeContent } from '../../content/siteContent.js'
import './ConsultationPage.css'

const questions = [
  { question: '¿Tengo que escoger una técnica antes de consultar?', answer: 'No. El primer paso es conversar y conocer tu necesidad. Las alternativas se revisan a partir de una evaluación individual.' },
  { question: '¿El mensaje por WhatsApp confirma una hora?', answer: 'No. El mensaje inicia una conversación para coordinar disponibilidad; la hora queda confirmada únicamente después de acordarla directamente.' },
  { question: '¿Cuánto dura una sesión y cuánto cuesta?', answer: 'Puedes consultar la duración y el valor de la sesión al coordinar tu atención.' },
]

export default function ConsultationPage() {
  const { contact } = useSiteContent()
  const practicalDetails = [
    ['Ubicación', contact.address],
    ['Accesibilidad', contact.accessibility],
    ['Horarios', contact.hours],
    ['Duración', contact.sessionDuration],
    ['Valor', contact.sessionPrice],
  ].filter(([, value]) => value)
  const whatsappHref = contact.whatsappNumber
    ? `https://wa.me/${contact.whatsappNumber.replace(/\D/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Hola, quisiera consultar disponibilidad para una sesión.')}`
    : ''

  return (
    <main id="main-content" className="consult-page page-wrap">
      <header className="consult-page__intro">
        <div className="consult-page__photo-frame">
        <img
          className="consult-page__photo"
          src="/photos/consulta-maya-925-960.jpg"
          srcSet="/photos/consulta-maya-925-480.jpg 480w, /photos/consulta-maya-925-960.jpg 960w"
          sizes="(max-width: 700px) calc(100vw - 40px), (max-width: 1064px) 42vw, 430px"
          alt="Nicolás Zamara conversando con una persona en su consulta"
          width="960"
          height="1439"
          fetchPriority="high"
        />
        </div>
        <h1 data-analytics-section="consultation_intro">{homeContent.consultation.title}</h1>
      </header>

      <section className="consult-page__steps" aria-labelledby="consult-steps-title">
        <h2 id="consult-steps-title" data-analytics-section="consultation_steps">Cómo comienza</h2>
        <p>{homeContent.consultation.description}</p>
        <p>{homeContent.consultation.additional}</p>
      </section>

      <section className="consult-page__details" aria-labelledby="consult-details-title">
        <div>
          <h2 id="consult-details-title" data-analytics-section="consultation_details">Cada consulta, con claridad desde el inicio.</h2>
          <p>Puedes consultar la ubicación, accesibilidad, horarios, duración y valores al coordinar tu atención.</p>
        </div>
        {practicalDetails.length > 0 && <dl>
          {practicalDetails.map(([label, value]) => <div key={label}><dt>{label}</dt><dd>{value}</dd></div>)}
        </dl>}
      </section>

      <section className="consult-page__faq" aria-labelledby="consult-faq-title">
        <h2 id="consult-faq-title" data-analytics-section="consultation_faq">Antes de escribir</h2>
        {questions.map((item) => (
          <details key={item.question}>
            <summary>{item.question}</summary>
            <p>{item.answer}</p>
          </details>
        ))}
      </section>

      <div id="interes-consulta" className="consult-page__interest">
        <InterestForm kind="consultation" />
      </div>

      <section className="consult-page__contact" aria-labelledby="consult-contact-title">
        <div>
          <h2 id="consult-contact-title" data-analytics-section="consultation_contact">¿Quieres conversar sobre disponibilidad?</h2>
          <p>El contacto sirve para coordinar. No equivale a una reserva confirmada.</p>
        </div>
        {whatsappHref
          ? <ActionLink analytics={{ element_id: 'consultation_whatsapp', placement: 'consultation_contact', service: 'consultation' }} href={whatsappHref} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" onClick={() => trackEvent('whatsapp_click', { element_id: 'consultation_whatsapp', placement: 'consultation_contact', service: 'consultation' })}>Consultar disponibilidad por WhatsApp <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></ActionLink>
          : <p className="consult-page__availability" role="status">El contacto por WhatsApp no está disponible en este momento.</p>}
      </section>
    </main>
  )
}
```

### `src/pages/ConsultationPage/ConsultationPage.test.jsx`

SHA-256: `b1b87bbee48fca49a336fa353691894d6858e72966af585e223e4dad26afd240` · 45 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```jsx
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { SiteContentProvider } from '../../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import ConsultationPage from './ConsultationPage.jsx'
import ConsultationPageSkeleton from './ConsultationPageSkeleton.jsx'

describe('ConsultationPage', () => {
  it('explica evaluación individual y no promete una reserva', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><ConsultationPage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    expect(screen.getByText(/La acupuntura y las técnicas complementarias se eligen según cada caso/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    const whatsapp = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Consultar disponibilidad por WhatsApp/i })
    expect(whatsapp).toHaveAttribute('href', `https://wa.me/56953961219?text=${encodeURIComponent('Hola, quisiera consultar disponibilidad para una sesión.')}`)
    expect(whatsapp).toHaveAttribute('target', '_blank')
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Me interesa agendar una consulta' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('definition')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/versión de pruebas/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('presenta únicamente los datos prácticos configurados', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider value={{ contact: { address: 'Dirección confirmada', sessionDuration: '60 minutos' } }}><ConsultationPage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('term')).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(screen.getByText('Dirección confirmada')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('60 minutos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Valor')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('ofrece un skeleton propio', () => {
    const { container } = render(<ConsultationPageSkeleton />)
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Cargando consulta')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
    expect(container.querySelector('.consult-skeleton__photo')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(container.querySelector('.consult-skeleton__title')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(container.querySelector('.interest-form-skeleton')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('presenta la foto MAYA-925 antes del texto dentro del hero', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><ConsultationPage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Nicolás Zamara conversando con una persona en su consulta' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/consulta-maya-925-960.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/consulta-maya-925-480.jpg 480w, /photos/consulta-maya-925-960.jpg 960w')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high')
    expect(photo.parentElement).toHaveClass('consult-page__photo-frame')
    expect(photo.parentElement.nextElementSibling).toBe(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 }))
    expect(photo.parentElement.parentElement).toHaveClass('consult-page__intro')
  })
})
```

```jsx
import InterestForm from '../../components/InterestForm/InterestForm.jsx'
import ActionLink from '../../components/ActionLink/ActionLink.jsx'

import { homeContent } from '../../content/siteContent.js'
import { trackHotmartClick } from '../../services/hotmartTrackingService.js'
import './CoursesPage.css'

export default function CoursesPage() {
  const { courseUrl } = useSiteContent()
  return (
    <main id="main-content" className="courses-page">
      <header className="courses-page__intro page-wrap">
        <h1 data-analytics-section="courses_intro">Aprender para acompañar con más atención.</h1>
        <p>Una formación para acercarse a las Flores de Bach desde la vida cotidiana, con un uso responsable y respeto por la autonomía de cada persona.</p>
      </header>

      <section className="courses-page__course page-wrap" aria-labelledby="bach-title">
        <div className="courses-page__course-copy">
          <h2 id="bach-title" data-analytics-section="courses_offer">{homeContent.course.title}</h2>
          <p>{homeContent.course.description}</p>
          <p>{homeContent.course.additional}</p>
          <div className="courses-page__actions">
            <ActionLink analytics={{ element_id: 'courses_hotmart', placement: 'courses_offer', service: 'course' }} href={courseUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" onClick={() => { void trackHotmartClick('course', { element_id: 'courses_hotmart', placement: 'courses_offer', service: 'course' }) }}>Ver el curso e inscribirme <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></ActionLink>
            <ActionLink analytics={{ element_id: 'courses_online_interest', placement: 'courses_offer', service: 'online' }} href="/cursos#interes-online" variant="text">Me interesa la modalidad online</ActionLink>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="courses-page__photo-frame">
        <img
          className="courses-page__photo"
          src="/photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg"
          srcSet="/photos/presentacion-botanica-640.jpg 640w, /photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg 1280w"
          sizes="(max-width: 640px) calc(100vw - 40px), (max-width: 1164px) 40vw, 406px"
          alt="Presentación de botánica con una flor amarilla proyectada en pantalla"
          width="1280"
          height="960"
          decoding="async"
        />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="courses-page__online" id="interes-online">
        <div className="page-wrap courses-page__online-inner">
          <div>
            <h2>Curso online para público hispanohablante.</h2>
            <p>Si te gustaría participar desde tu ciudad o país, déjame tus datos para recibir información cuando se abra una edición online.</p>
          </div>
          <InterestForm kind="online" />
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { SiteContentProvider } from '../../contexts/SiteContentContext/SiteContentContext.jsx'
import CoursesPage from './CoursesPage.jsx'
import CoursesPageSkeleton from './CoursesPageSkeleton.jsx'

describe('CoursesPage', () => {
  it('enlaza a la landing aprobada y distingue el interés de una matrícula', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><CoursesPage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /ver el curso e inscribirme/i })).toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://nzamara-mtc.hotmart.host/flores-de-bach-vida-cotidiana')
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/recibir información cuando se abra una edición online/i)[0]).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: /curso online para público hispanohablante/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Flores de Bach en modalidad online' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Me interesa la modalidad online' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/cursos#interes-online')
    expect(screen.queryByText(/futura modalidad online/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('ofrece un skeleton propio', () => {
    render(<CoursesPageSkeleton />)
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Cargando cursos')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
  })

  it('muestra la presentación botánica junto al texto del curso', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><CoursesPage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Presentación de botánica con una flor amarilla proyectada en pantalla' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/presentacion-botanica-640.jpg 640w, /photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg 1280w')
    expect(photo.closest('section')).toHaveAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'bach-title')
    expect(photo.parentElement).toHaveClass('courses-page__photo-frame')
    expect(photo.parentElement.previousElementSibling).toContainElement(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Flores de Bach para la vida cotidiana' }))
    expect(photo.parentElement.previousElementSibling).toContainElement(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /ver el curso e inscribirme/i }))
  })
})
```

```jsx
  })

  it('usa MAYA-844 junto a la biografía del inicio', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Nicolás Zamara sentado en un jardín' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/sobre-mi-maya-844-960.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/sobre-mi-maya-844-480.jpg 480w, /photos/sobre-mi-maya-844-960.jpg 960w')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('loading', 'lazy')
    expect(photo.closest('section')).toHaveAttribute('id', 'sobre-mi')
    expect(photo.nextElementSibling).toContainElement(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hola, soy Nicolás.' }))
  })
  it('usa la fotografía del curso en la sección Flores de Bach', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Presentación de botánica con una flor amarilla proyectada en pantalla' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/presentacion-botanica-640.jpg 640w, /photos/presentacion-botanica-1280.jpg 1280w')
    expect(photo.closest('section')).toHaveAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'home-course-title')
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Más información' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/naturaleza')
  })
  it('muestra las etiquetas y el enlace de interés online aprobados', () => {
    const { container } = render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    expect(container.querySelector('.home-consult-band__label')).toBeNull()
    expect(container.querySelector('.home-nature__label')).toHaveTextContent('Naturaleza y bienestar')
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Me interesa la modalidad online' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/cursos#interes-online')
  })
  it('presenta las tres áreas y los accesos a consulta y formación', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: /cuidar tu salud también es atender cómo te sientes/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /conoce la consulta/i })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/consulta')
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Consulta y terapias' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Cursos y formación' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Naturaleza y bienestar' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('muestra el skeleton de inicio mientras se prepara la página', () => {
    const { container } = render(<HomePageSkeleton />)
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Cargando inicio')).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true')
    expect(container.querySelectorAll('.home-page-skeleton__action')).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(container.querySelector('.home-page-skeleton__portrait')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('acompaña el hero con la fotografía de terapias integrales y variantes adaptables', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Nicolás Zamara conversando en su consulta' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/terapias-integrales-960.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/terapias-integrales-480.jpg 480w, /photos/terapias-integrales-960.jpg 960w')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high')
    expect(photo.closest('section')).toHaveAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'home-title')
  })

  it('muestra contemplando junto al texto de naturaleza', () => {
    render(<SiteContentProvider><HomePage /></SiteContentProvider>)
    const photo = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Una persona contemplando un lago turquesa rodeado de montañas nevadas' })
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', '/photos/contemplando-1200.jpg')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('srcset', '/photos/contemplando-600.jpg 600w, /photos/contemplando-1200.jpg 1200w')
    expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('loading', 'lazy')
    expect(photo.closest('section')).toHaveAttribute('id', 'naturaleza')
    expect(photo.parentElement.nextElementSibling).toContainElement(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Darte tiempo para estar en la naturaleza.' }))
  })
})
```

```jsx
import InterestForm from '../../components/InterestForm/InterestForm.jsx'
import ActionLink from '../../components/ActionLink/ActionLink.jsx'
import { natureContent } from '../../content/siteContent.js'
import './NaturePage.css'

export default function NaturePage() {
  return (
    <main id="main-content" className="nature-page">
      <section className="nature-page__hero" id="naturaleza" aria-labelledby="nature-title">
        <div className="nature-page__photo-frame">
          <img
            className="nature-page__photo"
            src="/photos/contemplando-1200.jpg"
            srcSet="/photos/contemplando-600.jpg 600w, /photos/contemplando-1200.jpg 1200w"
            sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 50vw"
            alt="Una persona contemplando un lago turquesa rodeado de montañas nevadas"
            width="1200"
            height="800"
            fetchPriority="high"
            decoding="async"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="nature-page__copy">
          <p className="nature-page__label">Naturaleza y bienestar</p>
          <h1 id="nature-title" data-analytics-section="nature_intro">{natureContent.title}</h1>
          {natureContent.paragraphs.map((paragraph) => <p key={paragraph}>{paragraph}</p>)}
          <ActionLink analytics={{ element_id: 'nature_interest', placement: 'nature_intro', service: 'nature' }} href="#interes-naturaleza">Me interesan los baños de bosque</ActionLink>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="nature-page__interest page-wrap" id="interes-naturaleza" aria-label="Registro de interés en naturaleza">
        <InterestForm kind="nature" placement="nature_page_form" />
      </section>
    </main>
  )
}
```

SHA-256: `aad81b7e379970e38dbb42f5f73d2d58e99f7560ad72adb4b282f602284ffad0` · 28 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
export class AdminError extends Error {
  constructor(status) { super(status); this.status = status }
}

export async function adminRequest(payload, signal) {
  const response = await fetch('/api/admin', {
    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', signal,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Admin-Request': '1' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  })
  const result = await response.json()
  if (!response.ok) throw new AdminError(result.status || 'unavailable')
  return result
}

export const getAdminSession = (signal) => adminRequest({ operation: 'session' }, signal)
export const getAdminInterests = (signal, key) => adminRequest({ operation: 'interests', ...JSON.parse(key) }, signal)
export const getAdminInterest = (signal, id) => adminRequest({ operation: 'detail', id }, signal)
export const markAdminInterestRead = (id, signal) => adminRequest({ operation: 'mark_read', id }, signal)

export const adminErrorMessage = (error) => ({
  invalid_credentials: 'Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.',
  rate_limited: 'Se alcanzó el límite de intentos. Espera 15 minutos para volver a intentar.',
  wrong_password: 'La contraseña actual no es correcta.',
  unauthorized: 'Tu sesión terminó. Vuelve a iniciar sesión.',
  not_found: 'Este interés ya no está disponible.',
  invalid: 'Revisa los datos ingresados.',
}[error?.status] || 'No pudimos completar la solicitud. Inténtalo nuevamente.')
```

<a id="archivo-src-services-analyticspagecontext-js"></a>

### `src/services/analyticsPageContext.js`

SHA-256: `250629c308aa03fb0f951f048e730eaf3e440131d2ad63ab0f31e258b888a8e9` · 27 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { pageMetadata } from '../content/siteContent.js'

const canonicalOrigin = 'https://www.nicolaszamara.com'
const pageTypes = { '/': 'home', '/consulta': 'consultation', '/terapias': 'therapies', '/cursos': 'courses',
  '/naturaleza': 'nature', '/sobre-mi': 'about', '/chatbot': 'chatbot', '/privacidad': 'privacy' }
const referrerHosts = ['www.google.com', 'www.google.cl', 'www.bing.com', 'www.instagram.com', 'www.facebook.com']

export function cleanReferrer(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value)
    if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || url.username || url.password || url.port) return ''
    if (['www.nicolaszamara.com', 'nicolaszamara.com'].includes(url.hostname)) {
      const path = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
      return Object.hasOwn(pageTypes, path) ? `${canonicalOrigin}${path}` : ''
    }
    return referrerHosts.includes(url.hostname) ? `${url.origin}/` : ''
  } catch { return '' }
}

export function createPageContext(pathname, referrer = '') {
  const path = typeof pathname === 'string' ? pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/' : '/404'
  const known = Object.hasOwn(pageTypes, path)
  const page_path = known ? path : '/404'
  return Object.freeze({ page_path, page_type: known ? pageTypes[path] : 'not_found',
    page_title: known ? pageMetadata[path].title : 'Página no encontrada | Nicolás Zamara',
    page_location: `${canonicalOrigin}${page_path}`, page_referrer: cleanReferrer(referrer) })
}
```

```javascript
import { getAnalyticsSettings } from '../config/analytics.js'
import { consentStore, CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS } from './consentService.js'

export function analyticsAllowed(category = 'analytics') {
  const consent = consentStore.getSnapshot()
  return getAnalyticsSettings().enabled && consent.status === 'accepted' && consent[category] === true
    && Date.now() - Date.parse(consent.updatedAt) < CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS
}
```
