<a id="archivo-src-services-analyticsruntime-js"></a>

### `src/services/analyticsRuntime.js`

SHA-256: `46418dc8dc6aa5fb13eef1a21fe8277244a011390fd676f2b88ff2e3ce4aafa0` · 37 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { getAnalyticsSettings } from '../config/analytics.js'
import { analyticsAllowed } from './analyticsPermission.js'
import { consentStore } from './consentService.js'
import { createGa4Adapter } from './ga4Adapter.js'
import { createPageContext } from './analyticsPageContext.js'
import { createMarketingTracker } from './marketingTracker.js'
import { createCampaignAttribution } from './campaignAttribution.js'

let runtime = null

function getRuntime() {
  if (runtime || typeof window === 'undefined') return runtime
  const settings = getAnalyticsSettings()
  const adapter = createGa4Adapter({ measurementId: settings.ga4Id, environment: settings.environment,
    allowed: analyticsAllowed, windowRef: window, documentRef: document })
  runtime = { adapter, page: createPageContext(window.location.pathname, document.referrer) }
  const attribution = createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: analyticsAllowed, storage: {
    getItem: (key) => window.sessionStorage.getItem(key), setItem: (key, value) => window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, value),
    removeItem: (key) => window.sessionStorage.removeItem(key),
  } })
  runtime.tracker = createMarketingTracker({ allowed: analyticsAllowed, adapter, page: () => {
    adapter.setCampaign(attribution.touch({ search: window.location.search, referrer: document.referrer })?.campaign)
    return runtime.page
  },
    dispatch: (eventName, params) => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('nzamara:metric', { detail: { eventName, params } })) })
  consentStore.subscribe(() => { if (!analyticsAllowed()) { runtime.tracker.revoke(); attribution.revoke() } })
  return runtime
}

export function updateAnalyticsPage(page) {
  const current = getRuntime()
  if (current) { current.page = page; current.adapter.updatePage(page) }
}

export function trackMarketingEvent(name, params) {
  return getRuntime()?.tracker.track(name, params) || false
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-services-analyticssensors-js"></a>

### `src/services/analyticsSensors.js`

SHA-256: `1a8f93dfbe3c48f8ff1163316093a4ea7c31c63af5eeef248130796367bb9d68` · 32 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { validateAnalyticsEvent } from '../config/analytics.js'

const navigationTargets = {
  '/': 'home', '/consulta': 'consultation', '/terapias': 'therapies', '/cursos': 'courses', '/naturaleza': 'nature',
  '/sobre-mi': 'about', '/privacidad': 'privacy', '/cursos#interes-online': 'online',
  '/consulta#consult-steps-title': 'steps', '/consulta#consult-contact-title': 'availability',
  '/naturaleza#interes-naturaleza': 'nature_interest', '/#interes-naturaleza': 'nature_interest',
}

export function navigationParams(href, placement) {
  const target = navigationTargets[href]
  const prefix = placement === 'header' ? 'nav' : placement === 'footer' ? 'footer' : 'chat'
  const params = { element_id: `${prefix}_${target}`, placement, destination_path: typeof href === 'string' ? href.split('#')[0] : '' }
  return target && validateAnalyticsEvent('navigation_click', params) ? params : null
}

export function ctaAttributes(params) {
  if (!params) return {}
  const value = { element_id: params.element_id, placement: params.placement, service: params.service }
  return validateAnalyticsEvent('cta_view', value) ? { 'data-analytics-cta': JSON.stringify(value) } : {}
}

export function exposureFor(element) {
  try {
    if (element.hasAttribute('data-analytics-section')) {
      const params = { section_id: element.getAttribute('data-analytics-section') }
      return validateAnalyticsEvent('section_view', params) ? { name: 'section_view', params } : null
    }
    const params = JSON.parse(element.getAttribute('data-analytics-cta'))
    return validateAnalyticsEvent('cta_view', params) ? { name: 'cta_view', params } : null
  } catch { return null }
}
```

```javascript
import { analyticsAllowed } from './analyticsPermission.js'
import { trackMarketingEvent } from './analyticsRuntime.js'

const allowedEvents = new Set([
  'hotmart_click',
  'whatsapp_click',
  'online_interest_saved',
  'nature_interest_saved',
  'consultation_interest_saved',
  'chat_contact_saved',
])

export function trackEvent(eventName, params) {
  if (params !== undefined) return trackMarketingEvent(eventName, params)
  // Legacy local-only events are removed control by control in M05/M06.
  // They never go to GA4 alongside the replacement event.
  if (!allowedEvents.has(eventName) || typeof window === 'undefined' || !analyticsAllowed()) return false
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('nzamara:metric', { detail: { eventName } }))
  return true
}
```

### `src/services/campaignAttribution.js`

SHA-256: `1883575d443f19aec55efdaaf2ff7eb471164947a169a2aacc24798290330c13` · 44 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import registry from '../../config/marketing/campaigns.json'
import { resolveCampaign } from './campaignRegistry.js'
import { cleanReferrer } from './analyticsPageContext.js'

export const ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY = 'nzamara:marketing-session'
export const SESSION_IDLE_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000
const uuidPattern = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i
const statuses = ['approved_campaign', 'invalid_campaign', 'direct', 'referral', 'unknown']

export function createCampaignAttribution({ allowed, storage = null, now = Date.now, uuid = () => crypto.randomUUID(), campaigns = registry.campaigns }) {
  let session = null
  function valid(value) {
    return value && Object.keys(value).sort().join() === 'campaign,last_activity,referrer,session_id,status,version'
      && value.version === 1 && typeof value.session_id === 'string' && uuidPattern.test(value.session_id) && statuses.includes(value.status)
      && Number.isFinite(value.last_activity) && value.last_activity <= now() && now() - value.last_activity < SESSION_IDLE_MS
      && typeof value.referrer === 'string' && cleanReferrer(value.referrer) === value.referrer
      && (value.status === 'approved_campaign') === (value.campaign !== null)
      && (value.campaign === null || JSON.stringify(resolveCampaign(new URLSearchParams(value.campaign), campaigns)) === JSON.stringify(value.campaign))
  }
  function forget() {
    session = null
    try { storage?.removeItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY) } catch { /* Storage can be blocked. */ }
  }
  return {
    touch({ search = '', referrer = '' } = {}) {
      if (!allowed()) { forget(); return null }
      if (!session) {
        try { const value = JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY)); if (valid(value)) session = value } catch { /* No valid previous session. */ }
      }
      if (!valid(session)) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(search)
        const campaign = resolveCampaign(params, campaigns)
        const clean = cleanReferrer(referrer)
        session = { version: 1, session_id: uuid(), last_activity: now(), campaign,
          status: campaign ? 'approved_campaign' : [...params.keys()].some((key) => key.startsWith('utm_')) ? 'invalid_campaign'
            : !referrer ? 'direct' : clean ? 'referral' : 'unknown', referrer: clean }
      }
      session = { ...session, last_activity: now() }
      try { storage?.setItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(session)) } catch { /* Memory-only session remains usable. */ }
      return { ...session, campaign: session.campaign ? { ...session.campaign } : null }
    },
    revoke: forget,
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY, SESSION_IDLE_MS, createCampaignAttribution } from './campaignAttribution.js'

const campaign = { utm_id: 'test-1', utm_source: 'test', utm_medium: 'fixture', utm_campaign: 'test', utm_content: 'hero' }
const id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
function data() {
  const map = new Map()
  return { getItem: (key) => map.get(key) || null, setItem: vi.fn((key, value) => map.set(key, value)), removeItem: vi.fn((key) => map.delete(key)) }
}
describe('campaign attribution', () => {
  it('creates no identifier or stored session before consent', () => {
    const storage = data(), uuid = vi.fn(() => id)
    const value = createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: () => false, storage, uuid })
    expect(value.touch({ search: '?utm_source=private' })).toBeNull()
    expect(uuid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(storage.setItem).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
  it('preserves an approved entry campaign through internal and direct navigation', () => {
    const storage = data()
    const value = createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: () => true, storage, uuid: () => id, campaigns: [campaign] })
    expect(value.touch({ search: new URLSearchParams(campaign).toString() }).campaign).toEqual(campaign)
    expect(value.touch().campaign).toEqual(campaign)
    expect(createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: () => true, storage, campaigns: [campaign] }).touch().session_id).toBe(id)
  })
  it('expires inactivity and starts a new session without restoring an old campaign', () => {
    let time = 0
    const uuid = vi.fn(() => id)
    const value = createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: () => true, now: () => time, uuid, campaigns: [campaign] })
    value.touch({ search: new URLSearchParams(campaign).toString() })
    time = SESSION_IDLE_MS
    expect(value.touch()).toMatchObject({ status: 'direct', campaign: null })
    expect(uuid).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })
  it('discards unsafe/corrupt persisted payloads and never stores raw search/referrer', () => {
    const storage = data()
    storage.setItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY, '{"email":"person@example.invalid"}')
    const value = createCampaignAttribution({ allowed: () => true, storage, uuid: () => id })
    expect(value.touch({ search: '?utm_source=person@example.invalid', referrer: 'https://unknown.invalid/private' })).toMatchObject({ status: 'invalid_campaign', referrer: '', campaign: null })
    expect(storage.getItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY)).not.toContain('person')
    value.revoke()
    expect(storage.getItem(ATTRIBUTION_STORAGE_KEY)).toBeNull()
  })
})
```

### `src/services/campaignRegistry.js`

SHA-256: `ab0f2f97d9a768dee2461d2de3074e2641d5ec96febea8feac6014f14525f05b` · 12 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import registry from '../../config/marketing/campaigns.json'

// A whole approved tuple is required; never combine unrelated campaign values.
export function resolveCampaign(params, campaigns = registry.campaigns) {
  if (!(params instanceof URLSearchParams)) return null
  const keys = ['utm_id', 'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content']
  if (params.has('utm_term') || keys.some((key) => params.getAll(key).length !== 1)) return null
  const campaign = campaigns.find((entry) => keys.every((key) =>
    typeof entry[key] === 'string' && entry[key].length <= 80 && /^[a-z0-9_-]+$/.test(entry[key]) && params.get(key) === entry[key],
  ))
  return campaign ? Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, campaign[key]])) : null
}
```

```javascript
import { resolveCampaign } from './campaignRegistry.js'

const campaign = { utm_id: 'fixture-1', utm_source: 'fixture', utm_medium: 'test', utm_campaign: 'test-only', utm_content: 'hero' }

    input.set('email', 'person@example.invalid')
    expect(resolveCampaign(input, [campaign])).toEqual(campaign)

      (value) => value.append('utm_id', 'other'), (value) => value.delete('utm_content'),

      (value) => value.set('utm_campaign', 'person@example.invalid'),
    ]) {
      const input = params(); mutate(input)
      expect(resolveCampaign(input, [campaign])).toBeNull()
    }
```

### `src/services/chatbotService.js`

SHA-256: `518700072c5f5a6f0e712d762055276c0df23c77898793f5583b09bfb91a4381` · 34 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
async function chatRequest(payload, { signal } = {}) {
  const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
    method: payload ? 'POST' : 'GET',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    ...(payload ? { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) } : {}),
    signal,
  })
  let result
  try { result = await response.json() } catch { throw new Error('invalid_response') }
  if (!result || typeof result.status !== 'string') throw new Error('invalid_response')
  if (!response.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error(result.status), { result })
  const state = result.state
  if (!state || typeof state.conversation_id !== 'string' || typeof state.can_send !== 'boolean'
      || typeof state.closed !== 'boolean' || !Number.isInteger(state.completed_rounds)
      || !result.policy || result.policy.reveal_delay_ms !== 800) throw new Error('invalid_response')
  if (result.status === 'completed' && (typeof result.result?.reply !== 'string'
      || typeof result.result?.topic !== 'string' || typeof result.result?.action !== 'string')) throw new Error('invalid_response')
  return result
}

export function sendChatMessage(payload, options) { return chatRequest({ ...payload, operation: 'send' }, options) }
export const chatbotApi = {
  session: async ({ fresh = false, signal } = {}) => {
    const session = await chatRequest(null, { signal })
    if (!fresh) return session
    const refreshed = await chatRequest({ operation: 'refresh', conversation_id: session.state.conversation_id }, { signal })
    if (refreshed.status === 'conversation_changed') {
      return chatRequest({ operation: 'refresh', conversation_id: refreshed.state.conversation_id }, { signal })
    }
    return refreshed
  },
  send: sendChatMessage,
  command: (operation, conversationId, options) => chatRequest({ operation, conversation_id: conversationId }, options),
}
```

### `src/services/consentService.js`

SHA-256: `af49548ce4ecea21ba047ace0ba43a06e21e673ce525db2332501fa195ca7554` · 75 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
export const CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY = 'nzamara:analytics-consent'
export const CONSENT_VERSION = '2026-10-29-analytics-v1'
export const CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS = 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
export const UNKNOWN_CONSENT = Object.freeze({ status: 'unknown', analytics: false, experience: false, version: CONSENT_VERSION, updatedAt: null })

function browserStorage() {
  try { return typeof window === 'undefined' ? null : window.localStorage } catch { return null }
}

export function parseConsent(raw, now = Date.now()) {
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(raw)
    if (!value || Object.keys(value).sort().join() !== 'analytics,experience,status,updatedAt,version') return UNKNOWN_CONSENT
    const time = Date.parse(value.updatedAt)
    if (value.version !== CONSENT_VERSION || typeof value.analytics !== 'boolean' || typeof value.experience !== 'boolean'
      || !Number.isFinite(time) || time > now || now - time >= CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS
      || value.status !== (value.analytics || value.experience ? 'accepted' : 'rejected')) return UNKNOWN_CONSENT
    return Object.freeze(value)
  } catch { return UNKNOWN_CONSENT }
}

export function clearAnalyticsCookies(documentRef = typeof document === 'undefined' ? null : document,
  hostname = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : window.location.hostname) {
  if (!documentRef) return
  const names = documentRef.cookie.split(';').map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
    .filter((name) => /^_ga(?:_|$)|^_cl(?:ck|sk)$/.test(name))
  const labels = hostname.split('.')
  const domains = ['', ...labels.map((_, index) => labels.slice(index).join('.')).filter((domain) => domain.includes('.'))]
  for (const name of names) for (const domain of domains) {
    documentRef.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax${domain ? `; Domain=${domain}` : ''}`
  }
}

// A functional preference only: no analytics IDs, provider calls or network.
export function createConsentStore({ storage = browserStorage(), now = Date.now, onRevoke = () => {} } = {}) {
  const listeners = new Set()
  function read() {
    try { return parseConsent(storage?.getItem(CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY), now()) } catch { return UNKNOWN_CONSENT }
  }
  let snapshot = read()
  function publish(next) {
    if (JSON.stringify(next) === JSON.stringify(snapshot)) return
    const previous = snapshot
    snapshot = next
    if ((previous.analytics && !next.analytics) || (previous.experience && !next.experience)) {
      try { onRevoke() } catch { /* Storage restrictions must not prevent revocation. */ }
    }
    listeners.forEach((listener) => listener())
  }
  function reload() { publish(read()) }
  return {
    getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
    getServerSnapshot: () => UNKNOWN_CONSENT,
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener)
      const sync = (event) => { if (event.key === CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null) reload() }
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.addEventListener('storage', sync); window.addEventListener('focus', reload) }
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener)
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.removeEventListener('storage', sync); window.removeEventListener('focus', reload) }
      }
    },
    save({ analytics, experience }) {
      if (typeof analytics !== 'boolean' || typeof experience !== 'boolean') return false
      const next = Object.freeze({ status: analytics || experience ? 'accepted' : 'rejected', analytics, experience,
        version: CONSENT_VERSION, updatedAt: new Date(now()).toISOString() })
      try { storage?.setItem(CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)) } catch { /* Keep the user's choice in memory. */ }
      publish(next)
      return true
    },
    reload,
  }
}

export const consentStore = createConsentStore({ onRevoke: clearAnalyticsCookies })
```

```javascript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY, CONSENT_VERSION, CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS, UNKNOWN_CONSENT, createConsentStore, parseConsent, clearAnalyticsCookies } from './consentService.js'

const date = Date.parse('2026-10-29T12:00:00Z')
function storage() {
  const values = new Map()
  return { getItem: (key) => values.get(key) || null, setItem: (key, value) => values.set(key, value) }
}

describe('consent service', () => {
  it('defaults to unknown, persists independent preferences and can reject', () => {
    const data = storage()
    const revoke = vi.fn()
    const store = createConsentStore({ storage: data, now: () => date, onRevoke: revoke })
    expect(store.getSnapshot()).toBe(UNKNOWN_CONSENT)
    store.save({ analytics: true, experience: false })
    expect(createConsentStore({ storage: data, now: () => date }).getSnapshot()).toMatchObject({ analytics: true, experience: false, status: 'accepted' })
    store.save({ analytics: false, experience: false })
    expect(store.getSnapshot().status).toBe('rejected')
    expect(revoke).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(JSON.parse(data.getItem(CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY)).version).toBe(CONSENT_VERSION)
  })
  it('keeps the preference in memory when storage is blocked', () => {
    const data = { getItem: () => { throw Error('blocked') }, setItem: () => { throw Error('blocked') } }
    const store = createConsentStore({ storage: data, now: () => date })
    expect(store.save({ analytics: false, experience: true })).toBe(true)
    expect(store.getSnapshot()).toMatchObject({ experience: true, analytics: false })
    expect(store.save({ analytics: 'true', experience: false })).toBe(false)
  })
  it('treats corrupt, outdated, future and sensitive stored preferences as unknown', () => {
    const store = createConsentStore({ storage: null, now: () => date })
    store.save({ analytics: true, experience: false })
    const valid = store.getSnapshot()
    for (const raw of ['not-json', 'null', JSON.stringify({ ...valid, email: 'a@b.invalid' }),
      JSON.stringify({ ...valid, version: 'old' }), JSON.stringify({ ...valid, status: 'rejected' }),
      JSON.stringify({ ...valid, updatedAt: new Date(date + 1).toISOString() })]) {
      expect(parseConsent(raw, date)).toBe(UNKNOWN_CONSENT)
    }
    expect(parseConsent(JSON.stringify(valid), date + CONSENT_MAX_AGE_MS)).toBe(UNKNOWN_CONSENT)
  })
  it('synchronizes external preference changes and cleans up subscriptions', () => {
    const data = storage()
    const store = createConsentStore({ storage: data, now: () => date })
    const listener = vi.fn()
    const unsubscribe = store.subscribe(listener)
    createConsentStore({ storage: data, now: () => date }).save({ analytics: false, experience: false })
    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY }))
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(store.getSnapshot().status).toBe('rejected')
    unsubscribe()
    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY }))
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })
  it('removes optional cookies without removing the functional chat cookie', () => {
    const writes = []
    const documentRef = { get cookie() { return '_ga=one; _ga_ID=two; _clck=three; chat_identity=four' }, set cookie(value) { writes.push(value) } }
    clearAnalyticsCookies(documentRef, 'www.nicolaszamara.com')
    expect(writes.some((value) => value.startsWith('_ga=; Max-Age=0'))).toBe(true)
    expect(writes.some((value) => value.includes('Domain=nicolaszamara.com'))).toBe(true)
    expect(writes.every((value) => !value.includes('chat_identity'))).toBe(true)
  })
```

### `src/services/formMetrics.js`

SHA-256: `d8f72eb1f73f197bedff1ea64f05e25b8fd41630e9807c925a74b0177fa8fa35` · 45 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { trackEvent } from './analyticsService.js'

const fields = { name: 'name', email: 'email', phone: 'phone', contactPreference: 'contact_preference', city: 'city', country: 'country', privacyConsent: 'privacy_consent' }

export function formPlacement(kind, path) {
  if (kind === 'consultation') return 'consultation_form'
  if (kind === 'online') return 'courses_online_form'
  return path === '/naturaleza' ? 'nature_page_form' : 'home_nature_form'
}

export function createFormMetrics({ kind, placement, service = () => kind, source = 'form', emit = trackEvent }) {
  let started = false, submitted = false, saved = false, lastError = null
  const invalid = new Set()
  const common = () => ({ form_kind: kind, placement })
  const start = () => {
    if (!started && emit('form_start', common())) started = true
  }
  return {
    start,
    invalid(target) {
      const field_id = fields[target.name] || 'form'
      const error_code = target.name === 'privacyConsent' ? 'consent_required' : target.validity?.valueMissing ? 'required'
        : target.validity?.tooLong ? 'too_long' : 'format'
      const key = `${field_id}:${error_code}`
      if (!invalid.has(key) && emit('form_validation_error', { ...common(), field_id, error_code })) invalid.add(key)
    },
    attempt() {
      start()
      if (!submitted) { emit('form_submit_attempt', common()); submitted = true }
      else if (lastError) emit('form_retry', { ...common(), error_code: lastError })
      lastError = null
      invalid.clear()
    },
    error(code) {
      lastError = ['rate_limited', 'timeout', 'network'].includes(code) ? code : 'unavailable'
      emit('form_submit_error', { ...common(), error_code: lastError })
    },
    success() {
      if (saved) return
      saved = true
      emit('generate_lead', { ...common(), service: service() || 'general', lead_source: source })
    },
    reset() { started = false; submitted = false; saved = false; lastError = null; invalid.clear() },
  }
}
```

### `src/services/ga4Adapter.js`

SHA-256: `ce49991a956dceaef79a8b11ec6a3a862ddbdd822965edf496aab5c1b3bad55f` · 67 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { ANALYTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION, SITE_VERSION, validateAnalyticsEvent } from '../config/analytics.js'
import { loadExternalScript } from './scriptLoader.js'
import { resolveCampaign } from './campaignRegistry.js'

const denied = { analytics_storage: 'denied', ad_storage: 'denied', ad_user_data: 'denied', ad_personalization: 'denied' }

export function createGa4Adapter({ measurementId, allowed, windowRef, documentRef, environment = 'development', loadScript = loadExternalScript }) {
  let loading = null
  let initialized = false
  let generation = 0
  let campaignFields = {}
  const validId = /^G-[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(measurementId || '')
  function pageFields(page) {
    return { page_title: page.page_title, page_location: page.page_location, page_referrer: page.page_referrer }
  }
  function permitted() { return validId && Boolean(windowRef) && allowed() }
  function command(...args) { windowRef.gtag(...args) }
  function configure(page) {
    windowRef[`ga-disable-${measurementId}`] = false
    command('consent', 'update', { ...denied, analytics_storage: 'granted' })
    command('js', new Date())
    command('config', measurementId, { send_page_view: false, allow_google_signals: false,
      allow_ad_personalization_signals: false, ...pageFields(page), ...campaignFields })
    initialized = true
  }
  async function start(page) {
    if (!permitted() || !validateAnalyticsEvent('page_view', pageFields(page))) return false
    if (initialized) return true
    const current = generation
    if (!loading) {
      windowRef[`ga-disable-${measurementId}`] = true
      windowRef.dataLayer ||= []
      windowRef.gtag ||= function () { windowRef.dataLayer.push(arguments) }
      command('consent', 'default', denied)
      loading = loadScript(documentRef, { id: `nzamara-ga4-${measurementId}`, src: `https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${measurementId}` })
    }
    let loaded = false
    try { loaded = await loading } catch { return false }
    if (!loaded || current !== generation || !permitted()) return false
    if (!initialized) configure(page)
    return true
  }
  return {
    async send(name, params, page, stillCurrent = () => true) {
      if (!stillCurrent() || !validateAnalyticsEvent(name, params) || !await start(page) || !permitted() || !stillCurrent()) return false
      // Subsequent automatic engagement events also inherit sanitized page fields.
      command('set', pageFields(page))
      command('event', name, { ...params, ...pageFields(page), ...campaignFields, schema_version: ANALYTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION, site_version: SITE_VERSION,
        environment: ['production', 'qa'].includes(environment) ? environment : 'development', send_to: measurementId })
      return true
    },
    updatePage(page) {
      if (initialized && permitted() && validateAnalyticsEvent('page_view', pageFields(page))) command('set', pageFields(page))
    },
    setCampaign(campaign) {
      const value = campaign && resolveCampaign(new URLSearchParams(campaign))
      campaignFields = value ? { campaign_id: value.utm_id, campaign_source: value.utm_source, campaign_medium: value.utm_medium,
        campaign_name: value.utm_campaign, campaign_content: value.utm_content } : {}
    },
    stop() {
      generation += 1
      initialized = false
      campaignFields = {}
      if (windowRef && validId) windowRef[`ga-disable-${measurementId}`] = true
    },
  }
}
```

### `src/services/hotmartTrackingService.js`

SHA-256: `1683bfed8d4f95c2a012e0a437aefb09e10bbafd5d34bb37a50714b06285d75f` · 30 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { trackEvent } from './analyticsService.js'
import { currentSourcePath } from './sourceContext.js'
import { analyticsAllowed } from './analyticsPermission.js'
import { consentStore } from './consentService.js'

let delivery = Promise.resolve()
const controllers = new Set()
consentStore.subscribe(() => {
  if (!analyticsAllowed()) controllers.forEach((controller) => controller.abort())
})

// Queue initial deliveries so the first response can establish the shared cookie.
// No preventDefault: metrics must never block the real Hotmart link.
export function trackHotmartClick(source, measurement) {
  if (!analyticsAllowed()) return Promise.resolve(false)
  trackEvent('hotmart_click', measurement ? { ...measurement, source } : undefined)
  const payload = { event_id: crypto.randomUUID(), source, source_path: currentSourcePath() }
  const send = () => {
    if (!analyticsAllowed()) return Promise.resolve(false)
    const controller = new AbortController()
    controllers.add(controller)
    const deadline = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000)
    return fetch('/api/hotmart_click', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', keepalive: true, signal: controller.signal,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }).then((response) => response.ok).finally(() => { clearTimeout(deadline); controllers.delete(controller) })
  }
  delivery = delivery.then(() => send().catch(() => send())).catch(() => false)
  return delivery
}
```

```javascript
import { currentSourcePath } from './sourceContext.js'

export async function submitInterest(payload, { signal } = {}) {
  const response = await fetch('/api/interests', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, source_path: currentSourcePath() }),
    signal,
  })
  const result = await response.json()
  if (response.status === 201 && result.status === 'saved') return { status: 'saved' }
  return { status: response.status === 429 ? 'rate_limited' : 'unavailable' }
}
```

### `src/services/marketingTracker.js`

SHA-256: `bda5bb829dd0f255805a3076c2f7fe03ba7cc2236f29bf62fbad4798f1c99a6d` · 37 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { ANALYTICS_QUEUE_LIMIT, ANALYTICS_QUEUE_TTL_MS, validateAnalyticsEvent } from '../config/analytics.js'

// Transport is injected: no provider, timer or browser required to test the queue.
export function createMarketingTracker({ allowed, adapter, page, dispatch = () => {}, now = Date.now }) {
  let pending = []
  let sending = false
  let generation = 0
  async function drain() {
    if (sending) return
    sending = true
    const current = generation
    try {
      while (pending.length && current === generation) {
        if (!allowed()) { pending = []; break }
        const item = pending.shift()
        if (now() - item.time >= ANALYTICS_QUEUE_TTL_MS) continue
        try { await adapter.send(item.name, item.params, item.page,
          () => current === generation && allowed() && now() - item.time < ANALYTICS_QUEUE_TTL_MS) } catch { /* Never disrupt the real action. */ }
      }
    } finally {
      sending = false
      if (pending.length && allowed()) void drain()
    }
  }
  return {
    track(name, params) {
      if (!allowed() || !validateAnalyticsEvent(name, params)) return false
      const item = { name, params: { ...params }, page: { ...page() }, time: now() }
      if (pending.length >= ANALYTICS_QUEUE_LIMIT) pending.shift()
      pending.push(item)
      try { dispatch(name, item.params) } catch { /* Local listeners must not break controls. */ }
      void drain()
      return true
    },
    revoke() { generation += 1; pending = []; adapter.stop() },
  }
}
```

<a id="archivo-src-services-scriptloader-js"></a>

### `src/services/scriptLoader.js`

SHA-256: `ab2b5a3fa98c4bae96af7d7caf7ba122bd40e3773690db03ff945b6127d05643` · 30 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
const documents = new WeakMap()

// Exactly one attempt per document/ID, including failure; a blocked provider
// must not trigger an unbounded retry loop on every interaction.
export function loadExternalScript(documentRef, { id, src, timeoutMs = 30000 }) {
  if (!documentRef) return Promise.resolve(false)
  if (!documents.has(documentRef)) documents.set(documentRef, new Map())
  const attempts = documents.get(documentRef)
  if (attempts.has(id)) return attempts.get(id)
  const attempt = new Promise((resolve) => {
    const script = documentRef.createElement('script')
    script.id = id
    script.src = src
    script.async = true
    script.referrerPolicy = 'strict-origin'
    const finish = (ok) => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      script.onload = null
      script.onerror = null
      if (!ok) script.remove()
      resolve(ok)
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), timeoutMs)
    script.onload = () => finish(true)
    script.onerror = () => finish(false)
    documentRef.head.appendChild(script)
  })
  attempts.set(id, attempt)
  return attempt
}
```

```javascript
    const result = loadExternalScript(doc, options)
    doc.querySelector('script').dispatchEvent(new Event('error'))
    expect(await result).toBe(false)
    expect(await loadExternalScript(doc, options)).toBe(false)
    expect(doc.querySelector('script')).toBeNull()
  })
  it('times out with fake timers and handles server rendering', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const doc = document.implementation.createHTMLDocument('fixture')
    const result = loadExternalScript(doc, { id: 'slow', src: 'https://provider.invalid/slow' })
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(30000)
    expect(await result).toBe(false)
    expect(doc.querySelector('script')).toBeNull()
    expect(await loadExternalScript(null, { id: 'server', src: '' })).toBe(false)
  })
})
```

SHA-256: `c15df71dc1f9cb9343f39a0337b6bbacac0edfc71d726a16eb45edb154d6e1e6` · 62 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```javascript
import { pageMetadata, siteSettings } from '../content/siteContent.js'
import { SITE_ORIGIN, SITE_ROUTES, normalizeSitePath } from '../config/siteRoutes.js'

const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[char])

export function seoMetadata(path, { indexingEnabled = false } = {}) {
  const normalized = normalizeSitePath(path)
  const route = SITE_ROUTES.find((entry) => entry.path === normalized)
  const canonical = `${SITE_ORIGIN}${route ? normalized : '/404'}`
  const metadata = route ? pageMetadata[normalized] : { title: 'Página no encontrada | Nicolás Zamara', description: 'Encuentra los servicios y páginas de Nicolás Zamara.' }
  return { ...metadata, canonical, robots: indexingEnabled && route?.indexable ? 'index,follow' : 'noindex,nofollow',
    image: `${SITE_ORIGIN}/photos/sobre-mi-maya-844-960.jpg`,
    structuredData: route ? { '@context': 'https://schema.org', '@graph': [
      { '@type': 'Person', '@id': `${SITE_ORIGIN}/#person`, name: siteSettings.brand, url: `${SITE_ORIGIN}/sobre-mi` },
      { '@type': 'WebSite', '@id': `${SITE_ORIGIN}/#website`, name: siteSettings.brand, url: `${SITE_ORIGIN}/` },
      { '@type': 'WebPage', '@id': `${canonical}#webpage`, url: canonical, name: metadata.title, isPartOf: { '@id': `${SITE_ORIGIN}/#website` } },
    ] } : null }
}

export function renderSeoHead(metadata, indexingEnabled = false) {
  const tags = [
    `<title>${escapeHtml(metadata.title)}</title>`,
    `<meta name="description" content="${escapeHtml(metadata.description)}">`,
    `<meta name="robots" content="${metadata.robots}">`,
    `<meta name="site-indexing-enabled" content="${indexingEnabled ? 'true' : 'false'}">`,
    `<link rel="canonical" href="${escapeHtml(metadata.canonical)}">`,
    ...Object.entries({ 'og:type': 'website', 'og:title': metadata.title, 'og:description': metadata.description,
      'og:url': metadata.canonical, 'og:image': metadata.image }).map(([property, content]) => `<meta property="${property}" content="${escapeHtml(content)}">`),
    ...Object.entries({ 'twitter:card': 'summary_large_image', 'twitter:title': metadata.title,
      'twitter:description': metadata.description, 'twitter:image': metadata.image }).map(([name, content]) => `<meta name="${name}" content="${escapeHtml(content)}">`),
  ]
  if (metadata.structuredData) tags.push(`<script id="site-structured-data" type="application/ld+json">${JSON.stringify(metadata.structuredData).replace(/</g, '\\u003c')}</script>`)
  return tags.join('\n')
}

export function htmlWithSeo(template, path, options = {}) {
  const clean = template.replace(/<title>[\s\S]*?<\/title>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<meta\b[^>]*>/gi, (tag) => /(?:name|property)=["'](?:description|robots|site-indexing-enabled|og:[^"']+|twitter:[^"']+)["']/i.test(tag) ? '' : tag)
    .replace(/<link\b[^>]*rel=["']canonical["'][^>]*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*id=["']site-structured-data["'][^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, '')
  return clean.replace('</head>', `${renderSeoHead(seoMetadata(path, options), options.indexingEnabled)}\n</head>`)
}

export function sitemapXml(indexingEnabled = false) {
  const urls = indexingEnabled ? SITE_ROUTES.filter((route) => route.indexable).map((route) => `<url><loc>${SITE_ORIGIN}${route.path}</loc></url>`).join('') : ''
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">${urls}</urlset>`
}

export function applySeoMetadata(documentRef, path, indexingEnabled = false) {
  const metadata = seoMetadata(path, { indexingEnabled })
  documentRef.title = metadata.title
  const tags = documentRef.createElement('template')
  tags.innerHTML = renderSeoHead(metadata, indexingEnabled)
  for (const node of [...tags.content.children]) {
    if (node.tagName === 'TITLE' || node.getAttribute('name') === 'site-indexing-enabled') continue
    const selector = node.id ? `#${node.id}` : node.tagName === 'LINK' ? 'link[rel="canonical"]'
      : node.hasAttribute('property') ? `meta[property="${node.getAttribute('property')}"]` : `meta[name="${node.getAttribute('name')}"]`
    documentRef.head.querySelector(selector)?.remove()
    documentRef.head.appendChild(node)
  }
  if (!metadata.structuredData) documentRef.head.querySelector('#site-structured-data')?.remove()
}
```

```javascript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { seoMetadata, htmlWithSeo, renderSeoHead, sitemapXml, applySeoMetadata } from './seoService.js'

describe('SEO generation', () => {
  it('requires explicit indexing and excludes privacy, chatbot and unknown routes', () => {
    expect(seoMetadata('/consulta').robots).toBe('noindex,nofollow')
    expect(seoMetadata('/consulta/', { indexingEnabled: true }).robots).toBe('index,follow')
    for (const route of ['/privacidad', '/chatbot', '/admin', '/someone@example.invalid']) {
      expect(seoMetadata(route, { indexingEnabled: true }).robots).toBe('noindex,nofollow')
    }
    expect(seoMetadata('/someone@example.invalid').canonical).toBe('https://www.nicolaszamara.com/404')
  })
  it('generates one coherent head and escapes text/JSON-LD injection', () => {
    const template = '<html><head><title>Old</title><meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow"><meta property="og:title" content="Old"></head><body><div id="root"></div></body></html>'
    const html = htmlWithSeo(template, '/cursos', { indexingEnabled: true })
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html')
    expect(doc.querySelectorAll('title')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(doc.querySelectorAll('meta[name="robots"]')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(doc.querySelector('meta[name="robots"]').content).toBe('index,follow')
    expect(doc.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]').href).toBe('https://www.nicolaszamara.com/cursos')
    expect(doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]').content).toBe(doc.title)
    const unsafe = renderSeoHead({ ...seoMetadata('/'), title: '"><img src=x>', structuredData: { text: '</script><script>alert(1)</script>' } })
    const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(unsafe, 'text/html')
    expect(parsed.querySelector('img')).toBeNull()
    expect(parsed.querySelectorAll('script')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(JSON.parse(parsed.querySelector('script').textContent).text).toContain('</script>')
  })
  it('includes only approved routes in the production sitemap without fabricated dates', () => {
    const sitemap = sitemapXml(true)
    expect(sitemap).toContain('https://www.nicolaszamara.com/consulta')
    expect(sitemap).not.toContain('/chatbot')
    expect(sitemap).not.toContain('/privacidad')
    expect(sitemap).not.toContain('/admin')
    expect(sitemap).not.toContain('lastmod')
    expect(sitemapXml(false)).not.toContain('<url>')
  })
  it('updates social tags and clears stale metadata on a 404 navigation', () => {
    const doc = document.implementation.createHTMLDocument('initial')
    applySeoMetadata(doc, '/consulta', true)
    applySeoMetadata(doc, '/cursos', true)
    expect(doc.querySelectorAll('link[rel="canonical"]')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(doc.querySelector('meta[name="twitter:title"]').content).toBe(doc.title)
    applySeoMetadata(doc, '/unknown', true)
    expect(doc.title).toBe('Página no encontrada | Nicolás Zamara')
    expect(doc.querySelector('meta[name="robots"]').content).toBe('noindex,nofollow')
    expect(doc.querySelector('#site-structured-data')).toBeNull()
  })
})
```

```sql
-- Private marketing ledger. Apply only in the authorized activation step.
create schema if not exists private;
create table private.marketing_import_batches (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  file_digest text not null check (file_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  kind text not null check (kind in ('movements','spend')),
  payload_hash text not null,
  row_count integer not null check (row_count between 1 and 10000),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(file_digest,kind)
);
create table private.marketing_transactions (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  provider text not null check (provider in ('hotmart','consultation_payments')),
  external_transaction_id text not null check (external_transaction_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,119}$'),
  service text not null check (service in ('consultation','course','online','nature')),
  product_id text,
  currency text not null check (currency in ('CLP','USD','EUR')),
  campaign_id text,
  attribution_method text not null check (attribution_method in ('unknown','provider_campaign','documented_manual')),
  attribution_reference text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(provider,external_transaction_id),
  check ((attribution_method='unknown' and campaign_id is null and attribution_reference is null)
    or (attribution_method<>'unknown' and campaign_id is not null and attribution_reference is not null))
);
create table private.marketing_movements (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  transaction_id bigint not null references private.marketing_transactions(id),
  provider text not null,
  external_event_id text not null check (external_event_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,119}$'),
  event_type text not null check (event_type in ('sale','refund','chargeback','fee','tax')),
  amount_minor bigint not null check (amount_minor between 1 and 9000000000000000),
  occurred_at timestamptz not null,
  batch_id bigint not null references private.marketing_import_batches(id),
  normalized_record jsonb not null,
  unique(provider,external_event_id)
);
create unique index marketing_one_sale_per_transaction on private.marketing_movements(transaction_id) where event_type='sale';
create index marketing_movements_transaction_idx on private.marketing_movements(transaction_id);
create index marketing_movements_date_idx on private.marketing_movements(occurred_at);
create table private.marketing_ad_spend (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  platform text not null check (platform in ('google_ads','meta_ads','other')),
  campaign_id text not null check (campaign_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,119}$'),
  spend_date date not null,
  source_timezone text not null,
  currency text not null check (currency in ('CLP','USD','EUR')),
  spend_minor bigint not null check (spend_minor between 0 and 9000000000000000),
  batch_id bigint not null references private.marketing_import_batches(id),
  unique(platform,campaign_id,spend_date,currency)
);
create table private.marketing_spend_revisions (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  spend_id bigint not null references private.marketing_ad_spend(id),
  old_minor bigint not null,
  new_minor bigint not null,
  batch_id bigint not null references private.marketing_import_batches(id),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table private.marketing_webhook_receipts (
  provider text not null,
  event_id text not null,
  payload_hash text not null,
  status text not null check (status in ('received','processed','rejected')),
  received_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(provider,event_id)
);

alter table private.marketing_import_batches enable row level security;
alter table private.marketing_transactions enable row level security;
alter table private.marketing_movements enable row level security;
alter table private.marketing_ad_spend enable row level security;
alter table private.marketing_spend_revisions enable row level security;
alter table private.marketing_webhook_receipts enable row level security;
revoke all on private.marketing_import_batches,private.marketing_transactions,private.marketing_movements,
  private.marketing_ad_spend,private.marketing_spend_revisions,private.marketing_webhook_receipts from public,anon,authenticated;
grant usage on schema private to service_role;
grant select,insert on private.marketing_import_batches,private.marketing_transactions,private.marketing_movements,
  private.marketing_spend_revisions,private.marketing_webhook_receipts to service_role;
grant select,insert,update on private.marketing_ad_spend to service_role;
grant usage,select on sequence private.marketing_import_batches_id_seq,private.marketing_transactions_id_seq,
  private.marketing_movements_id_seq,private.marketing_ad_spend_id_seq,private.marketing_spend_revisions_id_seq to service_role;

create function public.marketing_import_batch(p_batch jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security invoker set search_path='' as $$
declare
  batch private.marketing_import_batches%rowtype;
  tx private.marketing_transactions%rowtype;
  existing private.marketing_movements%rowtype;
  previous_spend private.marketing_ad_spend%rowtype;
  row_data jsonb;
  row_keys text[];
  v_batch_id bigint;
  sale_amount bigint;
  reversed_amount bigint;
  amount bigint;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_batch)<>'object' or p_batch->>'schema_version'<>'1'
    or p_batch->>'kind' not in ('movements','spend') or p_batch->>'file_digest' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_batch->'rows')<>'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_batch->'rows') not between 1 and 10000
    or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(p_batch))<>4 then
    raise exception 'marketing_invalid_batch';
  end if;
  -- Short imports are serialized to make cross-file deduplication deterministic.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(98760101);
  select * into batch from private.marketing_import_batches
    where file_digest=p_batch->>'file_digest' and kind=p_batch->>'kind';
  if found then
    if batch.payload_hash<>md5(p_batch::text) then raise exception 'marketing_batch_conflict'; end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','applied','replayed',true,'rows',batch.row_count);
  end if;
  insert into private.marketing_import_batches(file_digest,kind,payload_hash,row_count)
    values(p_batch->>'file_digest',p_batch->>'kind',md5(p_batch::text),jsonb_array_length(p_batch->'rows'))
    returning id into v_batch_id;

  for row_data in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_batch->'rows')
    order by case when value->>'event_type'='sale' then 0 else 1 end
  loop
    select array_agg(key order by key) into row_keys from jsonb_object_keys(row_data) key;
    if p_batch->>'kind'='movements' then
      if row_keys<>array['amount_minor','attribution_method','attribution_reference','campaign_id','currency','event_type',
          'external_event_id','external_transaction_id','occurred_at','product_id','provider','service']
        or row_data->>'provider' not in ('hotmart','consultation_payments')
        or row_data->>'service' not in ('consultation','course','online','nature')
        or row_data->>'event_type' not in ('sale','refund','chargeback','fee','tax')
        or row_data->>'amount_minor' !~ '^[0-9]+$'
        or row_data->>'external_transaction_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,119}$' then
        raise exception 'marketing_invalid_record';
      end if;
      amount := (row_data->>'amount_minor')::bigint;
      select * into existing from private.marketing_movements
        where provider=row_data->>'provider' and external_event_id=row_data->>'external_event_id';
      if found then
        if existing.normalized_record<>row_data then raise exception 'marketing_event_conflict'; end if;
        continue;
      end if;
      insert into private.marketing_transactions(provider,external_transaction_id,service,product_id,currency,
          campaign_id,attribution_method,attribution_reference)
        values(row_data->>'provider',row_data->>'external_transaction_id',row_data->>'service',row_data->>'product_id',
          row_data->>'currency',row_data->>'campaign_id',row_data->>'attribution_method',row_data->>'attribution_reference')
        on conflict(provider,external_transaction_id) do nothing;
      select * into tx from private.marketing_transactions
        where provider=row_data->>'provider' and external_transaction_id=row_data->>'external_transaction_id';
      if tx.currency is distinct from row_data->>'currency' or tx.service is distinct from row_data->>'service'
        or tx.product_id is distinct from row_data->>'product_id' or tx.campaign_id is distinct from row_data->>'campaign_id'
        or tx.attribution_method is distinct from row_data->>'attribution_method'
        or tx.attribution_reference is distinct from row_data->>'attribution_reference' then
        raise exception 'marketing_transaction_conflict';
      end if;
      select sum(amount_minor) filter(where event_type='sale'),coalesce(sum(amount_minor) filter(where event_type in ('refund','chargeback')),0)
        into sale_amount,reversed_amount from private.marketing_movements where transaction_id=tx.id;
      if row_data->>'event_type'='sale' and sale_amount is not null then
        if sale_amount<>amount then raise exception 'marketing_sale_conflict'; end if;
        continue; -- CSV and webhook approval are the same sale, not two payments.
      end if;
      if row_data->>'event_type' in ('refund','chargeback') and (sale_amount is null or reversed_amount+amount>sale_amount) then
        raise exception 'marketing_invalid_reversal';
      end if;
      insert into private.marketing_movements(transaction_id,provider,external_event_id,event_type,amount_minor,occurred_at,batch_id,normalized_record)
        values(tx.id,row_data->>'provider',row_data->>'external_event_id',row_data->>'event_type',amount,
          (row_data->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz,v_batch_id,row_data);
    else
      if row_keys<>array['campaign_id','currency','platform','source_timezone','spend_date','spend_minor']
        or row_data->>'spend_minor' !~ '^[0-9]+$'
        or not exists(select 1 from pg_timezone_names where name=row_data->>'source_timezone') then
        raise exception 'marketing_invalid_spend';
      end if;
      select * into previous_spend from private.marketing_ad_spend where platform=row_data->>'platform'
        and campaign_id=row_data->>'campaign_id' and spend_date=(row_data->>'spend_date')::date and currency=row_data->>'currency';
      amount := (row_data->>'spend_minor')::bigint;
      if found then
        if previous_spend.source_timezone<>row_data->>'source_timezone' then raise exception 'marketing_timezone_conflict'; end if;
        if previous_spend.spend_minor<>amount then
          insert into private.marketing_spend_revisions(spend_id,old_minor,new_minor,batch_id)
            values(previous_spend.id,previous_spend.spend_minor,amount,v_batch_id);
          update private.marketing_ad_spend set spend_minor=amount,batch_id=v_batch_id where id=previous_spend.id;
        end if;
      else
        insert into private.marketing_ad_spend(platform,campaign_id,spend_date,source_timezone,currency,spend_minor,batch_id)
          values(row_data->>'platform',row_data->>'campaign_id',(row_data->>'spend_date')::date,row_data->>'source_timezone',
            row_data->>'currency',amount,v_batch_id);
      end if;
    end if;
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','applied','replayed',false,'rows',jsonb_array_length(p_batch->'rows'));
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb) to service_role;
```

```sql
-- Administrative tables remain private; the only entry point is a server RPC.
create table private.admin_users (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  username text not null unique check (length(username) between 1 and 80),
  password_hash text not null check (password_hash ~ '^pbkdf2_sha256\$600000\$[0-9a-f]{32}\$[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  version integer not null default 1,
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  window_started_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  password_changed_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table private.admin_sessions (
  token_hash text primary key check (token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  user_id uuid not null references private.admin_users(id) on delete cascade,
  user_version integer not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '8 hours')
);
create index admin_sessions_user_idx on private.admin_sessions(user_id);
create index admin_sessions_expiry_idx on private.admin_sessions(expires_at);
create index interest_admin_pagination_idx on public.interest_registrations(created_at desc, id desc);
alter table private.admin_users enable row level security;
alter table private.admin_sessions enable row level security;
revoke all on private.admin_users, private.admin_sessions from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on private.admin_users, private.admin_sessions to service_role;

create function public.admin_access(p_operation text, p_values jsonb default '{}'::jsonb)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user private.admin_users%rowtype;
  v_id uuid;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_summary jsonb;
  v_total bigint;
  v_start timestamptz;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_interest text;
  v_cursor_at timestamptz;
  v_cursor_id uuid;
begin
  if p_operation = 'login_begin' then
    select * into v_user from private.admin_users
      where username = p_values->>'username' for update;
    if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','invalid_credentials'); end if;
    if v_user.window_started_at <= now() - interval '15 minutes' then
      v_user.attempts := 0;
      v_user.window_started_at := now();
    end if;
    if v_user.attempts >= 5 then return jsonb_build_object('status','rate_limited'); end if;
    update private.admin_users set attempts = v_user.attempts + 1, window_started_at = v_user.window_started_at where id = v_user.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','challenge','user_id',v_user.id,'password_hash',v_user.password_hash);
  end if;

  if p_operation = 'login_finish' then
    select * into v_user from private.admin_users where id = (p_values->>'user_id')::uuid for update;
    if not found or v_user.password_hash <> p_values->>'expected_hash' then
      return jsonb_build_object('status','invalid_credentials');
    end if;
    delete from private.admin_sessions where expires_at <= now();
    insert into private.admin_sessions(token_hash,user_id,user_version)
      values(p_values->>'token_hash', v_user.id, v_user.version);
    update private.admin_users set attempts=0, window_started_at=now() where id=v_user.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','authenticated','username',v_user.username);
  end if;

  select u.* into v_user from private.admin_sessions s join private.admin_users u on u.id=s.user_id
    where s.token_hash=p_values->>'token_hash' and s.expires_at>now() and s.user_version=u.version
    for update of u;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','unauthorized'); end if;
  if p_operation='session' then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','authenticated','username',v_user.username);
  elsif p_operation='logout' then
    delete from private.admin_sessions where token_hash=p_values->>'token_hash';
    return jsonb_build_object('status','signed_out');
  elsif p_operation='password' then
    if v_user.password_hash <> p_values->>'expected_hash' then return jsonb_build_object('status','unauthorized'); end if;
    update private.admin_users set password_hash=p_values->>'new_hash',version=version+1,password_changed_at=now(),attempts=0,window_started_at=now()
      where id=v_user.id;
    delete from private.admin_sessions where user_id=v_user.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','password_changed');
  elsif p_operation='detail' then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'id',id,'interest',interest,'full_name',full_name,'email',email,'phone',phone,
      'country',country,'city',city,'experience',experience,'contact_preference',contact_preference,
      'contact_channel',contact_channel,'source',source,'source_path',source_path,
      'created_at',created_at,'management_status',management_status,'privacy_consent',privacy_consent,
      'privacy_version',privacy_version,'privacy_accepted_at',privacy_accepted_at,
      'contact_consent',contact_consent,'contact_accepted_at',contact_accepted_at,'updates_consent',updates_consent
    ) into v_rows from public.interest_registrations where id=(p_values->>'id')::uuid;
    if v_rows is null then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','ready','record',v_rows);
  elsif p_operation <> 'interests' then
    raise exception 'invalid_admin_operation';
  end if;
  v_start := (p_values->>'start')::timestamptz;
  v_end := (p_values->>'end')::timestamptz;
  v_interest := p_values->>'interest';
  v_cursor_at := (p_values->>'cursor_at')::timestamptz;
  v_cursor_id := (p_values->>'cursor_id')::uuid;
  select count(*) into v_total from public.interest_registrations;
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', count(*),
    'consultation', count(*) filter(where interest='consultation'),
    'course', count(*) filter(where interest='course'),
    'online', count(*) filter(where interest='online'),
    'nature', count(*) filter(where interest='nature'),
    'new', count(*) filter(where management_status='new'),
    'form', count(*) filter(where source='form'),
    'chatbot', count(*) filter(where source='chatbot')
  ) into v_summary from public.interest_registrations
    where (v_start is null or created_at>=v_start) and (v_end is null or created_at<v_end)
      and (v_interest is null or interest=v_interest);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.created_at desc,t.id desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
    from (select id,created_at,full_name,interest,source,contact_preference,management_status
      from public.interest_registrations
      where (v_start is null or created_at>=v_start) and (v_end is null or created_at<v_end)
        and (v_interest is null or interest=v_interest)
        and (v_cursor_at is null or (created_at,id)<(v_cursor_at,v_cursor_id))
      order by created_at desc,id desc limit 21) t;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','ready','all_total',v_total,'summary',v_summary,
    'items', case when jsonb_array_length(v_rows)>20 then v_rows-20 else v_rows end,
    'next_cursor', case when jsonb_array_length(v_rows)>20 then
      jsonb_build_object('created_at',v_rows->19->>'created_at','id',v_rows->19->>'id') else null end);
end $$;
```

```sql
    return jsonb_build_object('status','challenge','user_id',v_user.id,'password_hash',v_user.password_hash);
  end if;

  if p_operation = 'login_finish' then
    select * into v_user from private.admin_users where id = (p_values->>'user_id')::uuid for update;
    if not found or v_user.password_hash <> p_values->>'expected_hash' then
      return jsonb_build_object('status','invalid_credentials');
    end if;
    delete from private.admin_sessions where expires_at <= now();
    insert into private.admin_sessions(token_hash,user_id,user_version)
      values(p_values->>'token_hash', v_user.id, v_user.version);
    update private.admin_users set attempts=0, window_started_at=now() where id=v_user.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','authenticated','username',v_user.username);
  end if;

  select u.* into v_user from private.admin_sessions s join private.admin_users u on u.id=s.user_id
    where s.token_hash=p_values->>'token_hash' and s.expires_at>now() and s.user_version=u.version
    for update of u;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','unauthorized'); end if;
  if p_operation='session' then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','authenticated','username',v_user.username);

    update private.admin_users set password_hash=p_values->>'new_hash',version=version+1,password_changed_at=now(),attempts=0,window_started_at=now()
      where id=v_user.id;
```

### `supabase/migrations/20261101201452_marketing_report_snapshot.sql`

SHA-256: `69a5649e5cd4eef7206e381629889d5cf9ca3b34c6810549b75e6e76d4f79793` · 67 líneas · sin seguimiento previo.

```sql
-- Read-only reporting snapshot: aggregate each source independently.
create function public.marketing_report_snapshot(p_start date, p_end date) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
declare
  v_start timestamptz;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_cash jsonb;
  v_spend jsonb;
  v_interests jsonb;
  v_latest_ledger timestamptz;
  v_latest_spend timestamptz;
  v_snapshot jsonb;
begin
  if p_start is null or p_end is null or p_end<p_start or p_end-p_start>=366 then
    raise exception 'invalid_report_period';
  end if;
  v_start := p_start::timestamp at time zone 'America/Santiago';
  v_end := (p_end+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Santiago';
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by d.date,d.provider,d.service,d.currency,d.campaign_id,d.attribution_method),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_cash from (
      select (m.occurred_at at time zone 'America/Santiago')::date as date,
        t.provider,t.service,t.currency,t.campaign_id,t.attribution_method,
        count(*) filter(where m.event_type='sale') as sales_count,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount_minor) filter(where m.event_type='sale'),0) as sales_minor,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount_minor) filter(where m.event_type='refund'),0) as refunds_minor,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount_minor) filter(where m.event_type='chargeback'),0) as chargebacks_minor,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount_minor) filter(where m.event_type='fee'),0) as fees_minor,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount_minor) filter(where m.event_type='tax'),0) as taxes_minor
      from private.marketing_movements m join private.marketing_transactions t on t.id=m.transaction_id
      where m.occurred_at>=v_start and m.occurred_at<v_end
      group by 1,t.provider,t.service,t.currency,t.campaign_id,t.attribution_method
    ) d;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by d.date,d.platform,d.campaign_id,d.currency),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_spend from (
      select spend_date as date,platform,campaign_id,currency,source_timezone,spend_minor
      from private.marketing_ad_spend where spend_date>=p_start and spend_date<=p_end
    ) d;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by d.date,d.service,d.source),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_interests from (
      select (created_at at time zone 'America/Santiago')::date as date,interest as service,source,count(*) as count
      from public.interest_registrations where created_at>=v_start and created_at<v_end
      group by 1,interest,source
    ) d;
  select max(created_at) filter(where kind='movements'),max(created_at) filter(where kind='spend')
    into v_latest_ledger,v_latest_spend from private.marketing_import_batches;
  v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version',1,
    'period',jsonb_build_object('start',p_start,'end',p_end,'timezone','America/Santiago'),
    'as_of',now(),
    -- Imported records do not prove complete source coverage or fee semantics.
    'sources',jsonb_build_object(
      'ledger',jsonb_build_object('state',case when v_latest_ledger is null then 'missing' else 'partial' end,'updated_at',v_latest_ledger),
      'spend',jsonb_build_object('state',case when v_latest_spend is null then 'missing' else 'partial' end,'updated_at',v_latest_spend),
      'interests',jsonb_build_object('state','complete','updated_at',now()),
      'analytics',jsonb_build_object('state','missing','updated_at',null),
      'search',jsonb_build_object('state','missing','updated_at',null)),
    'cost_components_complete',false,'cash',v_cash,'spend',v_spend,'interests',v_interests,'analytics','[]'::jsonb,'search','[]'::jsonb
  );
  -- A large request fails visibly; never return a silently truncated dataset.
  if octet_length(v_snapshot::text)>1900000
    or jsonb_array_length(v_cash)>10000 or jsonb_array_length(v_spend)>10000 or jsonb_array_length(v_interests)>10000 then
    raise exception 'report_too_large_reduce_period';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','ready','snapshot',v_snapshot);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.marketing_report_snapshot(date,date) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.marketing_report_snapshot(date,date) to service_role;
```

### `tests/admin_reads_unit.sql`

SHA-256: `1cd0940d0229435911f2e8c3a7e616882e989c138de1c5fa3168e2241ffaf89a` · 43 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Synthetic fixture and all marker changes are rolled back, including email queue.
begin;
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare
  u uuid;
  i uuid;
  h text := 'pbkdf2_sha256$600000$' || repeat('a',32) || '$' || repeat('b',64);
  result jsonb;
  first_read text;
begin
  insert into private.admin_users(username,password_hash) values('__reads_unit__',h) returning id into u;
  insert into private.admin_sessions(token_hash,user_id,user_version) values(repeat('e',64),u,1);
  insert into public.interest_registrations(interest,full_name,email,phone,contact_preference,source_path,city,privacy_consent,privacy_version,created_at)
    values('nature','Read state unit fixture','read-unit@example.invalid','+56912345678','whatsapp','/naturaleza','Santiago',true,'2026-10-23-contact-v3','2097-01-01T12:00:00Z') returning id into i;
  result := public.admin_access('mark_read',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('f',64),'id',i));
  assert result->>'status'='unauthorized';
  assert not exists(select 1 from private.admin_interest_reads where interest_id=i);
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'reading','unread','start','2097-01-01T00:00:00Z','end','2097-01-02T00:00:00Z'));
  assert (result->'summary'->>'new')::integer=1;
  result := public.admin_access('mark_read',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'id',i));
  assert result->>'status'='ready';
  first_read := result->>'read_at';
  assert first_read is not null;
  assert exists(select 1 from private.admin_interest_reads where interest_id=i and read_by=u);
  assert (select management_status='new' from public.interest_registrations where id=i);
  result := public.admin_access('mark_read',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'id',i));
  assert result->>'read_at'=first_read, 'retries preserve the first read date';
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'reading','unread','start','2097-01-01T00:00:00Z','end','2097-01-02T00:00:00Z'));
  assert (result->'summary'->>'new')::integer=0;
  assert jsonb_array_length(result->'items')=0;
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'reading','read','start','2097-01-01T00:00:00Z','end','2097-01-02T00:00:00Z'));
  assert (result->'summary'->>'read')::integer=1;
  assert result->'items'->0->>'id'=i::text;
  result := public.admin_access('detail',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'id',i));
  assert result->'record'->>'read_at'=first_read;
  result := public.admin_access('mark_read',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('e',64),'id',gen_random_uuid()));
  assert result->>'status'='not_found';
  assert not has_table_privilege('anon','private.admin_interest_reads','insert');
  assert not has_table_privilege('authenticated','private.admin_interest_reads','select');
end $$;
select 'admin_reads_unit_passed' as result;
rollback;
```

```sql
-- Unit checks with a synthetic administrator; no real contacts are created.
begin;
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare
  h text := 'pbkdf2_sha256$600000$' || repeat('a',32) || '$' || repeat('b',64);
  u uuid;
  result jsonb;
  total bigint;
begin
  insert into private.admin_users(username,password_hash) values('__admin_unit__',h) returning id into u;
  result := public.admin_access('login_begin',jsonb_build_object('username','__admin_unit__'));
  if result->>'status'<>'challenge' then raise exception 'missing_challenge'; end if;
  result := public.admin_access('login_finish',jsonb_build_object('user_id',u,'expected_hash','wrong','token_hash',repeat('a',64)));
  if result->>'status'<>'invalid_credentials' then raise exception 'race_hash_not_checked'; end if;
  result := public.admin_access('login_finish',jsonb_build_object('user_id',u,'expected_hash',h,'token_hash',repeat('a',64)));
  if result->>'status'<>'authenticated' then raise exception 'login_failed'; end if;
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('f',64)));
  if result->>'status'<>'unauthorized' then raise exception 'unauthorized_read'; end if;
  select count(*) into total from public.interest_registrations;
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('a',64)));
  if (result->>'all_total')::bigint<>total or (result->'summary'->>'total')::bigint<>total then raise exception 'incomplete_summary'; end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(result->'items')>20 then raise exception 'unbounded_page'; end if;
  if result::text like '%lead_fingerprint%' then raise exception 'private_field_exposed'; end if;
  result := public.admin_access('interests',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('a',64),'start','2099-01-01T00:00:00Z'));
  if jsonb_array_length(result->'items')<>0 then raise exception 'date_filter_failed'; end if;
  update private.admin_sessions set expires_at=now()-interval '1 minute' where token_hash=repeat('a',64);
  result := public.admin_access('session',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('a',64)));
  if result->>'status'<>'unauthorized' then raise exception 'expired_session_read'; end if;
  update private.admin_sessions set expires_at=now()+interval '1 hour' where token_hash=repeat('a',64);
  result := public.admin_access('password',jsonb_build_object('token_hash',repeat('a',64),'expected_hash',h,'new_hash',replace(h,repeat('b',64),repeat('c',64))));
  if result->>'status'<>'password_changed' then raise exception 'password_change_failed'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from private.admin_sessions where user_id=u) then raise exception 'sessions_not_revoked'; end if;
  for i in 1..5 loop perform public.admin_access('login_begin',jsonb_build_object('username','__admin_unit__')); end loop;
  result := public.admin_access('login_begin',jsonb_build_object('username','__admin_unit__'));
  if result->>'status'<>'rate_limited' then raise exception 'rate_limit_failed'; end if;
  if has_function_privilege('anon','public.admin_access(text,jsonb)','execute') or has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.admin_access(text,jsonb)','execute') then raise exception 'public_rpc_access'; end if;
  if has_table_privilege('anon','private.admin_users','select') or has_table_privilege('authenticated','private.admin_sessions','select') then raise exception 'public_credentials_access'; end if;
end $$;
select 'admin_unit_passed' as result;
rollback;
```

<a id="archivo-tests-hotmart-tracking-unit-sql"></a>

### `tests/hotmart_tracking_unit.sql`

SHA-256: `ad8fe76d5432062d1d7c2defa752906ac1214aa81de034654dc55204cc6f1979` · 25 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Execute inside BEGIN / ROLLBACK; no retained clicks or contacts.
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare v uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); event uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); item record; result jsonb;
begin
  result:=public.record_hotmart_click(event,v,'chatbot','/chatbot');
  assert result->>'status'='recorded', 'first click recorded';
  result:=public.record_hotmart_click(event,v,'chatbot','/chatbot');
  assert result->>'status'='recorded', 'retry is idempotent';
  result:=public.record_hotmart_click(event,gen_random_uuid(),'chatbot','/chatbot');
  assert result->>'status'='conflict', 'cannot reassign another visitor event';
  perform public.record_hotmart_click(gen_random_uuid(),v,'chatbot','/cursos');
  perform public.record_hotmart_click(gen_random_uuid(),v,'course','/cursos');
  perform public.record_hotmart_click(gen_random_uuid(),v,'home','/');
  select * into item from private.hotmart_click_summary where visitor=v;
  assert item.chatbot_clicks=2 and item.course_clicks=1 and item.home_clicks=1 and item.total_clicks=4,
    'separate atomic source counters';
  assert (select count(*) from private.hotmart_click_events where visitor=v)=4, 'no duplicated events';
  result:=public.record_hotmart_click(gen_random_uuid(),v,'course','/');
  assert result->>'status'='invalid', 'course source requires the course route';
  assert not has_function_privilege('anon','public.record_hotmart_click(uuid,uuid,text,text)','execute'), 'RPC is server-only';
  assert not has_table_privilege('anon','private.hotmart_click_counts','select'), 'no public counts';
  assert not has_table_privilege('authenticated','private.hotmart_click_summary','select'), 'no cross-user read';
end $$;
reset role;
```

<a id="archivo-tests-marketing-ledger-unit-sql"></a>

### `tests/marketing_ledger_unit.sql`

SHA-256: `38aa936762ab1f2d2fa632ff48bb0124e6adec6d5eb715c6d705f282a56d5af1` · 59 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Manual SQL unit verification. Synthetic records are always rolled back.
begin;
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare
  sale jsonb := jsonb_build_object('provider','consultation_payments','external_transaction_id','unit_tx_20261029',
    'external_event_id','unit_sale_20261029','event_type','sale','occurred_at','2026-10-29T12:00:00+00:00',
    'service','consultation','product_id',null,'currency','CLP','amount_minor',10000,
    'campaign_id',null,'attribution_method','unknown','attribution_reference',null);
  spend jsonb := jsonb_build_object('platform','google_ads','campaign_id','unit_campaign','spend_date','2026-10-29',
    'source_timezone','America/Santiago','currency','CLP','spend_minor',1000);
  batch jsonb;
  outcome jsonb;
begin
  batch := jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','movements','file_digest',repeat('a',64),'rows',jsonb_build_array(sale));
  outcome := public.marketing_import_batch(batch);
  if outcome->>'status'<>'applied' then raise exception 'unit_apply_failed'; end if;
  outcome := public.marketing_import_batch(batch);
  if (outcome->>'replayed')::boolean is not true then raise exception 'unit_replay_failed'; end if;
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(batch,'{file_digest}',to_jsonb(repeat('b',64))),
    '{rows}',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_set(sale,'{external_event_id}','"unit_other_delivery"'))));
  if (select count(*) from private.marketing_movements where external_event_id in ('unit_sale_20261029','unit_other_delivery'))<>1 then
    raise exception 'unit_sale_duplicated';
  end if;
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','movements','file_digest',repeat('c',64),
    'rows',jsonb_build_array(sale || '{"external_event_id":"unit_refund","event_type":"refund","amount_minor":1000}'::jsonb)));
  if (select sum(amount_minor) from private.marketing_movements where external_event_id='unit_refund')<>1000 then
    raise exception 'unit_refund_failed';
  end if;
  begin
    perform public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','movements','file_digest',repeat('d',64),
      'rows',jsonb_build_array(sale || '{"external_transaction_id":"unit_must_rollback","external_event_id":"unit_rollback_sale"}'::jsonb,
        sale || '{"external_event_id":"unit_excess_refund","event_type":"refund","amount_minor":20000}'::jsonb)));
    raise exception 'unit_expected_reversal_failure';
  exception when raise_exception then
    if sqlerrm<>'marketing_invalid_reversal' then raise; end if;
  end;
  if exists(select 1 from private.marketing_transactions where external_transaction_id='unit_must_rollback') then
    raise exception 'unit_partial_batch_persisted';
  end if;
  batch := jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','spend','file_digest',repeat('e',64),'rows',jsonb_build_array(spend));
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(batch);
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(batch,'{file_digest}',to_jsonb(repeat('f',64))),
    '{rows}',jsonb_build_array(spend || '{"spend_minor":2000}'::jsonb)));
  if (select spend_minor from private.marketing_ad_spend where campaign_id='unit_campaign')<>2000 then
    raise exception 'unit_spend_not_replaced';
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from private.marketing_spend_revisions r join private.marketing_ad_spend s on s.id=r.spend_id where s.campaign_id='unit_campaign')<>1 then
    raise exception 'unit_revision_missing';
  end if;
  if has_function_privilege('anon','public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb)','execute')
    or has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb)','execute') then
    raise exception 'unit_public_rpc_access';
  end if;
end;
$$;
reset role;
select 'marketing_ledger_unit_passed' as verification;
rollback;
```
