### `tests/marketing_report_unit.sql`

SHA-256: `191871d4ee360cb3c7898603e12583c697edb41ff489e7f12b273c0be182fcd9` · 41 líneas · sin seguimiento previo.

```sql
-- Private aggregate report reconciliation, reverted completely (no real sales).
begin;
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare
  sale jsonb := jsonb_build_object('provider','consultation_payments','external_transaction_id','unit_m13_tx',
    'external_event_id','unit_m13_sale','event_type','sale','occurred_at','2097-11-01T12:00:00Z','service','consultation',
    'product_id',null,'currency','CLP','amount_minor',10000,'campaign_id',null,'attribution_method','unknown','attribution_reference',null);
  refund jsonb;
  batch jsonb;
  result jsonb;
begin
  refund := sale || jsonb_build_object('external_event_id','unit_m13_refund','event_type','refund','amount_minor',2500,'occurred_at','2097-11-02T12:00:00Z');
  batch := jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','movements','file_digest',repeat('7',64),'rows',jsonb_build_array(sale,refund));
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(batch);
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(batch); -- same file must not duplicate a sale
  perform public.marketing_import_batch(jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'kind','movements','file_digest',repeat('8',64),
    'rows',jsonb_build_array(sale || jsonb_build_object('external_event_id','unit_m13_other_delivery'))));
  result := public.marketing_report_snapshot('2097-11-01','2097-11-02');
  assert result->>'status'='ready';
  assert jsonb_array_length(result->'snapshot'->'cash')=2;
  assert (result->'snapshot'->'cash'->0->>'sales_count')::integer=1;
  assert (result->'snapshot'->'cash'->0->>'sales_minor')::bigint=10000;
  assert (result->'snapshot'->'cash'->1->>'refunds_minor')::bigint=2500;
  assert result->'snapshot'->'sources'->'ledger'->>'state'='partial';
  assert result->'snapshot'->'sources'->'analytics'->>'state'='missing';
  assert not (result::text like '%external_transaction_id%' or result::text like '%normalized_record%' or result::text like '%full_name%' or result::text like '%email%');
  result := public.marketing_report_snapshot('2097-11-02','2097-11-02');
  assert jsonb_array_length(result->'snapshot'->'cash')=1;
  assert (result->'snapshot'->'cash'->0->>'sales_count')::integer=0;
  assert not has_function_privilege('anon','public.marketing_report_snapshot(date,date)','execute');
  assert not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.marketing_report_snapshot(date,date)','execute');
  begin
    perform public.marketing_report_snapshot('2097-11-03','2097-11-01');
    raise exception 'invalid_dates_accepted';
  exception when others then
    if sqlerrm<>'invalid_report_period' then raise; end if;
  end;
end $$;
select 'marketing_report_unit_passed' as result;
rollback;
```

<a id="archivo-tests-setter-refresh-unit-sql"></a>

### `tests/setter_refresh_unit.sql`

SHA-256: `aeb3e85c8384864ecc894fa90d46fb9e5373e602f90f658c00ea3277800f85ac` · 60 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```sql
-- Execute inside BEGIN / ROLLBACK: no provider calls or retained visitors.
set local role service_role;
do $$
declare
  v uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); closed_visitor uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
  conversation uuid; previous uuid; request uuid; result jsonb; budget_before bigint;
  today date:=(now() at time zone 'America/Santiago')::date;
  limits jsonb:='{"max_completed_rounds":10,"max_provider_attempts_per_conversation":12,"max_completed_rounds_per_visitor_day":30,"max_provider_attempts_per_visitor_day":36,"max_new_conversations_per_visitor_day":3,"cooldown_minutes_after_close":30,"daily_budget_micro_usd":900000000000,"reservation_micro_usd":1}';
  answer jsonb:='{"reply":"Refresh fixture","topic":"online","action":"show_hotmart","contact_declined":true,"stop":false}';
begin
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'session',limits);
  conversation:=(result#>>'{state,conversation_id}')::uuid;
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  assert result->>'status'='ready', 'an empty conversation remains ready';
  assert (select conversations from private.setter_daily where visitor=v and day=today)=1, 'empty refresh does not spend daily conversations';

  request:=gen_random_uuid();
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'reserve',limits,conversation,request,'hash');
  assert result->>'status'='reserved', 'fixture reserved';
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'complete',limits,conversation,request,null,answer,'{}');
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'start_capture',limits,conversation);
  select reserved_micro_usd into budget_before from private.setter_budget where day=today;
  previous:=conversation;
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  conversation:=(result#>>'{state,conversation_id}')::uuid;
  assert result->>'status'='ready' and conversation<>previous, 'used conversation replaced';
  assert result#>>'{state,completed_rounds}'='0' and result#>>'{state,provider_attempts}'='0', 'per-conversation rounds reset';
  assert result#>>'{state,topic}'='unknown' and result#>>'{state,action}'='none', 'topic and action reset';
  assert result#>>'{state,capturing}'='false' and result#>>'{state,contact_declined}'='false', 'capture and declined contact reset';
  assert result#>'{state,last_result}'='null'::jsonb, 'previous result cleared';
  assert (select completed_rounds=1 and provider_attempts=1 and conversations=2 from private.setter_daily where visitor=v and day=today), 'daily usage preserved';
  assert (select reserved_micro_usd from private.setter_budget where day=today)=budget_before, 'global budget not reset';
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'lookup',limits,previous,request,'hash');
  assert result->>'status'='conversation_changed', 'old tab cannot reuse its old conversation';

  request:=gen_random_uuid();
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'reserve',limits,conversation,request,'hash');
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  assert result->>'status'='pending' and (result#>>'{state,conversation_id}')::uuid=conversation, 'pending work cannot be orphaned';
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'fail',limits,conversation,request);
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  conversation:=(result#>>'{state,conversation_id}')::uuid;
  assert result->>'status'='ready', 'refresh works after the attempt settles';
  request:=gen_random_uuid();
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'reserve',limits,conversation,request,'hash');
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'complete',limits,conversation,request,null,answer,'{}');
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  assert result->>'status'='daily_conversation_limit', 'daily conversation ceiling preserved';
  update private.setter_daily set conversations=1,completed_rounds=30 where visitor=v and day=today;
  result:=public.setter_transition(v,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  assert result->>'status'='daily_limit', 'daily response ceiling preserved';

  result:=public.setter_transition(closed_visitor,'session',limits);
  conversation:=(result#>>'{state,conversation_id}')::uuid;
  update private.setter_conversations set closed_at=now(),completed_rounds=10 where visitor=closed_visitor;
  result:=public.setter_transition(closed_visitor,'refresh',limits,conversation);
  assert result->>'status'='cooldown', 'closed conversations keep their cooldown';
end $$;
reset role;
```

import io
import json
import os
import unittest
from email.message import Message
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from uuid import uuid4

from api.admin import handler
from backend.admin import process_admin, date_bounds, cursor_values
from backend.admin_security import password_hash, verify_password, session_cookie, session_token, token_hash
from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable


class SecurityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.encoded = password_hash('a-unit-password-only')

    def test_salted_hash_and_password_verification(self):
        self.assertNotIn('a-unit-password-only', self.encoded)
        self.assertNotEqual(self.encoded, password_hash('a-unit-password-only'))
        self.assertTrue(verify_password('a-unit-password-only', self.encoded))
        self.assertFalse(verify_password('wrong', self.encoded))
        for value in ('broken', None, 'pbkdf2_sha256$1$aa$bb'):
            self.assertFalse(verify_password('anything', value))

    @patch.dict(os.environ, {'APP_ENV': 'production'})
    def test_cookie_is_private_scoped_and_clearable(self):
        token = 'a' * 43
        cookie = session_cookie(token)
        for part in ('HttpOnly', 'Secure', 'SameSite=Strict', 'Path=/api/admin', 'Max-Age=28800'):
            self.assertIn(part, cookie)
        self.assertEqual(session_token(cookie), token)
        self.assertIsNone(session_token('nz_admin=bad'))
        self.assertIsNone(session_token('nz_admin=' + 'é' * 43))
        self.assertIn('Max-Age=0', session_cookie(clear=True))
        self.assertEqual(len(token_hash(token)), 64)


class FilterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chilean_calendar_dates_and_inclusive_range(self):
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({'mode': 'day', 'day': '2026-11-01'})['start'], '2026-11-01T03:00:00+00:00')
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({'mode': 'month', 'month': '2026-02'})['end'], '2026-03-01T03:00:00+00:00')
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({'mode': 'range', 'start': '2026-10-31', 'end': '2026-11-01'})['end'], '2026-11-02T03:00:00+00:00')
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({}), {'start': None, 'end': None, 'interest': None, 'reading': 'all'})
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({'reading': 'unread'})['reading'], 'unread')
        self.assertEqual(date_bounds({'reading': 'read'})['reading'], 'read')

    def test_dst_day_does_not_assume_24_hours(self):
        value = date_bounds({'mode': 'day', 'day': '2026-09-06'})
        self.assertEqual(value['start'], '2026-09-06T04:00:00+00:00')
        self.assertEqual(value['end'], '2026-09-07T03:00:00+00:00')

    def test_invalid_filters_and_cursors(self):
        for filters in ({'mode': 'bad'}, {'mode': 'day', 'day': 'bad'}, {'mode': 'month', 'month': '2026-13'},
                        {'mode': 'range', 'start': '2026-11-02', 'end': '2026-11-01'}, {'interest': 'bad'}, {'reading': 'bad'}, {'sql': 'x'}):
            with self.subTest(filters=filters), self.assertRaises((ValueError, KeyError)):
                date_bounds(filters)
        for cursor in ({'id': 'bad'}, {'id': str(uuid4()), 'created_at': '2026-01-01'}, 'bad'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): cursor_values(cursor)


class CoordinatorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mark_read_requires_session_and_accepts_only_a_valid_id(self):
        record_id = str(uuid4())
        call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': 'ready', 'id': record_id, 'read_at': '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z'})
        self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'mark_read', 'id': record_id}, call=call)[0], 401)
        call.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'mark_read', 'id': 'invalid'}, 'a' * 43, call)[0], 400)
        call.assert_not_called()
        result = process_admin({'operation': 'mark_read', 'id': record_id}, 'a' * 43, call)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(call.call_args.args[1], {'p_operation': 'mark_read', 'p_values': {'id': record_id, 'token_hash': token_hash('a' * 43)}})
        self.assertEqual(result[1]['read_at'], '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z')

    def test_mark_read_preserves_not_found_and_expired_session_errors(self):
        for status, code in (('not_found', 404), ('unauthorized', 401)):
            call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': status})
            self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'mark_read', 'id': str(uuid4())}, 'a' * 43, call)[0], code)

    def test_no_session_never_queries_interests(self):
        call = MagicMock()
        self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'interests'}, call=call)[:2], (401, {'status': 'unauthorized'}))
        call.assert_not_called()

    def test_wrong_password_returns_no_hash_and_no_session(self):
        call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': 'challenge', 'password_hash': 'private-hash'})
        with patch('backend.admin.verify_password', return_value=False):
            code, result, token = process_admin({'operation': 'login', 'username': 'unit', 'password': 'wrong'}, call=call)
        self.assertEqual((code, result, token), (401, {'status': 'invalid_credentials'}, None))
        self.assertEqual(call.call_count, 1)

    def test_login_creates_opaque_token_and_never_returns_hash(self):
        call = MagicMock(side_effect=[{'status': 'challenge', 'password_hash': 'private-hash', 'user_id': str(uuid4())}, {'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'}])
        with patch('backend.admin.verify_password', return_value=True):
            code, result, token = process_admin({'operation': 'login', 'username': 'unit', 'password': 'valid'}, call=call)
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(result, {'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'})
        self.assertEqual(len(token), 43)
        self.assertEqual(call.call_args.args[1]['p_values']['token_hash'], token_hash(token))

    def test_locked_account_does_not_verify_or_create_session(self):
        call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': 'rate_limited'})
        with patch('backend.admin.verify_password') as verify:
            self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'login', 'username': 'unit', 'password': 'x'}, call=call)[0], 429)
            verify.assert_not_called()

    def test_expired_session_discards_cookie_and_never_falls_back(self):
        call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': 'unauthorized'})
        self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'detail', 'id': str(uuid4())}, 'a' * 43, call), (401, {'status': 'unauthorized'}, ''))

    def test_filters_are_normalized_and_cursor_forwarded(self):
        call = MagicMock(return_value={'status': 'ready', 'items': []})
        result = process_admin({'operation': 'interests', 'filters': {'mode': 'day', 'day': '2026-11-01'},
                                'cursor': {'created_at': '2026-11-01T10:00:00Z', 'id': str(uuid4())}}, 'a' * 43, call)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], 200)
        values = call.call_args.args[1]['p_values']
        self.assertEqual(values['end'], '2026-11-02T03:00:00+00:00')
        self.assertIn('cursor_id', values)
        self.assertNotIn('a' * 43, values.values())

    def test_password_change_verifies_current_and_revokes_cookie(self):
        call = MagicMock(side_effect=[{'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'},
                                     {'status': 'challenge', 'password_hash': 'old-hash'}, {'status': 'password_changed'}])
        with patch('backend.admin.verify_password', return_value=True), patch('backend.admin.password_hash', return_value='new-hash'):
            self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'password', 'currentPassword': 'old', 'newPassword': 'a-new-password'}, 'a' * 43, call),
                             (200, {'status': 'password_changed'}, ''))
        self.assertEqual(call.call_args.args[1]['p_values']['new_hash'], 'new-hash')

    def test_password_change_wrong_current_does_not_write(self):
        call = MagicMock(side_effect=[{'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'}, {'status': 'challenge', 'password_hash': 'old-hash'}])
        with patch('backend.admin.verify_password', return_value=False):
            self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'password', 'currentPassword': 'wrong', 'newPassword': 'a-new-password'}, 'a' * 43, call)[1], {'status': 'wrong_password'})
        self.assertEqual(call.call_count, 2)

    def test_invalid_input_and_unavailable_store_are_closed(self):
        for payload in (None, {'operation': 'bad'}, {'operation': 'login', 'username': 'unit', 'password': 'x', 'role': 'admin'},
                        {'operation': 'password', 'currentPassword': 'old', 'newPassword': 'short'}, {'operation': 'detail', 'id': 'bad'}):
            self.assertEqual(process_admin(payload, 'a' * 43, MagicMock())[0], 400)
        call = MagicMock(side_effect=StoreUnavailable())
        self.assertEqual(process_admin({'operation': 'session'}, 'a' * 43, call)[0], 503)


class HttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def request(self, body, extra=None):
        instance = object.__new__(handler)
        instance.path = '/api/admin'
        instance.headers = Message()
        for key, value in {'Host': 'localhost:5173', 'Origin': 'http://localhost:5173', 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                           'X-Admin-Request': '1', 'Content-Length': str(len(body)), **(extra or {})}.items():
            instance.headers[key] = value
        instance.rfile = io.BytesIO(body)
        instance.reply = MagicMock()
        return instance

    @patch('api.admin.process_admin')
    def test_cross_origin_and_missing_csrf_header_rejected(self, process):
        for extra in ({'Origin': 'https://evil.invalid'}, {'X-Admin-Request': ''}):
            instance = self.request(b'{}', extra)
            instance.do_POST()
            self.assertEqual(instance.reply.call_args.args[0], 403)
        process.assert_not_called()

    @patch('api.admin.process_admin', return_value=(200, {'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'}, 'a' * 43))
    def test_sets_httponly_cookie_and_returns_only_public_result(self, process):
        instance = self.request(json.dumps({'operation': 'login'}).encode())
        instance.do_POST()
        self.assertIn('HttpOnly', instance.setter_cookie)
        self.assertEqual(instance.reply.call_args.args[1], {'status': 'authenticated', 'username': 'unit'})

class ValidationTests(unittest.TestCase):

        for value in ([], None, [{'role': 'system', 'content': 'x'}], [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'x' * 1001}],
                      [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'x'}], [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'x', 'quota': 0}],
                      [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'x'}] * 13):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(InvalidChatRequest):
                validate_messages(value)

        cases = json.loads(Path('config/chatbot/decision-cases.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        self.assertEqual(len(cases['model_cases']), 32)
        for case in cases['model_cases']:
            with self.subTest(case=case['id']):
                context = {**cases['server_context_defaults'], **case['input']['server_context']}
                self.assertEqual(validate_decision(case['expected'], context), case['expected'])

        invalid = [{**DECISION, 'action': 'start_contact_capture'}, {**DECISION, 'topic': 'nature'},

        self.assertIn('SameSite=Lax', cookie)

    def request(self, body=b'{}'):

        request.path = '/api/chat'
        request.headers = Message()
        request.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        request.headers['Content-Length'] = str(len(body))
        request.rfile, request.wfile = io.BytesIO(body), io.BytesIO()
        request.send_response, request.send_header, request.end_headers = MagicMock(), MagicMock(), MagicMock()
        return request

    @patch('api.chat.process_chat', return_value=(200, {'status': 'ready'}))
    def test_get_bootstraps_cookie_and_session_without_provider(self, process):
        request = self.request()
        request.do_GET()
        self.assertIn('HttpOnly', request.setter_cookie)
        self.assertEqual(process.call_args.args[0], {'operation': 'session'})

    @patch('api.chat.process_chat')
    def test_rejects_invalid_http_and_cross_origin(self, process):
        for header, value in (('Content-Type', 'text/plain'), ('Content-Length', '65537'), ('Sec-Fetch-Site', 'cross-site'), ('Origin', 'https://elsewhere.invalid')):
            request = self.request()
            request.headers.replace_header(header, value) if header in request.headers else request.headers.add_header(header, value)
            request.do_POST()
            self.assertGreaterEqual(request.send_response.call_args.args[0], 400)
        process.assert_not_called()

    def test_local_origin_requires_preserved_browser_host(self):
        request = self.request()
        request.headers['Origin'] = 'http://localhost:5173'
        request.headers['Host'] = 'localhost:5173'
        request.headers['Sec-Fetch-Site'] = 'same-origin'
        self.assertTrue(request.same_origin())
        request.headers.replace_header('Host', '127.0.0.1:3001')
        self.assertFalse(request.same_origin())
        request.headers.replace_header('Host', 'localhost:5173')
        request.headers.replace_header('Origin', 'https://elsewhere.invalid')
        self.assertFalse(request.same_origin())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('setter_accounting', ROOT / 'chatbot testing/scripts/pipeline_common.py')
accounting = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(accounting)
SOURCES = json.loads((ROOT / 'chatbot testing/evidence/sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


class TokenAccountingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_utf8_transport_preserves_accents_for_the_next_round(self):
        reply = 'Aquí tienes información en la página de cursos. ¿Qué prefieres?'
        payload = (json.dumps({'status': 'completed', 'result': {'reply': reply}}, ensure_ascii=False) + 'HTTP_CODE:200').encode('utf-8')
        parsed = accounting.parse_http_output(payload)
        self.assertEqual(parsed['body']['result']['reply'], reply)
        self.assertEqual(parsed['http_status'], 200)
        next_request = json.dumps({'messages': [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': parsed['body']['result']['reply']}]}, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(next_request)['messages'][0]['content'], reply)

    def test_cache_writes_use_their_own_tariff(self):
        usage = {'input_tokens': 2591, 'output_tokens': 32, 'total_tokens': 2623,
                 'input_tokens_details': {'cache_write_tokens': 2588, 'cached_tokens': 0},
                 'output_tokens_details': {'reasoning_tokens': 0}, 'service_tier': 'default'}
        self.assertEqual(accounting.calculate_cost(usage, SOURCES), {'usd': '0.0003398', 'clp': '0.335239884'})

    def test_reasoning_is_already_in_output_and_is_not_added_twice(self):
        usage = {'input_tokens': 10, 'output_tokens': 5, 'total_tokens': 15,
                 'input_tokens_details': {'cached_tokens': 10}, 'output_tokens_details': {'reasoning_tokens': 5}}
        self.assertEqual(accounting.calculate_cost(usage, SOURCES)['usd'], '0.0000026')

    def test_unmeasured_or_unpriced_service_does_not_become_zero_cost(self):
        self.assertIsNone(accounting.calculate_cost({}, SOURCES))
        usage = {'input_tokens': 10, 'output_tokens': 5, 'total_tokens': 15, 'input_tokens_details': {'cached_tokens': 0}, 'service_tier': 'unknown'}
        self.assertIsNone(accounting.calculate_cost(usage, SOURCES))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

        open_url.return_value.__enter__.return_value.status = 200
        with self.assertRaises(StorageUnavailable):
            save_interest(validate_submission(submission()))

    @patch("backend.interests.urlopen")
    def test_rate_limit_is_reported(self, open_url):
        open_url.side_effect = HTTPError("https://example.invalid", 400, "limit", {}, io.BytesIO(b'{"code":"P0001","message":"interest_rate_limited"}'))
        self.assertEqual(process_submission(submission())[0], 429)

    @patch("backend.interests.urlopen")
    def test_database_errors_do_not_leak_details(self, open_url):
        open_url.side_effect = HTTPError("https://example.invalid", 500, "error", {}, io.BytesIO(b'private details'))
        status, body = process_submission(submission())
        self.assertEqual(status, 503)
        self.assertNotIn("private", json.dumps(body))


class HandlerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def request(self, body, content_type="application/json", length=None):
        request = object.__new__(handler)
        request.path = '/api/interests'
        request.headers = Message()
        request.headers["Content-Type"] = content_type
        request.headers["Content-Length"] = str(len(body) if length is None else length)
        request.rfile = io.BytesIO(body)
        request.wfile = io.BytesIO()
        request.send_response = MagicMock()
        request.send_header = MagicMock()
        request.end_headers = MagicMock()
        return request

    @patch("api.interests.process_submission", return_value=(201, {"status": "saved"}))
    def test_json_post_calls_application(self, process):
        request = self.request(json.dumps(submission()).encode())
        request.do_POST()
        request.send_response.assert_called_once_with(201)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(request.wfile.getvalue()), {"status": "saved"})
        process.assert_called_once()

    @patch("api.interests.process_submission")
    def test_invalid_http_input_never_calls_storage(self, process):
        for body, mime, size, code in ((b'{}', 'text/plain', None, 415), (b'{', 'application/json', None, 400),
                                      (b'{}', 'application/json', 9000, 413), (b'{}', 'application/json', 'bad', 400)):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                request = self.request(body, mime, size)
                request.do_POST()
                request.send_response.assert_called_once_with(code)
        process.assert_not_called()

    def test_reads_are_not_supported(self):
        request = self.request(b'')
        request.do_GET()
        request.send_response.assert_called_once_with(405)

    def test_cross_site_post_is_rejected(self):
        request = self.request(b'{}')
        request.headers['Sec-Fetch-Site'] = 'cross-site'
        request.do_POST()
        request.send_response.assert_called_once_with(403)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from backend.local_environment import load_local_environment


class LocalEnvironmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_loads_server_settings_without_overriding_process_or_executing_values(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch.dict(os.environ, {'OPENAI_MODEL': 'process-model'}, clear=True):
            root = Path(directory)
            (root / '.env.local').write_text('OPENAI_API_KEY="unit-key"\nOPENAI_MODEL=file-model\nVERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN=ignored\nCHAT_COOKIE_SECRET=$(literal)\n', encoding='utf-8')
            (root / '.env').write_text('OPENAI_API_KEY=fallback\nAPP_ENV=development\n', encoding='utf-8')
            load_local_environment(root)
            self.assertEqual(os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'], 'unit-key')
            self.assertEqual(os.environ['OPENAI_MODEL'], 'process-model')
            self.assertEqual(os.environ['CHAT_COOKIE_SECRET'], '$(literal)')
            self.assertEqual(os.environ['APP_ENV'], 'development')
            self.assertNotIn('VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN', os.environ)

    def test_missing_local_files_do_not_create_settings(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
            load_local_environment(directory)
            self.assertNotIn('OPENAI_API_KEY', os.environ)

import csv
import io
import unittest
import tempfile
import json
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from backend.marketing_ledger import MOVEMENT_FIELDS, InvalidMarketingData, money_minor, validate_movement, validate_spend
from backend.marketing_imports import parse_marketing_csv, apply_marketing_batch
from backend.marketing_store import MarketingStore
from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable
from scripts.import_marketing_data import main


def movement(**changes):
    return {**dict(zip(MOVEMENT_FIELDS, ['consultation_payments', 'tx_1', 'event_1', 'sale', '2026-10-29T12:00:00Z',
        'consultation', '', 'CLP', '10000', '', 'unknown', ''])), **changes}


def csv_bytes(rows):
    output = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=MOVEMENT_FIELDS)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return output.getvalue().encode('utf-8')


class MarketingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_incomplete_files_and_formula_identifiers_are_rejected(self):
        for content in (b'', b'provider,amount_decimal\nconsultation_payments,10\n',
                        csv_bytes([movement(external_transaction_id='=SUM(A1)')])):
            with self.subTest(content=content):
                try:
                    report = parse_marketing_csv(content)
                except InvalidMarketingData:
                    continue
                self.assertFalse(report['valid'])
        truncated = csv_bytes([movement()]).decode().rsplit(',', 1)[0].encode()
        self.assertFalse(parse_marketing_csv(truncated)['valid'])

    def test_distinct_currencies_remain_separate_without_conversion(self):
        report = parse_marketing_csv(csv_bytes([
            movement(currency='USD', amount_decimal='10.25'),
            movement(external_transaction_id='tx_2', external_event_id='event_2', currency='EUR', amount_decimal='10.25'),
        ]))
        self.assertTrue(report['valid'])
        self.assertEqual([(row['currency'], row['amount_minor']) for row in report['rows']], [('USD', 1025), ('EUR', 1025)])

    def test_dry_run_never_loads_credentials_or_calls_storage(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / 'fixture.csv'
            path.write_bytes(csv_bytes([movement()]))
            with patch('scripts.import_marketing_data.load_local_environment') as load, patch('scripts.import_marketing_data.MarketingStore') as store, patch('sys.stdout', new_callable=io.StringIO) as output:
                self.assertEqual(main([str(path), '--dry-run']), 0)
                self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())['valid'])
                load.assert_not_called()
                store.assert_not_called()

    def test_spend_requires_approved_campaign_and_preserves_confirmed_zero(self):
        row = {'platform': 'google_ads', 'campaign_id': 'fixture_1', 'spend_date': '2026-10-29', 'source_timezone': 'America/Santiago', 'currency': 'CLP', 'spend_decimal': '0'}
        self.assertEqual(validate_spend(row, {'fixture_1'})['spend_minor'], 0)
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): validate_spend(row, set())
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): validate_spend({**row, 'source_timezone': 'Invalid/Zone'}, {'fixture_1'})

    def test_enabled_store_requires_durable_applied_response(self):
        with patch.dict('os.environ', {'MARKETING_LEDGER_ENABLED': 'true'}), patch('backend.marketing_store.rpc', return_value={'status': 'conflict'}):
            with self.assertRaises(StoreUnavailable): MarketingStore().apply_batch({})

    def test_exact_money_and_currency_rules(self):
        self.assertEqual(money_minor('123.45', 'USD'), 12345)
        self.assertEqual(money_minor('123', 'CLP'), 123)
        for value, currency in [('1.1', 'CLP'), ('1.001', 'USD'), ('NaN', 'USD'), ('1e6', 'USD'), ('-1', 'USD'), ('=1+2', 'CLP'), ('1', 'GBP')]:
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): money_minor(value, currency)

    def test_rejects_sensitive_columns_and_unknown_attribution(self):
        for row in [{**movement(), 'email': 'a@b.invalid'}, movement(campaign_id='made_up'), movement(occurred_at='2026-10-29'), movement(attribution_reference='person@example.invalid')]:
            with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): validate_movement(row)

    def test_normalizes_without_guessing_missing_campaign_or_product(self):
        value = validate_movement(movement())
        self.assertEqual(value['amount_minor'], 10000)
        self.assertIsNone(value['campaign_id'])
        self.assertIsNone(value['product_id'])
        self.assertEqual(value['occurred_at'], '2026-10-29T12:00:00+00:00')

    def test_whole_batch_validation_and_idempotent_input(self):
        report = parse_marketing_csv(csv_bytes([movement(), movement()]))
        self.assertTrue(report['valid'])
        self.assertEqual(len(report['rows']), 1)
        conflict = parse_marketing_csv(csv_bytes([movement(), movement(amount_decimal='20000')]))
        self.assertFalse(conflict['valid'])
        store = Mock()
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): apply_marketing_batch(conflict, store)
        store.apply_batch.assert_not_called()

    def test_reports_only_line_and_fixed_error_code(self):
        report = parse_marketing_csv(csv_bytes([movement(amount_decimal='private-string')]))
        self.assertFalse(report['valid'])
        self.assertEqual(report['errors'], [{'line': 2, 'code': 'invalid_amount'}])
        self.assertNotIn('private-string', str(report))

    def test_disabled_store_does_not_call_rpc(self):
        with patch.dict('os.environ', {'MARKETING_LEDGER_ENABLED': 'false'}), patch('backend.marketing_store.rpc') as rpc:
            with self.assertRaises(StoreUnavailable): MarketingStore().apply_batch({})
            rpc.assert_not_called()

    def test_apply_passes_only_validated_normalized_batch(self):
        report = parse_marketing_csv(csv_bytes([movement()]))
        store = Mock()
        apply_marketing_batch(report, store)
        payload = store.apply_batch.call_args.args[0]
        self.assertEqual(set(payload), {'schema_version', 'kind', 'file_digest', 'rows'})
        self.assertNotIn('amount_decimal', payload['rows'][0])


if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()

def cash(**changes):

            with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): export_report(build_report(data),target)

    def test_invalid_export_does_not_create_partial_directory(self):
        report=build_report(snapshot()); report['datasets']['quality'].append({'secret':'private'})
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            output=Path(directory)/'report'
            with self.assertRaises(InvalidMarketingData): export_report(report,output)
            self.assertFalse(output.exists())

    def test_windows_export_inherits_parent_permissions_instead_of_owner_only_acl(self):
        original_mkdir=Path.mkdir
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            output=Path(directory)/'report'
            with patch('backend.marketing_report_export.os') as operating_system, patch.object(Path,'mkdir',autospec=True,side_effect=original_mkdir) as mkdir:
                operating_system.name='nt'
                export_report(build_report(snapshot()),output)
                modes=[call.kwargs.get('mode') for call in mkdir.call_args_list if '.marketing-report-' in str(call.args[0])]
            self.assertEqual(modes,[0o777])

    def test_offline_cli_does_not_load_environment_or_touch_database(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            source=Path(directory)/'snapshot.json'; source.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot()),encoding='utf-8')
            with patch('scripts.export_marketing_report.load_local_environment') as load, patch('scripts.export_marketing_report.MarketingReportStore') as store, patch('sys.stdout',new_callable=io.StringIO) as output:
                self.assertEqual(main(['--input',str(source),'--output',str(Path(directory)/'out')]),0)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())['status'],'exported')
                load.assert_not_called(); store.assert_not_called()

    def test_invalid_cli_never_echoes_raw_values_or_paths(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            source=Path(directory)/'private-name.json'; source.write_text(json.dumps({'email':'private@example.invalid'}),encoding='utf-8')
            with patch('sys.stdout',new_callable=io.StringIO) as output:
                self.assertEqual(main(['--input',str(source),'--output',str(Path(directory)/'out')]),1)
                self.assertNotIn('private',output.getvalue())


class ReportStoreTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_disabled_reader_does_not_call_database_or_enable_imports(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{'MARKETING_REPORTS_ENABLED':'false','MARKETING_LEDGER_ENABLED':'true'}), patch('backend.marketing_report_store.rpc') as call:
            with self.assertRaises(StoreUnavailable): MarketingReportStore().snapshot('2026-11-01','2026-11-01')
            call.assert_not_called()

    def test_reader_uses_aggregate_rpc_and_increased_bounded_response(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{'MARKETING_REPORTS_ENABLED':'true','MARKETING_LEDGER_ENABLED':'false'}), patch('backend.marketing_report_store.rpc',return_value={'status':'ready','snapshot':snapshot()}) as call:
            self.assertEqual(MarketingReportStore().snapshot('2026-11-01','2026-11-01'),snapshot())
            call.assert_called_once_with('marketing_report_snapshot',{'p_start':'2026-11-01','p_end':'2026-11-01'},max_response_bytes=2*1024*1024)

    def test_unexpected_storage_response_is_never_an_empty_success(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{'MARKETING_REPORTS_ENABLED':'true'}), patch('backend.marketing_report_store.rpc',return_value={'status':'error'}):
            with self.assertRaises(StoreUnavailable): MarketingReportStore().snapshot('2026-11-01','2026-11-01')

    def test_shared_rpc_rejects_a_truncated_response(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{'SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY':'unit-secret'}), patch('backend.chat_store.urlopen') as open_request:
            response=open_request.return_value.__enter__.return_value
            response.status=200; response.read.return_value=b'x'*11
            with self.assertRaises(StoreUnavailable): rpc('unit',{},max_response_bytes=10)

```python
import json
import os
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from backend.chatbot import (OpenAIUnavailable, choose_response, encode_provider_payload,
                             process_chat, public_result, trusted_context)
from backend.chat_store import budget_limits
from backend.provider_settings import output_token_limit, reasoning_effort, request_timeout


class ProviderSettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True)
    def test_defaults_allow_short_conversational_replies(self):
        self.assertEqual(output_token_limit(), 512)
        self.assertEqual(request_timeout(), 15)
        self.assertEqual(reasoning_effort(), '')
        body = json.loads(encode_provider_payload([{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Curso'}], trusted_context({})))
        self.assertNotIn('reasoning', body)
        self.assertNotIn('testing_configuration', public_result({'status': 'ready'}))

    def test_low_and_high_are_explicit_server_settings(self):
        for effort in ('low', 'high'):
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {'OPENAI_MODEL': 'gpt-6-luna', 'OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT': effort,
                                        'OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS': '25000', 'OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS': '25'}):
                body = json.loads(encode_provider_payload([{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Curso'}], trusted_context({})))
                self.assertEqual(body['reasoning'], {'effort': effort})
                self.assertEqual(body['model'], 'gpt-6-luna')
                self.assertEqual(body['max_output_tokens'], 25000)
                self.assertEqual(request_timeout(), 25)

    def test_invalid_limits_fail_closed(self):
        for key, value, function in (('OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS', '25001', output_token_limit),
                                     ('OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', '26', request_timeout),
                                     ('OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT', 'invented', reasoning_effort)):
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {key: value}), self.assertRaises(ValueError): function()

    @patch.dict(os.environ, {'CHAT_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION': '0.10', 'CHAT_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION': '0.50',
                            'CHAT_DAILY_BUDGET_MICRO_USD': '3000000', 'OPENAI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS': '25000'})
    def test_reasoning_allowance_is_included_in_the_reserved_budget(self):
        self.assertEqual(budget_limits()['reservation_micro_usd'], 19259)

    @patch.dict(os.environ, {'OPENAI_API_KEY': 'unit-key'})
    @patch('backend.chatbot.urlopen')
    def test_usage_preserves_cache_and_reasoning_even_if_the_response_is_incomplete(self, open_url):
        response = open_url.return_value.__enter__.return_value
        response.status = 200
        response.read.return_value = json.dumps({'id': 'unit-response', 'model': 'gpt-6-luna', 'status': 'incomplete',
            'incomplete_details': {'reason': 'max_output_tokens'}, 'usage': {'input_tokens': 4000, 'output_tokens': 256,
            'total_tokens': 4256, 'input_tokens_details': {'cached_tokens': 2048},
            'output_tokens_details': {'reasoning_tokens': 256}}}).encode()
        with self.assertRaises(OpenAIUnavailable) as raised:
            choose_response([{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Curso'}], trusted_context({}))
        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.usage['input_tokens_details']['cached_tokens'], 2048)
        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.usage['output_tokens_details']['reasoning_tokens'], 256)
        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.usage['incomplete_reason'], 'max_output_tokens')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

### `tests/test_setter_learning.py`

SHA-256: `eab762a5058dd6f1b7708a6f0e50b0e7d8a20489bd290f676d4ee94e57517c7f` · 150 líneas · coincide con HEAD.

```python
import unittest
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
from email.message import Message
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from uuid import uuid4

from backend.chat_store import StoreUnavailable
from backend.setter_learning import approved_examples, save_feedback
from backend.chatbot import render_decision, trusted_context
from backend.setter_config import validate_decision, RESPONSES, KNOWLEDGE, INSTRUCTIONS
from api.chat_feedback import handler


def suggestion():
    return {'id': str(uuid4()), 'request_id': str(uuid4()), 'conversation_id': str(uuid4()),
            'category': 'irrelevant', 'question': '¿En qué consiste el método floral Bach?',
            'suggestion': 'Explicar el método y preguntar si le interesa aprenderlo.', 'comment': '', 'consent': True}


class LearningTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def request(self, body=b'{}'):
        request = object.__new__(handler)
        request.headers = Message()
        request.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        request.headers['Content-Length'] = str(len(body))
        request.headers['Host'] = 'localhost:5173'
        request.headers['Origin'] = 'http://localhost:5173'
        request.rfile = io.BytesIO(body)
        request.reply = MagicMock()
        return request

    @patch('backend.setter_learning.rpc')
    def test_retired_feedback_endpoint_does_not_accept_or_store_suggestions(self, rpc):
        request = self.request()
        request.do_POST()
        request.reply.assert_called_once_with(410, {'status': 'retired'})
        rpc.assert_not_called()

    @patch('backend.setter_learning.rpc', return_value={'status': 'saved'})
    def test_only_explicit_case_is_submitted_and_no_model_is_invoked(self, rpc):
        visitor = str(uuid4())
        self.assertEqual(save_feedback(suggestion(), visitor), (201, {'status': 'saved'}))
        self.assertEqual(rpc.call_args.args[0], 'setter_feedback_save')
        self.assertNotIn('messages', rpc.call_args.args[1]['p_values'])

    @patch('backend.setter_learning.rpc')
    def test_missing_identity_consent_or_unexpected_payload_never_reaches_storage(self, rpc):
        self.assertEqual(save_feedback(suggestion(), None)[0], 401)
        for update in ({'consent': False}, {'consent': 'true'}, {'id': 'bad'}, {'messages': []},
                       {'question': ''}, {'suggestion': 'x' * 1001}, {'category': 'approve'}):
            with self.subTest(update=update):
                self.assertEqual(save_feedback({**suggestion(), **update}, str(uuid4()))[0], 400)
        rpc.assert_not_called()

    @patch('backend.setter_learning.rpc', side_effect=StoreUnavailable())
    def test_optional_examples_fail_open_but_feedback_save_does_not_claim_success(self, rpc):
        self.assertEqual(approved_examples(), [])
        self.assertEqual(save_feedback(suggestion(), str(uuid4()))[0], 503)

    @patch('backend.setter_learning.rpc', return_value={'examples': [{'question': 'Caso', 'answer': 'Respuesta'}] * 12})
    def test_examples_are_bounded_and_loaded_only_through_reviewed_rpc(self, rpc):
        self.assertEqual(len(approved_examples()), 8)
        rpc.assert_called_once_with('setter_learning_examples', {})

    def test_natural_reply_is_used_instead_of_the_generic_services_list(self):
        decision = {'topic': 'therapies', 'response_key': 'therapies_info', 'action': 'show_therapies',
                    'contact_signal': 'none', 'reply': 'El método de Bach parte de observar los estados emocionales. ¿Te interesa aprenderlo?'}
        self.assertEqual(render_decision(validate_decision(decision, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True), {})['reply'], decision['reply'])
        for reply in ('', 'x' * 701, 'Abre https://example.com', '<script>x</script>'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_decision({**decision, 'reply': reply}, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_decision({k: v for k, v in decision.items() if k != 'reply'}, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True)

    def test_health_boundary_cannot_be_replaced_with_a_generated_claim(self):
        decision = {'topic': 'therapies', 'response_key': 'medical_boundary', 'action': 'none',
                    'contact_signal': 'none', 'reply': 'Esta frase no debe publicarse.'}
        self.assertEqual(render_decision(decision, {})['reply'], RESPONSES['medical_boundary'])

    def test_current_course_keeps_direct_enrollment_without_contact_gating(self):
        for topic in ('course',):
            for completed in (0, 7, 9):
                decision = {'topic': topic, 'response_key': 'hotmart_link', 'action': 'show_hotmart',
                            'contact_signal': 'declined', 'reply': 'Te dejamos el enlace para inscribirte directamente en Hotmart.'}
                context = trusted_context({'contact_declined': True})
                result = render_decision(validate_decision(decision, context, require_reply=True),
                                         {'completed_rounds': completed, 'contact_declined': True})
                self.assertEqual(result['action'], 'show_hotmart')
                self.assertNotIn('solicitar que te contactemos', result['reply'])

    def test_online_interest_keeps_the_future_edition_form(self):
        decision = {'topic': 'online', 'response_key': 'online_info', 'action': 'show_online_interest',
                    'contact_signal': 'none', 'reply': 'Te dejamos el enlace de inscripción de nuestro curso online.'}
        result = render_decision(validate_decision(decision, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True), {'completed_rounds': 9})
        self.assertEqual(result['action'], 'show_online_interest')
        self.assertIn('cuando se abra una edición online', result['reply'])
        self.assertNotIn('Hotmart', result['reply'])

    def test_online_legacy_enrollment_is_not_presented_as_open(self):
        for response_key in ('online_info', 'hotmart_link', 'course_conditions'):
            for rounds in (0, 7, 9):
                decision = {'topic': 'online', 'response_key': response_key, 'action': 'show_hotmart',
                            'contact_signal': 'none', 'reply': 'Inscríbete ahora en Hotmart.'}
                result = render_decision(validate_decision(decision, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True),
                                         {'completed_rounds': rounds})
                self.assertEqual(result['action'], 'show_online_interest')
                self.assertIn('cuando se abra una edición online', result['reply'])
                self.assertNotIn('Hotmart', result['reply'])

    def test_educational_flower_associations_are_available_to_the_provider(self):
        facts = {fact['id']: fact for fact in trusted_context({})['approved_facts']}
        for key, name in (('bach_mimulus', 'Mimulus'), ('bach_aspen', 'Aspen'), ('bach_rock_rose', 'Rock Rose'),
                          ('bach_red_chestnut', 'Red Chestnut'), ('bach_white_chestnut', 'White Chestnut')):
            self.assertIn(name, facts[key]['text'])
            self.assertTrue(facts[key]['source'].startswith('https://bachcentre.com/'))
        self.assertIn('EDUCACIÓN SOBRE EL MÉTODO', INSTRUCTIONS)
        self.assertIn('INDICACIÓN PERSONAL', INSTRUCTIONS)
        self.assertNotIn('orientaci?n', INSTRUCTIONS)

    def test_institutional_voice_is_explicit_and_used_by_protected_copy(self):
        self.assertIn('VOZ INSTITUCIONAL', INSTRUCTIONS)
        self.assertIn('primera persona plural', INSTRUCTIONS)
        self.assertIn('Podemos', RESPONSES['greeting'])
        self.assertIn('podemos', RESPONSES['payment_unverified'])
        self.assertIn('Podemos', RESPONSES['medical_boundary'])
        self.assertNotIn('Nicolás Zamara ofrece', json.dumps(KNOWLEDGE, ensure_ascii=False))

    def test_educational_replies_remain_conversational_while_personal_indications_use_boundary_copy(self):
        cases = json.loads(Path('config/chatbot/education-cases.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['cases']
        for case in cases:
            with self.subTest(case=case['id']):
                reply = 'Según Bach, Mimulus se asocia a miedos conocidos y Aspen a aprensión sin causa identificable; Rock Rose, a terror intenso.'
                decision = {'topic': 'therapies', 'response_key': case['response_key'],
                            'action': 'none' if case['response_key'] == 'medical_boundary' else 'show_therapies',
                            'contact_signal': 'none', 'reply': reply}
                result = render_decision(validate_decision(decision, trusted_context({}), require_reply=True), {})
                if case['response_key'] == 'medical_boundary':
                    self.assertEqual(result['reply'], RESPONSES['medical_boundary'])
                else:
                    self.assertEqual(result['reply'], reply)
                    for name in case['expected_mentions']:
                        self.assertIn(name, result['reply'])
                    for phrase in case['forbidden_reply']:
                        self.assertNotIn(phrase, result['reply'].lower())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
